title: Senior Financial Data Analyst / FP&A Business Partner
description:
**About The Company**
 Turning marketing into a market\-domination weapon, we created a new category \- the marketplace for future customers. Businesses shop for leads as they shop for products in e\-commerce: you see everything about a lead before you buy \- full transparency, control, and predictable outcomes. We're the \#1 lead marketplace in the USA, and we're accelerating.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for a Senior Financial Data Analyst / FP\&A Business Partner who will help us understand where the business makes money, where profit is lost, and which decisions can improve margins, cash flow, and overall performance. You will work closely with founders, finance, product, operations, and business teams to turn financial and operational data into clear recommendations. This role exists to help leadership make faster, better decisions based on real business numbers.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing:**
 Build and improve executive dashboards that show revenue, profit, margins, COGS, OpEx, refunds, payouts, cash flow, and key business metrics
   

  

 Analyze profitability across products, customers, providers, geographies, channels, lead sources, and operational workflows
   

  

 Create P\&L analysis, gross margin analysis, contribution margin analysis, unit economics models, forecasts, and scenario analysis
   

  

 Identify cost leaks, overspending, inefficient vendors, payment issues, margin risks, and other areas where the business can improve profit
   

  

 Partner with finance, accounting, product, operations, sales, and marketing teams to connect business activity with financial outcomes
   

  

 Reconcile business data with invoices, payouts, payment systems, taxes, accounting records, and financial reports
   

  

 Present clear recommendations to founders and senior leadership on pricing, cost optimization, product profitability, hiring, and growth decisions
   

  

**What Makes You a Strong Fit:**
 6\-8\+ years of experience in financial analytics, FP\&A, data analytics, business analytics, or a similar role
   

  

 Strong experience with financial modeling, P\&L analysis, unit economics, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis
   

  

 Expert\-level SQL and strong hands\-on experience with BigQuery
   

  

 Strong experience with Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or similar BI tools
   

  

 Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills for financial modeling, reporting, and scenario analysis
   

  

 Good understanding of accounting basics, financial statements, revenue, COGS, OpEx, gross margin, contribution margin, and cash flow
   

  

 Clear communication in English, both spoken and written, with the ability to explain financial insights to founders, business teams, and non\-finance stakeholders
   

  

**Bonus if you have:**
 Experience with Python or another scripting language for data analysis and reporting automation
   

  

 Experience with payment systems, accounting systems, CRM, ERP, Stripe, QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or similar tools
   

  

 Experience in marketplace, SaaS, fintech, real estate, lead generation, or performance marketing businesses
   

  

 Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership in a fast\-moving business environment
   

  

**Why You'll Love It Here:**
 You'll work at the core of a product\-led, AI\-powered startup where data drives every decision
   

  

 Your work will ship fast and impact thousands of users
   

  

 High autonomy, low bureaucracy: we trust you to own your domain
   

  

 Remote\-first culture with flexible hours and async\-friendly communication
   

  

 Salary (fixed base) ABOVE the market average
   

  

 A smart, passionate team that moves fast, supports each other, and builds cool stuff
   

  

 15 paid vacation days plus 5 paid sick days annually
   

  

 Paid access to courses, books, and growth resources
   

  

 Real decision\-making power and ownership of your results

title: Sr Data Analytics Supervisor
description:
**Job Description**
 Partnering with channel leaders, sales teams, business leadership, and cross\-functional stakeholders, you will develop and implement analytics, artificial intelligence (AI), and business intelligence solutions that enhance channel partner effectiveness, improve inventory health, strengthen market and channel intelligence, and accelerate business growth. Your ability to translate complex channel, customer, inventory, and market data into actionable insights will be critical in identifying growth opportunities, improving partner tiering and performance, enhancing forecast accuracy, optimizing inventory investments, and driving revenue growth. As a subject matter expert in analytics, you will champion data\-driven decision\-making across the organization while coaching and developing other analytics professionals to build a high\-performing analytics capability.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
*Key Responsibilities*
* Develop and implement channel sales analytics strategies, frameworks, and governance processes to support business growth and operational excellence.
* Lead channel partner tiering and segmentation initiatives, leveraging data to identify growth opportunities, optimize partner investments, and improve channel performance.
* Drive inventory analytics and management programs to improve inventory health, minimize excess and obsolete inventory, and support demand planning and forecasting efforts.
* Develop channel intelligence capabilities by integrating sales, market, customer, and competitive data to generate actionable business insights.
* Lead the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and advanced analytics solutions to improve forecasting accuracy, partner recommendations, anomaly detection, and decision\-making effectiveness.
* Collaborate with Sales, Channel Management, Supply Chain, Finance, and IT teams to identify business requirements and translate them into scalable analytical solutions.
* Design and maintain executive dashboards, KPI scorecards, and reporting frameworks that provide visibility into channel performance, inventory trends, and market opportunities.
* Ensure data quality, accuracy, governance, and consistency across channel sales and inventory data sources.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives by identifying trends, risks, and opportunities through advanced analytics and predictive modeling.
* Stay current with industry trends, best practices, AI technologies, and emerging analytics capabilities to enhance Honeywell's channel analytics strategy.


**Qualifications**
*YOU MUST HAVE*
* 5\+ years of experience in data analytics
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights
* Proficiency in data analytics tools and programming languages (e.g., Python, R, SQL, etc.)
* Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, etc.)


*WE VALUE*
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Data Science, Analytics, Engineering, etc.)
* Strong leadership skills and the ability to effectively influence and coach others
* Proven track record of driving data\-driven decision\-making and delivering measurable business results
* Experience in supply chain analytics or related field
* Knowledge of advanced analytics techniques (e.g., machine learning, predictive modeling, etc.)
* Experience with data governance and data quality initiatives


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: AVP, Collections Specialized Strategy (L10)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Collections Specialized Strategy (L10\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 This role will be responsible for Collections Strategy analytics to generate insights in strategy development, implementation, and performance monitoring of complex, regulatory\-sensitive loss mitigation programs. The person in this role will participate in the design of challenger (test) strategies including eligibility criteria, opportunity sizing, performance monitoring, and on\-going strategy enhancement. The creation and delivery of presentations to cross functional audiences is essential. In addition, there is on\-going responsibilities for maintaining key performance reporting and strategy documentation.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own loss mitigation program reporting and analytics: Create materials and lead monthly presentation to Collections Leadership. Create required quarterly OCC loss mitigation volume and performance presentation slides. Interpret performance and clearly present findings.
* Drive automation and perform ongoing validation/maintenance of new and existing loss mitigation reports; create automated reports with interactive data visualization intelligence.
* Proactively drive visual and content enhancements to loss mitigation program reporting for volumes and performance (e.g. advanced filters for due stage, channel, client, plan type, plan duration etc.).
* Support strategic initiatives by researching industry best practices, analyzing market trends, and identifying opportunities to strengthen pre\-charge\-off loss mitigation efforts.
* Partner with multiple groups to implement reporting changes and assess post\-implementation execution and performance.
* Proactively communicate and engage across multiple levels, on the status of project progress and analytic priorities
* Lead loss mitigation strategy changes for required maintenance (e.g., NCI/NPI; MISC1 changes; regulatory updates). This includes obtaining Working Group and Tollgate approvals, strategy sheet updates, requests to Strategy Delivery, and tracking pre \& post implementation validations (if applicable).
* Support in transitioning all existing and future loss mitigation strategy test performance monitoring to the Growth team
* Provide Analytics support to build best in class strategies for Loss Mitigation programs
* Evaluate new data elements, sources, industry best practices for collections
* Co\-lead or support cross\-functional project teams to consistently track performance. Perform analytics to understand performance changes and make enhancements to address degradation.
* Support OCC, Audit, NMT accuracy requests, regulatory requirements for all loss mitigation programs and ensure strategy documentation is comprehensive, accurate and up to date (i.e., audit ready).
* Participate in ad\-hoc projects and analyses, as needed, Other duties as assigned.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Bachelor's degree with quantitative underpinning (i.e., Data Science, Computer Science, Risk, Accounting, Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering) with 4\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience; OR in lieu of a degree, 6\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience.
* 4\+ years’ experience in SAS, SQL, Excel, Word and PowerPoint
* Excellent interpersonal, analytical, organizational and written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to make decisions and recommendations based on quantitative analysis and creative thinking
* Strong self\-starter balanced with desire to achieve team goals
* Ability to handle sensitive issues with uncompromising integrity and confidentiality


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Prior Collection Strategy Development or Credit Strategy Development/ Risk Management experience and/or prior Collections experience in other functions
* 4\+ years demonstrated success developing and delivering advanced analytics solutions
* Data lake experience and strategies
* Master's degree in Business or in a Quantitative Related Field
* Proven analytical and decision\-making skills
* Experience developing scoring models or decision\-tree segmentations
* Ability to independently manage processes, Self\-motivated, and drive continuous process improvement
* Strong communications, problem solving skills and attention to detail
* Experience presenting to senior leadership teams
* Demonstrated ability to apply strategic thinking toward tactical execution
* Experience working with cross\-functional project teams


**Eligibility Criteria**
* Bachelor's degree with quantitative underpinning (i.e., Data Science, Computer Science, Risk, Accounting, Business, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering) with 4\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience; OR in lieu of a degree, 6\+ years of experience in Programming/Analytics ideally in support of Risk, Credit, Finance, Accounting, Consumer Lending, or other relevant professional experience.


**Work Timings:** 
**2:00 PM to 11:00 PM IST**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

title: Commercial & Transformation Lead
description:
**Mission Brief** 




  





 Transform how Lenskart buys, negotiates and creates value from every rupee it spends.
 



 Lenskart is scaling rapidly across manufacturing, retail, supply chain and multiple geographies. At this scale, commercial decisions are no longer just about procurement. They are a strategic lever for growth, margin and competitive advantage.
 



 The opportunity is to bring greater intelligence, discipline and technology into how we manage external spend, from manufacturing inputs and logistics to retail, technology and corporate categories.
 



 Your mandate is to close the gap between what we spend and what we should spend and create a commercial engine that is data\-led, AI\-enabled and deeply connected to the business.
 



 This is a high\-ownership role for someone who enjoys solving complex, ambiguous business problems and turning those solutions into measurable outcomes.
 



  





**What You Will Own:** 




  





 Commercial Intelligence \& AI
 



 Shape Lenskart’s commercial intelligence layer across:
 


* Spend analytics, should\-cost models and total\-cost\-of\-ownership frameworks
* Supplier intelligence, scorecards and risk assessment
* E\-sourcing and contract intelligence
* AI\-assisted negotiation and price discovery
* Automated, data\-led decision making across categories



  





 The goal is to move from fragmented information and manual decision\-making to a system where
 **the data tells us where the opportunity is and technology helps us act on it.** 




  





 Strategic Sourcing \& P\&L Impact
 



 Own the commercial opportunity across a broad spend universe:
 



**Direct:** 
 Frames, lenses, coatings, accessories, packaging and manufacturing inputs
 



**Indirect:** 
 Store CapEx and OpEx, marketing, technology and corporate spend
 



**Supply Chain:** 
 Logistics, last\-mile, lab\-to\-store, make\-vs\-buy and network optimisation
 



 You will be expected to identify structural opportunities, develop category strategies and deliver measurable YoY P\&L impact through
 **should\-cost, TCO, value engineering and smarter commercial models.** 




  





 Negotiation \& Supplier Strategy
 



 Lead some of Lenskart’s highest\-value commercial negotiations while establishing greater negotiation rigour across the organisation.
 



  





 This includes developing stronger supplier strategies, benchmarking markets, understanding cost structures, defining negotiation playbooks and creating clear walk\-away positions.
 



 The objective is not simply to
 **negotiate harder** 
 , but to fundamentally improve the economics of the relationships we enter into.
 



  





 Business Problem Solving \& Leadership
 



 This role sits at the intersection of multiple parts of the business.
 



 You will work closely with
 **Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Retail, Technology and Marketing** 
 , as well as the founders and senior leadership team, on problems where the answer is not always obvious.
 



  





 You will be expected to:
 


* Break down complex business problems into clear commercial decisions.
* Challenge existing ways of working using data and first\-principles thinking.
* Translate business requirements into technology and AI solutions.
* Take ideas from analysis through implementation and measurable impact.
* Influence stakeholders across functions and drive adoption at scale.



  





 Who We’re Looking For
 



 We are looking for someone who
 **thinks like a business leader, not a functional specialist.** 




 You may come from strategy, consulting, business operations, supply chain, sourcing, procurement, corporate development or a high\-growth operating environment.
 



 What matters is that you have demonstrated:
 


* Strong problem\-solving ability across ambiguous, high\-impact business situations.
* Experience working directly with founders or senior leadership.
* Strong commercial and analytical instincts.
* Exposure to supply chain, sourcing, cost structures or commercial strategy.
* The ability to connect
 **strategy, economics, technology and execution.**
* A track record of taking ownership for outcomes, not just recommendations.
* Curiosity and instinct to use AI and technology to fundamentally improve how work gets done.



 Experience with
 **manufacturing, APAC, China or Middle East supply ecosystems** 
 is a strong advantage.
 



  





 Why This Role
 



**This is not a traditional procurement role.** 




 You will have the opportunity to work on some of the most consequential commercial problems at Lenskart, with visibility into the decisions that shape
 **margin, supply chain, capital allocation and growth.** 




  





 You will work closely with the
 **founders and senior leadership** 
 , operate across the full business and have significant ownership over the direction of the commercial function.
 



 The scale is substantial:
 **2,500\+ stores, hundreds of suppliers, multiple geographies and an increasingly complex manufacturing and supply chain ecosystem.** 




  





 The opportunity is to combine
 **business problem solving, commercial strategy, supply chain thinking and technology** 
 to create a capability that can materially change Lenskart’s economics.

description:
**About The Role**
 What if your MBA — your hard\-won expertise in corporate finance, market strategy, and business operations — could directly shape how AI advises executives and drives decisions for millions of businesses around the world?
   

  

 We're looking for MBA\-qualified professionals to work with Alignerr, partnering with the world's leading AI research labs to train and evaluate cutting\-edge AI models. You'll stress\-test AI reasoning on the toughest business problems, author gold\-standard solutions, and ensure these models are truly ready to function as sophisticated partners for executive decision\-making.
   

  

 This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. No prior AI experience needed — just deep business expertise and a sharp analytical mind.
   

  

* Organization: Alignerr
* Type: Hourly Contract
* Location: Remote
* Commitment: 10–40 hours/week


**What You'll Do**
* Design Complex Business Challenges — Craft advanced business cases and quantitative problems spanning DCF valuation, market entry strategy, operations bottlenecks, cap table modeling, and more
* Author Ground\-Truth Solutions — Produce rigorous, step\-by\-step responses complete with financial statements, strategic frameworks (4Ps, 5Cs, Porter's Five Forces), and executive\-level rationales that serve as the "golden standard" for AI training

* Comfortable working independently and asynchronously on your own schedule
* No prior AI or data annotation experience required


**Nice to Have**
* Prior experience in management consulting, investment banking, or corporate strategy
* Background in data annotation, data quality, or evaluation systems
* Proficiency in data\-driven tools such as Excel financial modeling, Tableau, or SQL
* Experience producing board\-level or C\-suite communications and deliverables


**Why Join Us**
* Work directly with industry\-leading large language models at the frontier of AI development
* Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you, on your terms
* Freelance autonomy with the structure of meaningful, high\-impact project work
* Apply your business expertise to a domain that is reshaping the global economy
* Potential for ongoing work and contract renewals as new projects launch

title: Associate, Data Foundation & Governance
description:
**Associate, Data Foundation \& Governance** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
*4\-8 years of relevant experience* 




  





**About the Company** 




 Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm built around entrepreneurial, action\-oriented, and results\-focused professionals. The firm takes a hands\-on approach to solving complex client problems and helping organizations reach their potential. A\&M values Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, creating a collaborative environment for independent thinkers and doers. In 2023, A\&M established a high\-quality Global Capability Center in India to support leadership, business units, and client delivery teams across major markets. The center combines consulting and industry professionals across Consumer \& Retail, Healthcare, Software \& Technology, Automotive \& Industrials, Hospitality \& Leisure, Energy \& Natural Resources, and Financial Services. Unlike traditional back\-office models, the GCC partners with case teams on end\-to\-end delivery and thought leadership. The growing center already has more than 900 members and is designed to scale specialized talent, accelerate delivery, and apply automation and analytics to create measurable business value.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 As Associate, Data Foundation \& Governance, you will strengthen the trusted data foundations that power global People Data Analytics \& Reporting. You will own the consistency, clarity, and quality of HR data across Workday, Jobvite, and connected systems. Your work will establish standardized definitions, maintain the business and metric glossary, govern master data, and document lineage and change controls. You will partner with HRIS, reporting, Finance, and business stakeholders to identify and remediate data issues before they affect reporting, analytics, compliance, or workforce decisions. The role combines hands\-on data stewardship with structured governance, requiring careful analysis, clear documentation, and disciplined follow\-through. You will also help prepare HR data for a future governed data lakehouse, creating scalable foundations for reliable global workforce insight.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own standardized HR data definitions and the business and metric glossary across HR, Finance, and business units, improving consistency and reducing conflicting interpretations in workforce reporting.
* Establish data quality standards, validation checks, and periodic audits across people systems, using documented controls to identify errors early and improve confidence in recurring analytics.
* Support data alignment across Workday, Jobvite, and connected HR systems, resolving inconsistencies in structures, attributes, and records that could distort workforce reporting or downstream analysis.
* Maintain master data governance for positions, organizations, cost centers, and related entities, ensuring approved ownership, definitions, and changes remain aligned with business requirements.
* Document data lineage, definitions, and change controls, creating an accessible evidence base that preserves continuity, supports audits, and makes reporting logic easier to understand and maintain.
* Partner with HRIS on Workday architecture and configuration decisions, assessing how upstream design choices affect data quality, reporting reliability, governance, and future scalability.
* Coordinate stewardship workflows for definition changes, issue escalation, and dispute resolution, helping stakeholders reach documented decisions that protect enterprise\-wide data consistency.
* Contribute to audit, compliance, and secure data\-handling requirements, including GDPR awareness, while preparing governed data foundations for a future data lakehouse migration.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* 3–5 years of hands\-on relevant experience in HR data management, data governance, data stewardship, or master data management, with total experience typically ranging from 4–8 years.
* Practical experience creating and maintaining data definitions, business glossaries, data dictionaries, quality rules, lineage documentation, or change\-control records for HR data across functions.
* Familiarity with Workday data structures and HR domains such as positions, organizations, cost centers, headcount, and reporting hierarchies; exposure to Jobvite or similar systems is valuable.
* Strong Excel and data\-analysis capability, with exposure to Alteryx preferred. You should be able to investigate data issues methodically and translate findings into actionable remediation.
* Working knowledge of data governance, data quality, master data management, secure data handling, and data protection expectations such as GDPR.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to document standards, explain data issues, and collaborate effectively with global, cross\-functional stakeholders.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Experience supporting HRIS, People Analytics, reporting, Finance, or enterprise data teams in environments where definitions and master data must remain consistent across functions.
* Exposure to data lineage tooling, governed data lakehouse preparation, migration readiness, or structured stewardship and approval workflows.
* Experience working in a global organization or consulting environment with distributed stakeholders, multiple geographies, and changing business requirements.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* A Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Information Management, Statistics, Business Analytics, or a related discipline, supported by practical experience working with enterprise or HR data.
* Hands\-on ownership of data governance, data stewardship, or master data management outcomes, rather than only report production. You can define standards, establish controls, and follow issues through resolution.
* Strong attention to detail and a methodical quality mindset. You challenge ambiguous definitions, investigate root causes, document decisions, and protect the reliability of data used for workforce and business decisions.
* Understanding of HR data across functions, including positions, organizational structures, cost centers, headcount, and related workforce attributes. You can connect business meaning with system structures and reporting needs.
* Confidence working with Excel and data analysis, with the ability to review records, identify patterns, test quality, and communicate practical remediation actions. Exposure to Alteryx, Workday, Jobvite, or comparable tools is advantageous.
* Clear, structured communication and documentation skills. You can make technical or governance concepts understandable to HR, Finance, HRIS, reporting, and business stakeholders.
* A collaborative approach suited to a global, cross\-functional environment. You take ownership, manage competing inputs objectively, and contribute to governance decisions that improve trust, compliance, and scalability.



  





**Why Join Us** 




 This role gives you the opportunity to shape the data foundations behind a global workforce, rather than simply producing reports from existing information. Your standards, controls, definitions, and stewardship decisions will influence how leaders understand people data across functions and geographies. You will work at the intersection of HR, HRIS, Finance, reporting, governance, and analytics, building experience that remains valuable as organizations modernize their data operating models. The role also provides a direct path into future data lakehouse and enterprise governance initiatives, allowing you to contribute to scalable architecture and stronger decision support. At A\&M, you will join an entrepreneurial consulting environment where independent thinkers are encouraged to take ownership and create measurable impact. The India GCC offers exposure to global markets, multiple industries, and end\-to\-end delivery work rather than a narrowly transactional support model. You will be supported through formal training, on\-the\-job learning, performance development, and opportunities to expand your technical and professional capabilities. Your contribution will be visible, practical, and connected to business outcomes.
 



  





**What We Offer** 



* A high\-impact opportunity to build trusted people\-data foundations for a growing global consulting organization. Your work will improve reporting consistency, governance, compliance readiness, and workforce decision\-making.
* Exposure to global stakeholders across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC, with opportunities to partner across HR, HRIS, Finance, reporting, analytics, and business teams.
* A structured environment for continuous learning through formal training, on\-the\-job development, performance feedback, and opportunities to build specialized data governance expertise.
* A collaborative, inclusive, and entrepreneurial culture guided by A\&M’s values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity.

 Key Responsibilities

 Skills \& Competencies
 



  





 Essential Skills

description:
**About This Role**
 Business Unit Overview:
   

  

 The Performance Measurement \& Attribution team is responsible for the outcome and interpretation of portfolio \& benchmark return analytics in Blackrock, critical to insights that enable investment and risk teams to make informed decisions. This includes generating and interpreting analytical outcomes, leading product \& strategy level support, acting as a centralized source and applying analytical tools and automated solutions that standardize calculators \& methodologies, reduce time\-to\-market and bring consistency across our analytics.
   

  

 The demand for accurate, timely \& informational performance data is central to many of the organizational core objectives, and are core to the analytical and global client service culture of the team. Products covered by the team are the spectrum of Mutual Funds, ETF’s, segregated clients and investment asset classes including Fixed Income, Multi\-Asset, Equity and Alternatives.
   

  

**Background And Development Value**
 Do you want to build a foundation in performance, and learn to provide investment and technology solutions with purpose to help our clients meet their goals? As a member of PMA, take part in the story and take ownership as a performance expert. We are responsible for investment performance and attribution analysis globally across Fixed Income, Equity and Multi\-Asset strategies. You get to work with multiple business divisions, including the iShares Equity Product suite, Institutional Equity, Beta Strategies, and Fixed Income products. The team focuses on using technology and project management to improve existing processes to optimize content delivery.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Partner with teams globally to present a consistent client experience catalyzing a common culture.
* Lead and oversee accurate and timely performance reporting across multiple fund groups, ensuring smooth data flow between systems and teams.
* Drive resolution of residuals using the Aladdin platform and proactively identify improvements in execution.
* Deepen expertise in internal analytical systems (Aladdin) to investigate complex client inquiries and support evolving business needs.
* Mentor and guide junior colleagues, fostering a culture of learning and collaboration. Lead cross\-regional transitions and changes to reporting platforms, ensuring seamless execution.
* Champion efficiency and capacity\-building initiatives, including automation and standardization efforts, employing BlackRock’s technology platform.


**Knowledge/Experience**
* Strong conceptual and practical understanding of performance and attribution concepts
* Strong domain knowledge in Multi\-Asset, Fixed Income, and Equity instruments, along with general performance principles.
* 5–8 years of experience in Performance and Attribution within the asset management industry
* Experience in leading reporting platform migrations and handling cross\-regional transitions.
* Advanced programming skills in SQL, Python, and Power BI; passion for learning new technologies and deepening Aladdin attribution expertise.


**Skills/Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent; prior experience with business modeling techniques and/or attribution tools (CFA or CIPM designation a plus).
* Ability to work independently and lead initiatives; strong problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail.
* Forward\-thinking and passionate about outcomes; able to synthesize information, summarize issues, and drive solutions.
* Proven success in mentoring junior colleagues and building team capability.
* Experience with performance tools and external fund administrators a plus


**Competencies**
 We pride ourselves on our diverse approaches and thinking styles. We want an excellent communicator (verbal and written), who displays strong interpersonal interactions, and can operate in a distributed team environment. Someone with a sharp control/risk mitigation attitude, and positive get\-the\-job\-done demeanor
   

  

**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
   

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
 At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision\-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
 **guidance** 
 on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
   

  

**About BlackRock**
 At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well\-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
   

  

 This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
   

  

 To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.
   

  

 BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

title: Category Associate
description:
**About Us** 
 : We are making natural living a HABIT little by little. We do so by serving 100% natural self care to our consumers. The products are scientifically formulated, guided by ayurvedic principles \& modern science. They are prepared fresh everyday in our ayurvedic kitchen, out of whole and raw ingredients such as fresh milk, curd, fruit pulps, flowers, herbs, nut \& spices. They are finally tested clinically for efficacy \& safety. This offering of Fresh Ayurveda has made a mark in the Indian personal care industry.
 



  





 Today \~60Lac customers trust us for their personal care needs. The founding team has a strong startup experience, is well funded and backed by tier 1 institutional investors.
 



  





**About the role** 




 Most entry\-level category hires start with a dashboard. This one starts with a phone call. The Category Associate's job is to build the category's understanding of its consumer from the ground up \- through call surveys, focus group discussions (FGDs) and in\-person interactions \- and turn that into insight that shapes what we make, how we sell it, and where we invest next. It's a research\-to\-execution role: you generate the insight, then help ship the decisions that follow from it.
 



  





**Why this starts with a real conversation, not a dashboard** 




 We won't pretend it's the easy part. Calling a stranger, running an FGD, or standing in front of a consumer and asking why she didn't repurchase is harder than pulling a report \- and most people this early in their career would rather stay behind a screen. We're asking you to do it anyway, because it's the one input nobody else in the building has.
 



  





 Secondary data \- sales, ratings, app analytics \- tells you
 *what* 
 happened. A consumer conversation tells you
 *why* 
 , often weeks before it shows up in a number. That gap is where category strategy actually gets built: which claim lands, which price point stings, which product idea is a real gap versus a nice\-to\-know. Skip the conversation and you're strategising on guesses.
 



  





 It's also the fastest route to real say in the business. The Category Associates who move quickest into P\&L ownership are the ones whose point of view the business trusts before the data catches up \- because they built it firsthand, one conversation at a time.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



1. **Consumer insight engine.** 
 Run structured call surveys, FGDs and in\-person consumer interactions (store visits, pop\-ups, cohort meetups) to build a live, ground\-up read of what the category's consumer wants, buys, and drops off on \- a standing system, not a one\-time project.
2. **Insight → action.** 
 Convert raw consumer feedback into structured insight \- need\-gaps, purchase triggers, objections, usage occasions \- that Product, Marketing and Ops can act on, and follow through to make sure it actually gets used.
3. **Category ops execution.** 
 Own the operational backbone of the category \- listings, pricing hygiene, catalog accuracy, promo execution, inventory flags, competitor tracking \- so nothing slips between insight and shelf.
4. **Data and dashboards.** 
 Track category KPIs (sales, conversion, repeat rate, ratings/reviews, NPS) and build or automate the reporting for them. The bar: build a workflow once, don't rebuild a report every week.
5. **Ground\-up category mapping.** 
 Build and maintain the category's core reference material \- competitor landscape, price\-value map, consumer segments, category taxonomy \- as living, reusable assets, not one\-off decks.
6. **Cross\-functional coordination.** 
 Work daily with Marketing, Creative, Ops and Supply to get category initiatives shipped on time.



  





**What great looks like in your first 90 days** 



* You've personally spoken to 50\+ consumers (calls, FGDs, in\-person) and turned it into one clear point of view on a real gap or opportunity in the category.
* You've built, or meaningfully improved, a self\-refreshing dashboard for the category's core KPIs \- no manual pull required.
* You know the category's competitive set cold: pricing, claims, reviews, what's winning and why.
* At least one of your insights has visibly changed a decision \- a listing, a claim, a promo, a launch input.



  





**What you bring** 



* 1\+ years of experience \- freshers welcome; internships or research/analytics projects count.
* You genuinely enjoy talking to consumers \- you'd rather run 10 calls than read 10 secondary reports.
* Strong with data: comfortable in Excel/Sheets at minimum; SQL or basic scripting is a real plus, and you're always looking for what can be automated rather than repeated by hand.
* Business\-first instinct \- you don't stop at "here's what the data says," you push to "here's what we should do about it."
* High ownership of ops execution \- as comfortable in the weeds of listings, pricing sheets and trackers as you are in a deck.
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline \- research, consumer behaviour, business or a quant background all work well here.



  





 Location: Udyog Vihar, Gurgaon
 



 Website: www.nathabit.in
 



 Instagram: www.instagram.com/nathabit.in

description:
**Locations** 
 : Gurgaon \| Bengaluru
   

  

 Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Lead Analyst in BCG X Product Delivery, you will support the delivery of projects and digital solutions for clients across the oil \& gas, refining, chemicals, and broader energy value chain. You will work at the intersection of business strategy, operations, and technology, helping clients translate complex operational challenges into practical, high\-impact solutions.
   

  

 You will help structure client problems, identify value pools, define improvement opportunities, and support the design of use cases across areas such as refining performance, planning and scheduling, margin optimization, emissions reduction, turnaround management, maintenance, reliability, and operational excellence.
   

  

 You will work closely with BCG case teams, BCG X product and technical teams, and client stakeholders to ensure that Ekons solutions are grounded in real business needs. You will support client interviews, workshops, diagnostics, value sizing, business case development, roadmap definition, and change management activities.
   

  

 You will also help translate strategic and operational priorities into clear solution requirements, ensuring that digital tools are not developed in isolation but are directly linked to measurable business outcomes. title: Senior Category Associate
description:
**About Us** 
 : We are making natural living a HABIT little by little. We do so by serving 100% natural self care to our consumers. The products are scientifically formulated, guided by ayurvedic principles \& modern science. They are prepared fresh everyday in our ayurvedic kitchen, out of whole and raw ingredients such as fresh milk, curd, fruit pulps, flowers, herbs, nut \& spices. They are finally tested clinically for efficacy \& safety. This offering of Fresh Ayurveda has made a mark in the Indian personal care industry.
 



  





 Today \~60Lac customers trust us for their personal care needs. The founding team has a strong startup experience, is well funded and backed by tier 1 institutional investors.
 



  





**About the role** 




 A Senior Category Associate does everything a Category Associate does \- stays close to the consumer, keeps the insight engine running, keeps ops tight \- and then goes one step further: you own the category's P\&L and make the calls. Pricing, mix, promo calendar, launch bets, inventory investment \- the decisions are yours, backed by the ground\-truth you built.
 



  





**Why this stays hands\-on even once you own the P\&L** 




 It would be easy, at this level, to hand the calls and FGDs to someone junior and sit with the dashboard instead. We deliberately don't let that happen. The decisions you're now accountable for \- pricing, assortment, what to launch, what to sunset \- are only as good as the ground\-truth behind them, and that ground\-truth comes from talking to consumers directly, not from a report someone else generated.
 



  





 Secondary data tells you what happened last month. A direct conversation tells you why, early enough to act before it shows up as a dip in the number you own. The Senior Category Associates who make the best calls are the ones who never fully hand over the phone \- they just get faster and sharper at turning what they hear into a decision.
 



  





**What you'll own** 



1. **The full Category Associate scope** 
 \- consumer insight generation (calls, FGDs, in\-person), insight\-to\-action, category ops, KPI dashboards and automation, ground\-up category mapping \- at a higher bar of independence.
2. **Category P\&L.** 
 Own revenue, margin and growth for your category end\-to\-end \- you know the number, you know why it moved, and you're accountable for moving it.
3. **Pricing and promo decisions.** 
 Set and adjust pricing, discounting and the promo calendar for your category based on consumer insight, competitive movement and margin impact.
4. **Portfolio and launch calls.** 
 Decide what's in and out of the category's assortment \- which SKUs to push, fix or sunset \- and drive new launches from consumer insight through to go\-to\-market, owning the business case.
5. **Inventory and investment.** 
 Make the call on stock investment and category spend, balancing growth against working capital.
6. **The "why" behind the plan.** 
 Brief and align Marketing, Creative, Supply and Ops around your category plan \- you're the person who owns the reasoning, not just the numbers.



  





**What great looks like in your first 90 days** 



* You can explain your category's P\&L movement for the last quarter, cold \- and you have a point of view on what to do next.
* You've made and owned at least one real pricing, promo or assortment call, and can show the before/after.
* Your workflows and trackers run without you touching them daily \- your time is going into decisions, not data\-pulling.
* Cross\-functional teams come to you as the source of truth in your category.



  





**What you bring** 



* 2\+ years of experience, ideally with exposure to consumer research/insights and category or business ops \- a Category Associate background, or equivalent, is ideal.
* Comfortable owning a number: you think in margin, contribution and growth, not just tasks completed.
* Strong data fluency with a real bias to automate \- you build the system once so you're not rebuilding the report every week.
* A decisive, business\-first operator \- you can move from "here's the insight" to "here's the decision" to "here's what shipped."
* Still hands\-on with consumers directly \- this isn't a desk\-only role even at the senior level.
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline.



  





 Location: Udyog Vihar, Gurgaon
 



 Website: www.nathabit.in
 



 Instagram: www.instagram.com/nathabit.in

title: Planning Lead
description:
**About the Role** 




 FNP operates in a high\-velocity, occasion\-driven gifting business where demand can spike 5–10x around key calendar events (Valentine's Day, Rakhi, Diwali, Mother's Day, Anniversaries) and where a large share of the catalog — flowers, cakes, plants — is perishable with a shelf life measured in hours or days. This makes planning the backbone of the business: get it wrong, and the company either loses sales during peak occasions or writes off perishable stock; get it right, and it protects both customer experience and margins.
 



  





 We are looking for a
 **Lead – Planning** 
 who will own the
 **demand plan, inventory plan, and operations manpower plan** 
 as one integrated system rather than three disconnected charts. The role leads
 **three functions** 
 (Demand Planning, Inventory Planning, and Operations Manpower Planning) directly, and is accountable for the quality, alignment, and business impact of what each of them produces. This is a highly cross\-functional role sitting at the intersection of Sales, Category, Supply Chain, Hub Operations, and HR/Workforce teams, and is ideal for someone who enjoys working with data, can operate a level above the day\-to\-day execution, and can translate a demand forecast all the way down.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Demand Planning
 


* Direct and review the
 **short\-term (weekly/daily) and long\-term (monthly/seasonal) demand forecasts** 
 built by the Demand Planning Manager across categories (flowers, cakes, plants, personalized gifts, combos) and cities/hubs; sign off before they feed downstream planning.
* Set the strategy for
 **event/occasion\-based forecasting** 
 (Valentine's Day, Rakhi, Diwali, Mother's Day, Friendship Day, Anniversaries, Corporate Gifting cycles) and stress\-test the Manager's assumptions against historical trends, growth targets, and market intelligence.
* Represent Planning in discussions with
 **Sales, Category, and Marketing teams** 
 on promotions, new product launches, and campaign spends, ensuring these are correctly reflected in the forecast.
* Own
 **forecast accuracy (MAPE/Bias) as a KPI** 
 for the Demand Planning Manager; chair the monthly/weekly forecast review (S\&OP) and drive accountability on deviations.
* Guide demand segmentation by
 **city, hub, delivery slot, and channel** 
 (app/web/B2B) to ensure it's granular enough for inventory and manpower planning downstream.
* Ensure early\-warning triggers for demand risk (weather impact on flower availability, competitor activity, macro trends) are built and escalated in time.



 2\. Inventory Planning
 


* Review and approve the
 **procurement and inventory plans** 
 the Inventory Planning Manager builds off the demand plan, for both perishable (flowers, cakes) and non\-perishable (vases, add\-on gifts, packaging) categories.
* Set policy for
 **safety stock, reorder points, and shelf\-life\-based replenishment norms** 
 , given the perishability constraints unique to floriculture and bakery items, and hold the Manager accountable to it.
* Own
 **inventory health metrics** 
 — fill rate, wastage/spoilage %, aging stock, stock\-out %, and inventory turns — as KRAs for the Manager, and step in on corrective action plans when metrics slip.
* Escalate and resolve issues with
 **Sourcing/Procurement and Vendor Management** 
 on supplier lead times and MOQs where the Manager needs senior\-level support, especially ahead of peak occasions.
* Sign off on
 **hub\-wise and dark\-store\-wise stock allocation** 
 plans to balance delivery reliability against working capital.
* Set direction for
 **pre\-season and post\-season inventory strategy** 
 — build\-up ahead of peak days and liquidation/markdown planning for residual inventory — and hold the Manager to the plan.



 3\. Operations Manpower Planning
 


* Review and approve the
 **operations workforce plan** 
 the Manager builds off the demand and inventory plan — across florists/decorators, packers, riders/delivery partners, and warehouse staff.
* Approve
 **shift\-wise and day\-wise manpower requirement models** 
 , with particular scrutiny on surge plans for peak occasions where manpower needs can multiply overnight.
* Provide senior\-level backing to the Manager's coordination with
 **HR, Hub Operations, and Third\-Party Logistics/Gig partners** 
 on hiring, temporary staffing, and gig\-workforce deployment ahead of peak seasons.
* Own
 **productivity metrics** 
 (orders processed per FTE, cost per order/delivery, utilization %) as a KRA for the Manager, and sponsor efficiency initiatives that need cross\-functional or budget approval.
* Sign off on the
 **peak season manpower playbook** 
 — sourcing timelines, training plans, and contingency staffing (backup riders/packers) — before each major occasion.
* Hold the Manager accountable for manpower cost against the
 **operations budget and cost\-per\-order targets** 
 .



 4\. Integrated Planning \& Stakeholder Management
 


* Run an
 **integrated S\&OP (Sales \& Operations Planning) process** 
 that connects demand, inventory, and manpower plans into a single peak\-season readiness plan.
* Present
 **weekly/monthly planning reviews** 
 to leadership with clear visibility on forecast accuracy, inventory health, fill rates, and manpower readiness.
* Ensure
 **planning dashboards/MIS** 
 (Excel/Power BI/internal tools) maintained by the three Managers give real\-time visibility during high\-demand periods.
* Act as the
 **single point of accountability** 
 for "will we be ready for \[occasion]?" across product, stock, and people.



 5\. People Management
 


* Lead, mentor, and performance\-manage the
 **Demand Planning Manager, Inventory Planning Manager, and Operations Manpower Planning Manager** 
 , setting clear KRAs and reviewing them regularly.
* **Resolve trade\-offs between the three functions** 
 when priorities conflict — e.g., Inventory pushing to cut safety stock for working capital vs. Demand wanting a buffer for an upcoming occasion, or Manpower flagging a staffing constraint that the demand plan hasn't accounted for.
* Build
 **bench strength and succession** 
 within the planning team; identify capability gaps and drive relevant training (forecasting tools, S\&OP practices, data literacy).
* Foster a
 **culture of data\-driven decision\-making and ownership** 
 across the three teams, and represent the collective planning function to senior leadership as one voice.



  





**Required Qualifications \& Experience** 



* **Education:** 
 MBA / PGDM (Operations, Supply Chain, Analytics) or B.Tech/B.E. with relevant experience; certifications in Supply Chain Planning (CPIM/CSCP) are a plus.
* **Experience:** 
 10–14 years in Demand Planning, Inventory/Supply Chain Planning, or Operations Planning, preferably in
 **e\-commerce, quick\-commerce, FMCG, retail, or perishables** 
 businesses with high demand seasonality, with at least 3–4 years managing managers or leading a multi\-function planning team.
* Demonstrated experience managing
 **peak\-season/event\-driven demand spikes** 
 is highly preferred.
* Prior exposure to
 **workforce/manpower planning** 
 in an operations\-heavy (hub/warehouse/last\-mile) setup is a strong plus.
* Proven track record of
 **leading and developing managers/team leads** 
 , not just individual contributors — this role's success depends on getting the best out of three functional heads, not doing their jobs for them.



**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong
 **analytical and quantitative skills** 
 — comfortable with forecasting techniques, statistical models, and large datasets.
* Proficiency in
 **Excel/Google Sheets** 
 (advanced) and working knowledge of
 **Power BI/Tableau** 
 ; exposure to planning tools (SAP APO, Blue Yonder, o9, or similar) is a plus.
* Ability to think in
 **systems** 
 — connecting demand, inventory, and people as one plan rather than three silos.
* Strong
 **people leadership** 
 — able to manage through managers, delegate effectively, and coach rather than take over when a Manager struggles.
* Sound
 **conflict resolution and prioritization** 
 skills to adjudicate between the three functions when their goals pull in different directions.
* Excellent
 **stakeholder management** 
 skills to align Sales, Category, Procurement, Hub Operations, and HR around a single plan.
* Comfortable operating with
 **high ambiguity and tight timelines** 
 , especially in the run\-up to peak gifting occasions.
* Strong
 **communication skills** 
 — ability to present complex planning data simply to leadership.
* A bias for
 **action and ownership** 
 , with the resilience to manage the intensity of a 24\-48 hour peak\-occasion operating window multiple times a year.

title: Senior Analyst, Institutional Portfolio Operations
description:
When you join the Institutional Portfolio Operations (IPO) team as a Senior Analyst, you are joining a group of tightknit, energetic, and social individuals, who together have a direct impact on the investment success of individuals, pension funds, foundations and endowments, First Nations and other institutional clients.

title: Manager, Marketplace Accounts Receivable
description:
As our Accounts Receivable Manager, Marketplace, you will lead the financial operations for our rapidly expanding cloud marketplace ecosystem (AWS, Azure, and GCP). This is a strategic backfill for a key leadership role within our Global Order\-to\-Cash organization.
   

  

 You will own the daily financial operations of MongoDB’s cloud marketplace business across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Ensure seamless integration between partner portals and internal finance systems while safeguarding transaction accuracy, revenue integrity, and operational continuity. Proactively identify risks and implement scalable solutions as transaction volumes grow.
   

  

 Based in our Gurugram office, you will sit at the intersection of Finance, Sales Operations, and Cloud Engineering. You aren't just managing a ledger; you are managing the financial health of our most critical growth channel, ensuring that high\-volume marketplace transactions are billed accurately and collected with surgical precision.
   

  

 What You’ll Do (Day\-to\-Day)
   

  

* Marketplace Operations Leadership: Serve as the functional successor in managing MongoDB’s cloud marketplace presence. Oversee the daily flow of transactions through AWS, Azure, and GCP, ensuring seamless integration between partner portals and internal finance systems
* Accounts Receivable Supervision: Maintain rigorous oversight of the AR lifecycle for the marketplace portfolio. This includes supervising the accuracy of invoices, monitoring aging reports, and ensuring that payouts are reconciled daily against recognized revenue


 Lead end\-to\-end AR lifecycle management for the marketplace portfolio: Oversee invoice accuracy and completeness to maintain reliable financial records, monitor aging accounts and drive a proactive collections strategy to optimize cash flow, meet/exceed assigned cash targets on a monthly and quarterly basis \& participate actively in month\-end and close activities, including reporting.
   

  

* Cash Application \& Reconciliation Excellence: Ensure timely and accurate application of marketplace receipts across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Oversee daily reconciliation for incoming cash, minimize unapplied cash, resolve remittance discrepancies, and drive automation to support scale and clean audit trails \& partner cross\-functionally to address root causes.
* Strategic Partner Engagement: Act as the primary Finance liaison for our Cloud Partners which includes maintaining strong relationships to ensure all issues or discrepancies can be resolved timely.
* Process Standardization: Continue the evolution of our "Order\-to\-Cash" workflows. Identify bottlenecks in the marketplace billing cycle and implement automated solutions to manage increasing transaction volumes as we scale along with owning operational readiness in a fast\-paced environment by multitasking effectively and staying highly organized.
* Team Mentorship \& Management: Retain, lead and develop a high\-performing team of AR Specialists in India. Your day will include technical guidance on complex reconciliations, performance reviews, and fostering a culture of "Customer Success" within Finance.
* Cross\-Functional Synergy: In this role, you will partner closely with the Marketplace Operations, Marketplace Billing, and Customer Success teams to ensure that marketplace customers experience a frictionless billing journey. You will act as a strategic bridge between the Finance and Sales teams to ensure contract alignment, billing accuracy, and clear revenue visibility.
* SOX \& Audit: Ensure operations and processes adhere to our SOX Controls, reviews and is familiar with our key and non key controls listed in AuditBoard. Monitor and adjust processes, workflows, recommend controls needed or changes to existing controls as business operations change \& support Audit requirements and activities as needed.


**What You’ll Need**
* Experience: 8–10 years in Accounts Receivable or Revenue Operations, with 4\+ years in a leadership capacity within a high\-growth Global Capability Center (GCC) or SaaS environment.
* Technical Mastery: \* Advanced proficiency in NetSuite (ERP) and Salesforce (CRM) is essential
+ Hands\-on experience with automated collections tools and reporting
+ Expert Excel skills (Data manipulation, Power Query, and complex reconciliations)

* Marketplace Savvy: Deep understanding of hyperscaler billing dynamics (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including payout reports, net vs. gross revenue, and fee structures
* Analytical Rigor: An obsession with detail and the ability to spot root\-cause issues in large, multi\-currency datasets
* Communication: Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills to interact with stakeholders across US and EMEA time zones
* Compliance: Solid understanding of US GAAP and SOX controls related to the Order\-to\-Cash cycle


**Success Measures (The MongoDB Way)**
* In 1 Month: Fully onboard and master the unique nuances of established marketplace workflows and reporting cadences
* In 6 Months: Take complete ownership of the marketplace AR portfolio, achieving "Zero\-Variance" monthly reconciliations and reducing the aging profile
* In 12 Months: Serve as a global subject matter expert for marketplace expansion, advising on financial controls and scaling the India\-based team to support $5B\+ in revenue


**Why Join Us?**
* Impact: We value "Make it Matter." Your work directly influences our global cash flow and partner relationships
* Inclusion: Comprehensive health coverage, fertility assistance, and 20 weeks of fully\-paid gender\-neutral parental leave
* Growth: We are a "Build Together" culture. We invest in your development within our world\-class Gurugram Finance hub

We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**Digital Marketing and E\-Commerce Manager** 




  





**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana, India
 



**Experience:** 
 7\-10 years
 



  





**About the Company** 




 bioQuad Life Sciences is a biotechnology company that manufactures patented, clinically tested supplements built on Bio\-Replenishments®, bioactive molecules the body naturally produces to maintain homeostasis. Published clinical trials support the company’s claims, which is uncommon in this industry. We operate two brands: bioQuad® for people and Boneo Canine® for pets. Both brands sell in the US, Europe and the UAE through Amazon, direct\-to\-consumer Shopify stores, and professional and retail distribution channels. Our products are based on original scientific research and are designed to support the body’s natural systems of regulation, repair, renewal and balance. The company has a growing international presence across the US, Europe, the Middle East and India. We combine scientific rigour, product quality and commercial execution to develop next\-generation solutions for metabolic and broader systemic health. This role reports directly to the Founder and CEO and will help build the paid acquisition function that supports the next stage of growth.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This role takes charge of our paid advertising and makes it profitable. Amazon US is the priority. Both brands sell well there on their own, but the advertising has been left unmanaged by an outside agency. You will audit the accounts, present a rebuild plan, and then run the campaigns yourself. After Amazon US, you will launch Meta and Google, then paid traffic to our Shopify stores, and then assess Amazon UAE. None of these channels is currently running at full capability. You will work directly in the ad accounts, report to the Founder and CEO, and take responsibility for the numbers. The first ninety days are clear: audit the accounts, relaunch Amazon advertising on an approved structure, restore return on ad spend, and present a plan for the next channels. As the function grows, you will help set creative priorities, review agencies and take part in hiring additional digital team members.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Audit the existing Amazon US campaigns for both brands and present a written, costed rebuild plan before making changes.
* Create the campaign structure across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Display, with sound bidding, match types and negative keyword management.
* Restore return on ad spend to a profitable level and hold it, while ensuring budgets pace evenly through the day and remain within approved limits.
* Maintain account health and respond to policy notifications and listing suppressions within 24 hours. Improve titles, keywords, images and A\+ content before publication.
* Track inventory levels, restock timing and the causes of order cancellations so advertising does not create demand for products that cannot be supplied.
* Develop Meta and Google from dormant accounts into working campaigns across prospecting, retargeting, Search, Shopping and Performance Max, with tracking verified through GA4, Tag Manager and platform pixels.
* Strengthen the path from advertisement to completed Shopify checkout, identify conversion bottlenecks, and create and test campaign landing pages with the creative team.
* Submit a performance report every Monday, covering spend, revenue and return across all channels. Set creative and agency deliverables, verify reported figures, and escalate risks promptly.



  





**Essential Skills \& Technologies** 



* Amazon Seller Central, Amazon Advertising and Brand Registry, including Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Display, bidding, match types, negative keywords and account health.
* Meta Ads Manager and Business Manager, Google Ads, Google Search, Shopping and Performance Max, with the ability to launch and manage campaigns yourself.
* Google Analytics 4, Tag Manager, Search Console and platform pixels, including the ability to verify tracking and diagnose gaps in reported performance.
* Shopify administration and analytics, with practical experience improving product pages, landing pages, checkout conversion and the wider e\-commerce funnel.
* Strong command of return on ad spend, ACOS, TACOS, cost per acquisition, conversion rate, budget pacing, revenue forecasting and quarterly spend planning.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, with experience preparing weekly performance reports, forecasts, variance analysis and channel\-level decisions.
* Daily use of AI tools for research, ad copy, creative briefs, keyword analysis and reporting, alongside practical use of Helium 10, Jungle Scout or similar tools.



  





**Additional Plus** 



* Background in supplements, nutraceuticals, health or pet products, where product claims, customer education and compliance require care.
* Experience with Amazon UAE or European marketplaces, including the differences in demand, creative, timing and marketplace operations.
* Experience reviewing an external marketing agency, leading a small digital team, or managing advertising budgets substantially larger than the current spend.



  





**What You'll Bring** 



* Seven to ten years in performance marketing or e\-commerce growth, still working hands\-on in the advertising accounts.
* A revenue target you carried for a channel and met, with the ability to talk through the numbers and explain what drove the result.
* A channel you launched from nothing and made profitable, including the starting position, the actions taken and the timeline to profitability.
* Hands\-on command of Amazon Advertising and Seller Central. You must be able to diagnose and repair an underperforming account yourself.
* A track record of running Meta or Google advertising profitably for a direct\-to\-consumer brand, preferably in a Western market.
* The ability to prepare a quarterly spend and revenue forecast, not only optimize week to week.
* Fluency in return on ad spend, ACOS, TACOS, cost per acquisition and conversion rate, with the judgment to act when they move.
* Strong written and spoken English, sufficient for clear reporting to senior management. You use AI tools daily and are comfortable working directly with the Founder and CEO.
* You are commercially accountable, organized and willing to build the function rather than wait for a finished team, established process or fully managed account.



  





**Why Join Us** 



* You turn a channel around rather than maintain one. The result of your work is visible and attributable in revenue, return on ad spend and budget performance.
* You report directly to the Founder and CEO, with no layers between you and the decision. Strategy, budget and channel priorities are close to the person accountable for the business.
* The scope grows in a defined order: Amazon US first, then Meta and Google, then Shopify, then Amazon UAE. You will build the system as each channel comes online.
* You help shape and hire the digital team that follows you. This is an opportunity to establish how paid acquisition, creative testing, reporting and agency management are done.



  





**What We Offer** 



* A hands\-on role with direct responsibility for paid advertising across two international health and pet\-care brands.
* Direct reporting to the Founder and CEO, with clear ownership of channel performance, budget control, reporting and the ninety\-day delivery plan.
* A defined path to broaden the role from Amazon US into Meta, Google, Shopify, Amazon UAE and digital team building.
* Full\-time, in\-office work at HQ27, Sector 27, Gurugram, a Grade A building near IFFCO Chowk metro, with a food court and parking.
