title: Sr Manager - Decision Intelligence
description:
**Job Description**
**About Busuu**
 Busuu is one of the world's leading language\-learning platforms, part of Chegg. We help over 100 million learners build language skills that change their lives — through apps, web, and now an AI\-first product experience. We operate across consumer (B2C) and business (B2B/enterprise) markets in over 100 countries
   

  

**About Decision Intelligence**
 Decision Intelligence (DI) is the central capability that makes the business measurable, governed, and trusted. It spans data insights and analytics across the organization, operating through three layers: analytics partners embedded in business teams, a central hub that owns standards, metrics architecture, experimentation, and governance, and a platform layer (Data Engineering) that builds the infrastructure.
   

  

 DI does not govern business decisions — it governs the standards that make those decisions trustworthy and evidence\-based. We don't build dashboards on request; we build the foundations teams build on. We work hybrid with team members across India, the UK, and the EU.
   

  

**The Role**
 You are the operational backbone of Busuu's Decision Intelligence function. As Head of Decision Intelligence, you anchor business\-wide strategic intelligence, run the hub day\-to\-day, manage and develop analytics leaders as a player\-coach, and own the methodology behind Busuu's weekly business performance reporting and monthly leadership reviews.
   

  

 You operate as a player\-coach: you lead capability work in the hub, grow direct reports across the organization, and continue to contribute hands\-on to strategic analytics work. You partner with senior analytics stakeholders on metrics architecture and strategy, with the Director on hub direction, and with business leaders on analytics\-driven narratives.
   

  

 The role is the connective tissue of the function — turning measurement into operating decisions across the business. It is also a role with a clear trajectory: the right person grows into broader strategic leadership scope over time as the function scales.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Business\-wide strategic owner — anchor cross\-functional business narrative, deep\-dives, and performance readouts. Be the credible analytics voice in leadership forums and key business meetings.
* Player\-coach for direct reports — Develop 3\-4 analytics leaders on craft, level progression, and strategic partnership capability. Balance coaching and mentorship with your own hands\-on strategic analytics contributions.
* Weekly business performance reporting — design, narrative arc, and analytical integrity of weekly business performance summaries.
* Monthly leadership review architecture — partner with senior analytics stakeholders on monthly business review structure; you own the weekly\-to\-monthly narrative connection.
* Experimentation standards — co\-build testing rigor and best practices across the organization.
* Hub operations — day\-to\-day leadership of the analytics hub as the synthesis layer that makes cross\-functional signals usable for executive decisions.
* Metrics architecture co\-ownership — co\-own metrics definition and architecture with senior analytics partners.
* Business performance deep\-dives — cross\-functional lens, working with your team on methodology and insights.
* Strategic planning and forecasting — the senior analytics voice on business strategy, OKR setting, and opportunity sizing.


**Required**
**What We Are Looking For**
* 10\+ years experience in analytics, business intelligence, strategy, or consulting at meaningful scale — ideally with hands\-on analytical depth and people leadership combined.
* Demonstrated player\-coach experience — managing 3\+ analysts or data scientists while continuing to contribute as a senior individual contributor to strategic work. Comfortable in both leadership and hands\-on analytical work.
* Strong commercial instinct — you understand how analytics maps to business outcomes (revenue, retention, lifetime value, unit economics, conversion).
* Strategic narrative skill — you translate quantitative measurement into executive\-grade communication that drives decisions, not just describes them.
* Senior stakeholder influence — comfortable operating with Directors, VPs, and General Managers. Diplomatic but direct.
* Excellent SQL and fluency with BI tooling (Tableau, Looker, Metabase, or equivalent). Working knowledge of semantic\-layer thinking (dbt, Cube, LookML, or equivalent).
* Experience designing or owning a weekly business performance reporting cadence and a monthly business review architecture.
* Comfort working in a hybrid team across time zones — explicit overlap with London and EU as a known feature of the role.


**Preferred**
* B2C subscription \+ B2B SaaS exposure — comfortable thinking about both segments and weaving them together.
* EdTech context.
* AI and transformation measurement experience.
* Prior team\-building or hiring track record — bringing in talent, growing analysts, and building team\-level capability.
* Demonstrated growth trajectory — you've taken on expanded scope as you've delivered. The function is scaling; the right person will too.
* Familiarity with analytics operating models, data\-driven decision practices, or building analytics functions in fast\-moving environments.


**Competencies Expected at this Level**
* Strategic Thinking — plans strategy for team and projects (3\-9 month horizon); anticipates issues; plans for scalability; contributes to function\-level direction.
* Communication \& Leadership — tactical day\-to\-day team communication; conflict resolution; makes sound talent decisions (hires, performance, promotions); coaches and develops with compassion; fosters collaboration; influences senior stakeholders.
* Critical Thinking — prioritizes given impact and effort; identifies and asks tough questions; coaches reports on data\-driven decision\-making.
* Accountability — drives repeatable results at team and project level; provides clear ownership; knows when to escalate; fully committed to objectives.
* Analytics Architecture and Design — coaches team on measurement design; sets architectural standards; owns system\-level measurement conversations with key stakeholders.
* Cross\-functional Pattern Recognition — drives conversation across teams on shared patterns; coaches team members to identify and surface patterns; weaves signals into coherent narrative.


**How We Work**
 Decision Intelligence is deliberately small and high\-leverage. We are pragmatic about trade\-offs, opinionated about standards, and committed to evidence over opinion. The hub is the connective layer between business teams and Executive Leadership — and as Head of Decision Intelligence, you are the connective tissue of that layer.
   

  

 The function is scaling as part of broader business evolution at Busuu. The right person in this role will grow with it — expanding scope over time as the function matures.
   

  

 We work hybrid across India, the UK, and the EU. The role is India\-based with explicit time\-zone bridging with EU/UK.

title: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager - Brand & Engagement
description:
**💻 Position: Senior Enterprise Solutions Manager \- Brand \& Engagement** 




**📍Location: Delhi** 




**🗓️ Working Days: Monday to Friday** 




**📌 Experience Required: 4–7 years** 




  





**About the Role** 




 Own the
 **end\-to\-end implementation and growth of FMCG brand campaigns post\-sale** 
 — getting them live, setting up tooling/dashboards, handling SQL, legal/ops, and building solutions when standard processes don’t fit.
 



  





**The Role** 



* You own what happens after a brand signs — and part of what happens just before.
* You take a signed (or near\-signed) enterprise brand and stand up a working, measurable campaign: configuring internal tooling, building the demo/sandbox the brand evaluates, wiring up their analytics dashboards, and clearing the legal and operational steps between contract and go\-live.
* When the standard path doesn't fit a brand's ask, you design one. And you feed every recurring gap back to Product, so the next deployment is faster.
* This is a builder's seat, not a relationship\-management seat. You'll be measured on getting brands live, instrumented and expanding — not on meeting cadence.



  





**What You'll Do** 



* **Demos \& sandboxes:** 
 Build the demo environments and proof\-of\-concept setups brands evaluate, in coordination with the founding team.
* **Solutioning:** 
 Translate a brand's objective into a concrete campaign configuration. Invent workarounds when our defaults don't fit.
* **Customer setup:** 
 Configure and launch new enterprise customers in our internal tools. Own time\-to\-first\-live\-campaign.
* **Analytics:** 
 Stand up and maintain customer\-facing dashboards so every brand can see purchase intent and campaign outcomes without having to ask.
* **Cross\-functional coordination:** 
 Drive legal (MSAs, DPAs, brand \& procurement reviews) and operations (fulfilment, sampling logistics) to unblock go\-live.
* **Account outcomes:** 
 Own the ongoing result — accounts that stay live and grow because they're properly instrumented. Catch risk in the data before it surfaces at renewal, not after.
* **Product partnership:** 
 Surface recurring friction, scope it with Product, and help shape the tooling built specifically for this function.



  





**Requirements** 



* 4–7 years in solutions engineering, implementation / onboarding, technical account management, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS, martech or adtech company.
* Hands\-on data fluency. You build dashboards from raw data, not just read them — hands\-on SQL, plus a BI tool (Metabase, Looker, Power BI, Tableau).
* Ownership in ambiguity. You've run an implementation or a complex onboarding end\-to\-end, not just managed a relationship around one.
* Enterprise stakeholder management. You've sat across from brand / marketing, procurement and legal — ideally in or around FMCG / CPG brand teams or their agencies (WPP, Publicis, Mindshare, Dentsu).
* Communication. Sharp written and verbal; you can run a room of senior client stakeholders.

title: Sr Manager, Strategy & Operations
description:
The Trade Desk is a global technology company and the world’s leading independent platform for digital advertising, with over 3,000 employees across more than 30 offices. Our technology helps advertisers reach the right audiences across the open internet — from streaming TV and podcasts to mobile apps, news, and more.
   

  

 Advertising powers the content people love. By making it more transparent, effective, and responsible, we help support trusted journalism, quality entertainment, and creators worldwide. The world’s brands and agencies rely on us to reach their customers and grow their businesses responsibly.
   

  

 The scale of our platform brings unique technical challenges — from processing massive datasets in real time to building systems that operate reliably on a global scale. When you work here, your impact is worldwide. We welcome diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and build teams that learn from one another. If you’re driven to solve meaningful challenges, we’d love to meet you.
   

  

 The Trade Desk is helping shape the future of digital advertising, and APAC \& EMEA are the most dynamic places to build that future. As APAC \& EMEA Strategy \& Operations (S\&O) resets from ad\-hoc executor to strategic advisor, we are standing up two accountable pillars: RevOps \& Sales Enablement, and Systems \& XFN Enablement to give the region the scalable frameworks and operating discipline it needs for sustained double\-digit growth.
   

  

 We're looking for a hands\-on operator who thrives on turning systems and process chaos into trusted, self\-serve foundations, someone who is as comfortable rolling up their sleeves in Salesforce (or equivalent platforms) as they are coaching a country manager through change. If you're energised by fixing the plumbing so teams can focus on customers, this is where you'll do some of your best work.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Reporting into the APAC Director, Systems \& XFN Enablement, you'll own the execution layer that turns the region's systems foundation from a source of friction into a source of trust. Today, channel management activities (such as, mapping rework and change requests) pull Business Development \& Client Services managers and sellers off customers; you'll close that gap for good.
   

  

  

* Own Salesforce hygiene end\-to\-end, empowering Sales teams with tools for a frictionless \& efficient experience.
* Support systems transformation at regional and global level.
* Run change management and self\-serve training series with managers, including relationship methodology as well as 1:many governance cadences with the Salesforce champion community.
* Operate governance gates for rev\-group creation and maintain a clean audit trail, partnering with Finance, HR and Deal Desk.
* Support the Top Accounts process and outbound account management logic as part of the broader sales enablement agenda and contribute to the redesign of the Ops rhythm (Weekly Revenue Call, Quarterly \& Annual Planning).
* Track and report against success measures (mapping accuracy, backlog, adoption, meetings/FTE, training completion) to demonstrate ROI and free up selling time for GTM teams.
* Identify and build automation for standard workflows, processes and reporting, in partnership with engineering where needed.


**Who You Are**
* 8\-10 years in Sales Ops, Revenue Ops, Systems/Salesforce administration or Strategy, ideally in ad tech, SaaS or digital media.
* Deep, hands\-on Salesforce or CRM expertise (account/territory mapping, workflow rules, Portfolio Manager App or equivalent tooling); Tableau or Power BI experience is a strong plus.
* A track record of designing durable, self\-serve processes rather than one\-off fixes — you build the reusable rule, not just the one\-time exception.
* Comfortable running change management directly with frontline managers: training, governance cadences, and building trust that the new system works.
* Detail\-obsessed and data\-driven, with the judgement to know when a process needs to flex versus when to hold the governance line.
* A collaborative operator who partners naturally across Finance, HR, Deal Desk, Sales and Engineering to get things done.


**Why this role, why now**
 At TTD, values like Vision, Grit, Agility, Generosity, Openness, and Full\-Heartedness show up in how we work with one another every day. We're building a team that reflects the diversity of the markets we serve, and we warmly welcome people from all backgrounds who are excited to help shape what comes next.
   

  

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, The Trade Desk is committed to creating an inclusive hiring experience where everyone has the opportunity to thrive.
   

  

 Please reach out to us at accommodations@ thetradedesk. com to request an accommodation or discuss any accessibility needs you may require to access our Company Website or navigate any part of the hiring process.
   

  

 When you contact us, please include your preferred contact details and specify the nature of your accommodation request or questions. Any information you share will be handled confidentially and will not impact our hiring decisions.

title: E commerce Ads Specialist
description:

 Doctor’s Choice is a food brand focused on combining thoughtful nutrition with great taste, creating high\-protein, easy\-to\-prepare versions of everyday favorites. Founded by Ankit Jha and Nupur Jha, the company aims to support modern, health\-conscious lifestyles without asking people to give up the foods they enjoy. Its product range is designed for individuals seeking convenient, balanced nutrition that fits into busy routines. Every item reflects a commitment to accessible, satisfying better\-for\-you options, delivering both flavor and nourishment. Doctor’s Choice is building a smarter, more enjoyable way to eat well.

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Commerce, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience in e\-commerce advertising.
* Familiarity with nutrition, FMCG, or food brands is an advantage, along with a strong interest in health\-conscious consumer products.

title: AVP,  Data Architect (L11)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Data Architect (L11\)**
**Company Overview:** 
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards.
   

  

 The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Fortunately, advanced technology stands ready to automate and manage this constant torrent of information, ensuring smooth transactions around the clock, 365 days a year.
   

  

 Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. Join us to work on diverse projects, from fintech to data analytics, and contribute to shaping the future of technology. If you're passionate about engineering and innovation.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The AVP, Data Architect owns how data is sourced, modeled, governed, and delivered for analytic workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI solutions. The Data Architect will need to develop intimate knowledge of SYF key data domains (originations, loan activity, collection, etc.) and maintain a holistic view across SYF functions to design performant, resilient and cost\-effective data solutions.
   

  

 This role requires strong hands\-on experience for preparing data for AI data pipelines so agents can reliably access high\-quality, compliant information. The role partners closely with the data engineering team, AI Platform team, the data governance team, data science/analytics teams, and business stakeholder teams to define data architecture, standards, and operating models that enable scalable, secure, and cost\-effective analytics and AI workloads. This leader combines deep data architecture skills, strong understanding of different data model methodology, ETL pipelines, AI/LLM/RAG patterns.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Define logical, physical data model structure, integrate, govern, and store data in the enterprise repositories for supporting analytics/data science workloads, reporting/dashboarding and agentic AI workloads.
* Execute POCs and prototypes in sandbox and lab environments to propose solutions for AWS cloud workloads and AI solutions using data on AWS.
* Document data flow diagrams. Ensure discipline in the creation of Logical Data Models and their later implementation as Physical Data Structures.
* Define the target\-state Data \& AI Foundations architecture supporting agentic AI use cases, enterprise knowledge graph or metadata layer, data products, and AI\-ready datasets.
* Assist in developing the strategy and roadmap for making key enterprise data sources "AI\-ready": curation, quality, metadata, access patterns, latency requirements, and retention.
* Partner with source system owners (core servicing, CRM, collections, risk, fraud, etc.) to define data contracts, SLAs, and integration patterns that support downstream analytics.
* Establish data preparation and curation pipelines for model fine\-tuning, including dataset selection, labeling strategies, quality validation, versioning, and compliance with model risk policies.
* Define and enforce data governance policies for AI: data classification, lineage, access controls, PII handling, retention, and usage logging for AI workloads.
* Partner with AI Governance/Model Risk and InfoSec/AppSec to ensure data usage in prompts, context, and tools adheres to policies, including regulatory, privacy, and model risk requirements.
* Establish data quality and observability practices for AI data: data SLAs, freshness, completeness, drift detection, and business rule validation tied to AI outcomes.
* Drive adoption of metadata and catalog tools so platform and agent teams can discover, understand, and safely consume datasets.
* Define and oversee patterns for integrating external data (third\-party, public, partner data) into AI workflows, including licensing checks, quality assessment, and monitoring.
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned.


**Qualifications/Requirements**
* Minimum 6\+ years of experience across data engineering, data architecture, or analytics platforms, with at least 3\+ years in cloud data platforms and enterprise data leadership roles.
* Strong experience with modern cloud data stacks (e.g., data warehouses like Redshift/Snowflake/BigQuery, relational databases like PostgreSQL, and object storage) and their use in analytics and AI.
* Demonstrated expertise in enabling data readiness for agentic AI from existing data stores in front\-end (OLTP) applications or analytical (OLAP) applications like data lake and warehouses. Strong hands\-on experience on designing data models (star schema, 3NF) for raw, standardized and curated data products for optimal performance and scalability of data applications for AI.
* Strong hands\-on experience in generating semantic layers for the data products that serve multiple consuming applications on AWS.
* Proven experience building data pipelines for AI/ML use cases including ETL/ELT workflows, streaming data integration, and data preparation for model training and fine\-tuning.
* Strong experience with Lakehouse architecture using S3, Apache Iceberg, Glue Data Catalog, Redshift
* Strong Python skills for building data processing, evaluation, and automation pipelines, plus familiarity with DevOps practices (CI/CD, infrastructure as code, environment management).
* Good understanding of identity and data security architecture \- IAM, IAM Identity Center, cross account data access patterns, identity propagation for AI agents and services

title: Demand Generation Manager
description:
Working at Infobip means being part of something truly global. With 75\+ offices across six continents, we’re not just building technology — we’re shaping how more than 80% of the world connects and communicates.
   

  

 As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full\-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.
   

  

 We operate with an AI\-first mindset, embedding intelligent tools into our daily workflows to work smarter and more efficiently. Every role here benefits from and contributes to this approach.
   

  

 If you're looking for meaningful work and challenges that grow you in a culture where people show up with purpose, this is your opportunity.
   

  

 Let’s build what’s next, together.
   

  

 We are looking for a data\-driven, strategic, and hands\-on
 **Demand Generation Manager** 
 to lead our customer acquisition, pipeline generation, and account\-based marketing (ABM) strategies. In this role, you will own multi\-channel campaigns designed to create, capture, and convert qualified pipeline for our sales teams.
   

  

 You will bridge the gap between marketing execution and sales velocity, partnering directly with Revenue Operations, Account Executives, and SDR leads to accelerate funnel conversion and maximize lifetime target account value.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Campaign Strategy \& Execution: Design, build, and optimize multi\-channel inbound and outbound marketing campaigns across LinkedIn Ads, Google Search, content syndication, webinars, and automated email sequences.
* Account\-Based Marketing (ABM): Partner closely with sales leads to execute tailored ABM strategies targeting our Target Account List (TAL) to increase enterprise deal velocity and win rates.
* Sales \& SDR Alignment: Build tight hand\-off processes and SLAs with the sales team to ensure rapid lead follow\-up, high conversion rates, and continuous feedback loops on lead quality.
* Funnel Analytics \& Attribution: Track, analyze, and present performance metrics across every stage of the funnel (MQLs, SQLs, CAC, ROAS, sales pipeline generated, and closed\-won revenue).
* MarTech \& Automation: Manage and optimize our core marketing stack (CRM, Marketing Automation, ABM tools) for precise audience segmentation, automated nurture tracks, and lead scoring.
* Experimentation \& Optimization: Continuously test ad creative, landing pages, copy, and audience targeting to lower customer acquisition costs (CAC) while scaling pipeline volume.


**What We're Looking For**
* Experience: 8\-10 years of hands\-on demand generation or growth marketing experience in a B2B SaaS environment.
* Channel Mastery: Proven track record managing significant monthly paid acquisition budgets ($30k\+/month) with verifiable pipeline contribution.
* Tech Stack Proficiency: Strong operational experience with Salesforce/HubSpot, Marketo, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads/GA4, and ABM/sourcing tools (e.g., Demandbase, 6sense, Apollo).
* Sales\-Minded Alignment: Strong empathy for sales workflows with a clear understanding of enterprise sales cycles, deal stages, and ACV dynamics.
* Data\-Driven: Ability to extract actionable insights from raw performance data and communicate key metrics clearly to executive leadership.


**Why you'll love it here**
* Financial rewards \& recognition \- A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance\-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.
* Flexible work arrangements \- We combine in\-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere \- and not always between 9 and 5\.
* ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) \- As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.
* Work\-life balance and Well\-being  \- We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
* Career mobility \- Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.
* Professional development \- Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow \- no matter where you start.
* International mobility \- Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long\-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well\-being, and success \- wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection


**Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents.** 
 We’re proud to be an equal\-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.
   

  

 No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.

**Organizational Context**
**Key Aspects:**
* Part of the Aditya Birla Financial Service Group (ABFSG), Aditya Birla Housing Finance Limited (ABHFL) is registered with the National Housing Bank as a housing finance company under the National Housing Bank Act, 1987\. The company offers a complete range of housing finance solutions such as home loans, home improvement and home construction loans, balance transfer and top\-up loans, loans against property and construction finance. The company acquired its license on 9 th July 2014 and has aggressive growth plans
* ABHFL operates in the Rs. 11\.4 trillion Indian Housing Finance market, which has grown at a steady rate of 17% CAGR over the last 3 years while reporting good asset quality despite challenges in the operating environment. While the industry is dominated by five large groups, there has been an emergence of newer entrants in niche segments like affordable housing and self\-employed borrowers, given the high potential in these segments. Despite increased focus by banks, HFCs have been able to maintain their share in the mortgage market and has remained stable at \~37% as on December 2015
* The nature of the HFC business (dealing largely with retail customers in the potentially sensitive area of housing/ mortgages), along with the additional regulatory and control mechanisms imposed as a result, means it is imperative that all functions and processes align and comply with sound risk management guidelines and applicable regulations/ controls proactively and judiciously. This is vital for managing risk and protecting interests of both the business as well as the customer


**Job Context**
**Key Aspects:**
* The Risk team provides core underwriting services fundamental to the ABHFL business health, risk management and sustainability. Structured as a dual to the Sales/ Sourcing team, with positions mapped against corresponding Sales roles across the organization, the Risk team is responsible for necessary controls and process checks to ensure business performance and health
* While the core responsibility for this function is to control the business via robust underwriting and risk management, supporting business expansion via joint evaluation of different product/ market growth proposals with the Sales team is also an important contribution
* The Credit Manager plays the role of executing risk and credit operations in line with established guidelines and norms, and securing the organization against diverse risks in local business operations via process measures and checks. This role is responsible for ensuring robust and efficient creditworthiness and risk assessment. He/ She is the “ears on the ground” member of the Risk Team who meets every customer as part of the underwriting process and also visits the property which is being funded. Therefore, he/she needs to have an understanding of the Legal and Valuation framework to be able to perform their role satisfactorily


**Key Challenges**
* While the ABFL Mortgages team also works with retail customers in the property space, the ABHFL business is exposed to the additional Construction Risk, i.e. risk from under construction projects not getting completed as planned. The Risk Team must factor for this when designing and implementing control mechanisms, and evaluating business proposals
* ABHFL is in its inception phase as a company and in the midst of rapid growth. The Risk function must therefore be able to balance priorities of risk management and business growth efficiently, without increasing sub\-prime exposures or impacting business health and sustainability
* The housing space is characterized by state\-wise norms and business practices, as well as varied interpretations of regulatory guidelines by different stakeholders. It is therefore essential for Risk function team members to remain up to date on business practices/ norms in their respective states/ locations and work within regulatory guidelines in a manner that minimizes business risk and also supports growth objectives


****Enabling Skill Sets \& Qualifications****
* Critical skill sets required to meet these challenges include business and commercial acumen, analytical skills, interpersonal and presentation skills, and execution capabilities
* Education \& experience required to fulfil this profile are a CA/ MBA – Finance with minimum 0 – 3 yrs of experience in a bank/ NBFC/ HFC

 A. Systems adoption \& network design
 


* Drive end\-to\-end adoption of TMS across all distribution centers and the store network — from go\-live to full usage and reporting.
* Convert manual, DC\-by\-DC processes into system\-run processes, each with a measured before\-and\-after baseline.
* Own network design and periodic network review, with a planned, data\-led approach.
* Collaborate with IT and the SC Transformation Lead on the build, and assume ownership of field adoption, whereby IT delivers the build and this role secures usage.



 B. Control tower, MIS \& reporting
 


* Operate the control tower as the consolidated, authoritative source of operational KPIs across all DCs and lanes.
* Replace fragmented DC\-by\-DC reporting with one consolidated dashboard and MIS suite, published weekly.
* Own operational data quality and one\-version reporting on OTIF, order fill rate, dispatch accuracy, inventory health and cost.



 C. Early warning \& exception management
 


* Identify potential SLA breaches, stock\-out risk and service failures in advance — ideally seven days ahead — rather than after the resulting sales loss has occurred.
* Define escalation paths and drive closure of flagged exceptions with the DC Managers and Supply Planning.
* Replace manual indent follow\-up with system\-driven exception management.



 D. Service, inventory \& damage standards
 


* Set dispatch\-accuracy and perfect\-order standards for the network (in full, damage\-free, documentation right).
* Track inventory accuracy, ageing and perfect\-order fulfilment at line level across all DCs.
* Own damage and shrinkage norms and build recovery into the 3PL contract.



 E. Analytics \& decision support
 


* Provide the underlying data set — freight cost per case, cost versus MRE, vehicle fill and capacity utilization — on which the Capacity \& Sourcing and Cost Control leads base their decisions.
* Support network changes, carrier selection, lane\-rate and capex decisions with control\-tower analytics.
* Track and report the operational benefits delivered through systems adoption.



 F. Automation, AI \& continuous improvement
 


* Apply design\-thinking to examine every manual process through an automation and scale lens, uncovering opportunities to remove effort, error and cost.
* Use AI tools to ideate, create and implement automated workflows across planning, warehousing and distribution.
* Build and priorities a pipeline of automation opportunities and convert them into system\-run processes with measured before\-and\-after impact.



 G. Contingency \& festive readiness
 


* Build and maintain contingency plans for the distribution network — covering DC outages, transporter failures, and vehicle and labor shortages — to safeguard operational continuity.
* Own festive and peak\-season readiness across all DCs and lanes, including capacity ramp\-up, buffer\-stock positioning and surge\-lane planning ahead of demand spikes.
* Define fallback routing and alternate\-3PL arrangements, and run periodic business\-continuity drills, so that service levels are maintained during disruption.
* Coordinate escalation and recovery with DC Managers, Supply Planning and 3PL partners during peak and contingency events.



 Key Relationships
 



 Internal
 


* Head of Logistics \& Distribution (reporting manager); DC Managers; Capacity \& Sourcing Lead; Cost Control \& Budgeting (SC Finance).
* Supply Planning (inventory norms), National S\&OP, SC Transformation Lead and IT (systems build and adoption).



 External
 


* 3PL partners operating the distribution centers; TMS and WMS solution vendors; transporters.



 Qualifications \& Experience
 


* Graduate in Engineering, Supply Chain or Operations; MBA in Supply Chain, Operations or Analytics preferred.
* 3–7 years in supply chain or logistics, with strong exposure to WMS / TMS implementation and control\-tower or analytics roles.
* Proven record of driving systems adoption across a multi\-site distribution network; QSR, FMCG or retail\-distribution experience preferred.
* Hands\-on with SAP (VC / MM), TMS, WMS and BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.



 Skills \& Competencies
 


* Systems implementation with strong change\- and adoption\-management capability.
* Data analytics, dashboarding and MIS design, including the capability to establish a single, consistent version of reporting.
* Process re\-engineering — converting manual processes to system\-run, with baseline discipline.
* Stakeholder management across IT, Operations, Finance and 3PL partners.
* Control\-tower and exception\-management orientation, with an emphasis on early warning.
* Single\-point ownership and maker\-checker discipline across the function.
* Hands\-on use of AI tools to ideate, create and implement automated workflows.
* Design\-thinking mindset — views every manual process from an automation and scale perspective to uncover opportunities.

 Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!
   

  

**Global Business Services**
 Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
   

  

 Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
   

  

 In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non\-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
   

  

**Process Overview\***
 Global Finance was set up in 2007 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to Line of Business and Enterprise Finance functions. The capabilities hosted include Accounts Payable, General Accounting \& Reconciliations, Management Reporting \& Analysis, Research \& Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing, Finance Systems Support \& Regulatory reporting. Over the years, the scope of Global Finance has been expanded to include operations for other enterprise control functions like Human Resources and Risk and Compliance.
   

  

 The CFOC (CFO Change) team, which is part of the COO \& Governance organization within CFO division, delivers finance projects and technology solutions for the Bank of America (BAC) enterprise and also supports Line of Business (LOB) projects that impact our core finance and general ledger applications. The CFO Change team is responsible for overall program/project management, business analysis and requirements, functional design, testing, organization readiness and deployment activities.
   

  

**Job Description\***
 This role is for a Business Analyst resource responsible for documenting detailed business requirements in support of the FCPS delivery of programs/projects in the US, EMEA, APAC and LATAM regulatory reporting groups and general ledger operations. The resource will be responsible for (1\) understanding the Change, (2\) defining and documenting the current state (if applicable) and target state processes and (3\) ensuring collaboration with Technology teams \& Users until implementation of the Change. It requires working closely with the Business Lead/Product Owner, including upstream / downstream Stakeholders and Technology to ensure all aspects of the change are being considered and prioritized when documenting the requirements. The business requirements are the foundation for the design, build, test, operational / organizational readiness, and deployment activities in the life cycle of a project.
   

  

**Responsibilities\***
* Understanding the Regulatory Change and documenting detailed requirements. This includes functional capabilities, workflow needs, business rules, reporting requirements and timelines, etc. Collaborate with the Users \& procure all required sign offs.
* Identifying current state processes and the target state scope, objective and business outcomes of the Program/Project
* Identifying any data sourcing requirements, documenting them and coordinating with relevant Teams
* Understanding the in\-house GRIFFIN \& AXIOM design and documenting functional specifications in conjunction to the business requirements
* Creating high quality JIRAs documenting all critical aspects including business requirements, mapping requirements, acceptance criteria, etc using the BAC enterprise change management templates
* Create process maps or operating model where necessary.
* Walkthrough of the requirements to Technology and participating in the sprint planning along with the Project Manager.
* Collaborating with the test teams to clearly set the expectations from a Quality or User Acceptance Testing perspective.
* Regression before every code release into production.
* Facilitate review sessions with Business, Technology \& Testing Teams where relevant.


**Requirements\***
**Education\***
 Graduate degree in Commerce, Business or Technology.
   

  

 Certifications If Any \- AXIOM / Business Analysis etc.
   

  

**Experience Range\***
 7 to 10 years
   

  

**Foundational skills\***
* Experience as a Functional Business Analyst in technology implementation projects, having written Business requirement documents (BRDs)
* Extremely strong Knowledge of EMEA regulatory reports (COREP, Finrep, AnaCredit, ESG etc..) and Strong knowledge of financial concepts
* Ability to understand complex business processes and breakdown to process components.
* Demonstrate ability to work in a fast\-paced, every\-changing, highly collaborative environment.
* Strong knowledge of creating process maps
* Strong relationship management and interpersonal skills, ability to build strong rapport, respect and trust with key stakeholders and constituents.
* Professional written and verbal communication skills
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to identify/raise questions, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, and good with numbers
* Proficient with Microsoft Office products (particularly MS Excel, Word, Visio, PowerPoint)


**Desired Skills**
* Exposure to projects in Financial Accounting and reporting (in Financial Control / Product Control/Treasury), and/or in Risk Regulatory reporting (Market or Counterparty risk) in financial services industry
* Expertise in Axiom Regulatory platform (if possible, AXIOM certified)
* Knowledge of Banking and Capital market products
* Understanding of automation tools like Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI
* Knowledge/ Experience with Copilot/ Other AI tools usage in day\-to\-day BAU processes
* SQL, Database knowledge \& ability to analyze data and related flows
* Knowledge of Agile methodology and tools (i.e., JIRA)


**Work Timings\***
 11:30 am to 8:30 pm
   

  

**Job Location\***
 Gurugram/Mumbai

title: Growth Manager - Enterprise Growth (Digital Commerce)
description:
**Company Overview** 




  





 GobbleCube is an agentic growth operating system designed to help brands scale profitably across digital marketplaces. Founded in November 2022 by the ex\- core team of Blinkit, the platform went live commercially from private beta in September 2024\.
 



  





 Since then, GobbleCube has scaled rapidly, supporting 600\+ brands across enterprise and D2C, growing revenue 10X, and onboarding 45 of India’s largest CPG enterprises in just the last 9 months, including HUL, Nivea, Tata Consumer Products, ITC, Godrej, Beiersdorf, MTR, L’Oréal, Hershey’s, and many more.
 



  





 As commerce becomes more distributed and hyperlocal, GobbleCube is building agentic solutions to help brands navigate complexity in real time, across visibility, performance marketing, supply chain, and growth strategy. Headquartered in Gurugram, the company supports brands across India, MENA, and LATAM.
 



  





**About the role** 




 India's largest CPG brands do business worth hundreds of crores every year on Quick Commerce platforms. They lose share for reasons invisible from a 360 dashboard: a dark\-store availability gap, a competitor outbidding them on a category keyword, a discount ladder that buys volume at the cost of contribution margin.
 



 GobbleCube finds those reasons. Your job is to walk into the brand's boardroom, tell the CXO what is happening, recommend what to do about it, and get a room of senior people who might disagree to commit to a decision.
 



  





**What this role is not** 




 This is not a marketing growth role. No funnel, no CAC, no acquisition budget, and no performance campaigns to run. If you are a growth marketer, this isn't the job you want.
 



 This is also not a traditional Customer Success role. You are not measured on tickets closed, QBR decks delivered, or logins. Nobody here will ask you to "drive adoption."
 



 The closest analogue is what an MBB consultant does for a CPG client, except you do it under a productised strategic consulting environment, for India's largest CPG brands at once, with a product doing the work in the background.
 



  





**What you will actually do** 



* Run regular strategic connects (online and in\-person both) with each account's senior leadership. Not a status update. A point of view on their business, and recommendations backed by data, to drive their business objectives.
* Diagnose why an output metric moved: market share, offtake, margin, etc. Decompose it into availability, visibility, discounting and supply chain. Then decide what is worth acting on.
* Take a difficult position to a senior stakeholder and make it land. Frequently the recommendation is "stop doing the thing that makes your number this month."
* Build the quarterly impact story: problem identified, action recommended, outcome achieved, revenue or share impact, in the brand's own numbers.
* Find the next business problem worth solving, prove it in a pilot, and convert it into expansion revenue.
* Turn what worked on one account into a repeatable SOP or a product requirement, so the ninth account does not need a ninth person.



  





**Who you will be in the room with** 




 CMOs, Sales Heads, E\-commerce Heads, Supply Chain Heads, occasionally CFOs. They are senior, have limited face time, and each of them wants something different from the same budget. Their KAMs and brand managers are your day\-to\-day.
 



  





**What makes this different from consulting** 




 The dogwork is automated. RCA, data pulls, anomaly detection, competitive tracking, and most of the analysis run through the product and agentic workflows in the backend. You are deciding what the analysis means, what to recommend (the right action at the right time), and how to get it approved. That is also the bar. When the analysis is free, the analysis is not the value. Your judgement is.
 



  





**How you will be measured** 



* Net revenue retention across your portfolio. Zero downsell, plus expansion.
* A documented, quantified impact story per account per quarter.
* Pilot\-to\-conversion rate on expansion modules.
* Qualified expansion opportunities briefed to GTM with a written business case.
* No account goes Amber without you flagging it first.
* Strategic connect coverage and conversation quality across your book.



  





**You will do well here if** 



* You can hold your position when a senior stakeholder tells you your data is wrong, without either backing down or repeating "the data says so."
* You are comfortable being the least senior person in the room and still owning the recommendation.
* You end conversations with an owner, a decision, a metric and a review date, rather than with an action\-items list.
* You would rather be right in eight weeks than agreeable today.



  





**You will struggle here if** 



* You need a clean brief before you can start.
* You want analysis to be your main contribution.
* Confrontation with senior stakeholders drains you.



  





**Requirements** 



* Bachelor's or Master's from a Tier 1 institute (IIT, IIM, ISB and equivalent).
* 3\-7 years in management consulting, strategy and ops, growth, or enterprise customer success at a B2B SaaS company. Consumer or retail exposure is a strong plus.
* Structured problem\-solving you can demonstrate live, not just describe.
* Presentation and stakeholder management skills at CXO level.
* Strong Excel. Enough SQL to interrogate an analysis and find the hole in it.

title: CRM & Business Systems Architect
description:
Company Description
 
  





 E\-Waste Recyclers India (EWRI) is one of India’s established e\-waste recycling and IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) companies, with nearly 18 years of industry experience. As a women\-led, R2v3\-certified organization, EWRI provides secure, compliant, and sustainable technology lifecycle solutions across India.
 



 EWRI serves 5,000\+ clients, including global enterprises, OEMs, institutions, government organizations, and international ITAD and recycling partners requiring execution across India.
 



 With 50,000\+ MT of combined processing capacity, our capabilities span ITAD, secure data sanitization and destruction, data center decommissioning, refurbishment and reuse, asset recovery and remarketing, e\-waste recycling, plastics recovery, and battery recycling.
 



 As EWRI continues to scale, we are investing in technology\-driven traceability, automation, operational visibility, and customer reporting across the entire IT asset disposition process.
 


 About the Role
 
  





 EWRI is looking for an experienced
 **CRM \& Business Systems Architect** 
 to help us design the digital foundation for our next stage of growth.
 



 This is a business\-process and solution\-architecture role. We have
 **not pre\-selected a CRM or technology platform** 
 . The successful candidate will work directly with management and internal teams to understand how our business operates, map current and future requirements, evaluate suitable technology platforms, and recommend the right architecture for EWRI.
 



 The initial focus will be designing and implementing a scalable CRM covering sales, customer relationships, business development, international partnerships, direct outreach, asset sourcing, and auction opportunities.
 



 The system will subsequently need to integrate with or expand into ITAD project management, pickups and logistics, asset tracking, data security, inventory, refurbishment, remarketing, recycling, reporting, field operations, and customer\-facing portals.
 



 The objective is to create a connected business operating platform rather than implement a standalone CRM.
 


 Key Responsibilities
 
  




* Work directly with management and internal teams to understand, map, and document existing business processes.
* Conduct structured requirements\-gathering sessions across sales, operations, logistics, finance, warehouse, ITAD, and management teams.
* Map current\-state workflows and design scalable future\-state processes.
* Identify inefficiencies, manual processes, duplicated data, and opportunities for automation.
* Define the functional and technical requirements for EWRI's CRM.
* Design workflows for accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, direct outreach, quotations, follow\-ups, approvals, partner management, and customer relationships.
* Design requirements for international ITAD partner development and onboarding.
* Design workflows for direct asset sourcing, supplier opportunities, inventory offers, and auction tracking.
* Evaluate suitable CRM, ERP, low\-code, and business application platforms based on EWRI's requirements.
* Compare platforms based on functionality, scalability, customization, integration capabilities, security, user experience, implementation complexity, and total cost of ownership.
* Recommend the appropriate technology stack and implementation architecture.
* Design the integration between CRM and future ITAD operational systems.
* Define data structures, workflows, automation rules, user roles, permissions, audit trails, dashboards, and reporting requirements.
* Develop detailed functional specifications and implementation documentation.
* Work closely with developers and/or implementation partners during development.
* Review development to ensure the system aligns with approved business processes and architecture.
* Lead or support UAT, deployment planning, employee training, and user adoption.
* Establish a long\-term roadmap for extending the platform into ITAD operations and other business functions.


 Future System Scope
 
  





 The architecture should be capable of supporting future modules including:
 


* ITAD project and site management
* Pickup and logistics management
* Asset and serial\-number tracking
* Data sanitization and destruction
* Field technician/mobile workflows
* Chain\-of\-custody tracking
* Exception management
* Automated reports and certificates
* Warehouse and inventory management
* Refurbishment and grading
* Asset recovery and remarketing
* Recycling and downstream tracking
* Customer and international partner portals
* Financial reconciliation and project profitability
* Management dashboards and business intelligence


 Required Skills \& Experience
 
  




* CRM and/or ERP solution architecture
* Business process mapping and process redesign
* Requirements gathering and functional specification
* CRM implementation and configuration
* Data architecture and workflow design
* Business process automation
* API and third\-party integrations
* User roles, permissions, security, and governance
* Reporting, dashboards, and business intelligence
* UAT, deployment, and user adoption
* Experience working directly with business users and senior management
* Experience taking business applications from discovery through implementation



 Experience with multiple platforms such as
 **Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Power Platform, Salesforce, Odoo, Zoho, HubSpot, SAP, or similar enterprise business systems** 
 will be highly valued.
 



 The candidate should be capable of evaluating technologies objectively rather than being dependent on a single platform.
 


 What We're Looking For
 
  





 We are looking for someone who thinks
 **business process first and software second** 
 .
 



 The successful candidate should be comfortable sitting with our teams and observing how work actually happens — from a customer enquiry or outbound approach through quotation, project execution, asset processing, reporting, and commercial closure.
 



 We want someone capable of asking the right questions, challenging inefficient processes, identifying what should and should not be automated, and translating the resulting requirements into a scalable system architecture.
 



 The ideal candidate has previously been involved in the complete lifecycle:
 



**Business Discovery → Process Mapping → Requirements Gathering → Platform Evaluation → Solution Architecture → Implementation → Testing/UAT → Deployment → User Adoption → Continuous Improvement** 




**Experience: 3\+ years preferred.** 



 Initial Assignment
 
  





 The first phase will be to:
 


1. Understand and document EWRI's existing processes.
2. Define our future\-state workflows.
3. Develop detailed CRM requirements.
4. Evaluate suitable technology platforms.
5. Recommend the appropriate platform and architecture.
6. Define implementation costs, resources, risks, and timeline.
7. Develop a phased implementation roadmap.
8. Support the implementation of the selected solution.



 This is an opportunity to help design a business operating platform from the ground up and play a key role in EWRI's long\-term digital transformation as we scale our ITAD, refurbishment, recycling, and technology lifecycle operations across India and internationally.

title: Client Services and Administration
description:
Company Description
 



 Synergetic Communication Inc. is a debt collection agency focused on combining a customer\-centric approach with advanced technology to achieve effective delinquent account recovery. The company emphasizes innovation, using modern tools and streamlined processes to improve efficiency, transparency, and communication. Its compliance\-driven operations aim to foster trust and satisfaction among both clients and consumers. Team members are expected to balance strong results with respectful, empathetic interactions. Synergetic Communication Inc. is committed to redefining industry standards by aligning technology, communication, and positive consumer experiences.
 



  





 Role Description
 



 We are expanding our Client Services and Administration team with multiple full\-time, on\-site openings based in Gurugram, India. This team is the operational and compliance backbone of the business, supporting consumer interactions, data integrity, training delivery, quality assurance, audit readiness, and platform uptime. Candidates are encouraged to apply once and indicate in their application which function best matches their experience; we will consider applicants across all openings.
 



  





 Open Functions
 



  





 Consumer Disputes \- Research, document, and resolve consumer disputes end to end. Review account histories, gather supporting documentation, prepare written responses within regulatory timeframes, and escalate issues that require compliance or legal review.
 



  





 Data Entry \- Accurately enter, validate, and maintain account and consumer records across internal platforms. Reconcile incoming client files, correct data discrepancies, and maintain the record quality that downstream reporting and compliance depend on.
 



  





 Learning Management System Admin (LMS) \- Administer the company learning platform: build and publish courses, manage user accounts and permissions, assign and track required compliance training, troubleshoot learner issues, and report on completion rates and certification status.
 



  





 Quality Call Scoring \- Monitor and score recorded consumer calls against quality and compliance scorecards. Document findings, identify coaching opportunities and trends, and partner with operations leadership to raise consistency across the floor.
 



  





 Internal Audit Testwork \- Execute internal audit test procedures across operational and compliance controls. Pull and review samples, document evidence and exceptions, prepare clear workpapers, and support remediation tracking through to closure.
 



  





 System Monitoring Admin \- Monitor production systems, dialer platforms, and scheduled processes for availability and errors. Track alerts, run daily health checks, log and escalate incidents, and maintain monitoring documentation and shift handoff notes.
 



  





 Qualifications
 


* Strong written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to document work clearly and professionally.
* Solid computer proficiency, including Microsoft Excel and Word, and comfort learning new business platforms quickly.
* High attention to detail and accuracy when working with records, documentation, and consumer data.
* Ability to follow defined procedures, meet deadlines, and work within a regulated, compliance\-focused environment.
* Sound judgment in handling confidential and sensitive consumer information.
* Ability to work on\-site in Gurugram, India, on assigned shifts, and to collaborate with operations, compliance, and management teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in BPO, collections, financial services, customer service, quality assurance, audit, or systems administration is an advantage.
* Function\-specific experience is preferred but not required: dispute handling or complaints for Consumer Disputes; high\-volume data processing for Data Entry; LMS or training coordination for LMS Admin; QA scorecards or call monitoring for Quality Call Scoring; audit or controls testing for Internal Audit Testwork; monitoring tools, ticketing, or basic SQL for System Monitoring Admin.



 Please indicate your preferred function or functions in your application.

title: Monitoring Evaluation Accountability Learning (MEAL) Specialist
description:
**Organizational Setting**
 The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) contributes to the achievement of the 2030 Agenda through the FAO Strategic Framework by supporting the transformation to more efficient, inclusive, resilient and sustainable agrifood systems, for better production, better nutrition, a better environment and a better life, leaving no one behind.
   

  

 FAO is a specialized agency of the UN that leads international efforts to defeat hunger. FAO's goal is to achieve food security for all and ensure that people have regular access to enough high\-quality food to lead active, healthy lives. With 195 Members (194 countries and the European Union), FAO works in over 130 countries worldwide.
   

  

 The Global Environment Facility (GEF) has approved the Government of India's GEF\-7 project “Promotion of Sustainable Food Systems in India through Transforming Rice\-Wheat Systems in Punjab, Haryana, Odisha and Chhattisgarh” (GCP/IND/184/GFF), part of the GEF\-7 Food Systems, Land Use and Restoration (FOLUR) Impact Programme. The project objective is to promote sustainable, integrated landscapes and efficient food value and supply chains at scale in rice\- and wheat\-based food systems in India. It works across two contrasting agro\-ecological contexts: the intensive rice\-wheat systems of the Indo\-Gangetic Plain in Punjab and Haryana, and the biodiversity\-rich, forested rice\-growing landscapes of Chhattisgarh and Odisha.
   

  

 The project is organized around four components: (1\) integration of cross\-sector sustainability provisions into food systems and planning frameworks, (2\) enhanced capacities for climate\-smart food production practices and responsibly sourced commodity value chains, (3\) landscape management and restoration to sustain food systems and deliver global environmental benefits, and (4\) knowledge management to guide policies and maximize impacts. The Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare (MoA\&FW) is the Project Executing Entity/Operational Partner, and the project is implemented through a National Project Management Unit (NPMU) at the national level and State Project Management Units (SPMUs) in each of the four target states, under the oversight of the National and State Project Steering Committees.
   

  

 The position is located in the FAO Country Office in India, within the project's NPMU.
   

  

**Reporting Lines**
 Under the overall supervision of the FAO Representative in India, the direct technical guidance of the National Technical Coordinator, and in coordination with the FAO Lead Technical Officer (LTO), .
   

  

**Technical Focus**
 The M\&E Specialist will perform qualitative and quantitative analysis of data collected by the NPMU, SPMUs and Operational Partners to report on project results. Monitoring and Evaluation (M\&E) of agriculture and food systems, and natural resource management projects.
   

  

**Tasks And Responsibilities**
 The incumbent will undertake the following duties:
   

  

* Based on the project's Results Framework and Theory of Change, develop and refine SMART indicators to track regular progress at output, outcome and objective levels, and define other monitoring and evaluation requirements at national and state levels of project implementation.
* Lead preparation of a detailed, fully budgeted Monitoring and Evaluation (M\&E) Plan for the project, defining data collection methods, frequency, responsibilities for data collection/analysis and means of verification for each indicator.
* Coordinate with MIS unit to identify and use appropriate indicators that capture the progress of the project in different states.
* Perform qualitative and quantitative analysis of data collected by the project team to report project results, including inputs to the annual Project Implementation Report (PIR), Narrative Progress Reports (NPRs) and Technical Reports.
* Coordinate the tracking, updating and reporting of GEF\-7 Core Indicators, Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) indicators and Land Degradation Neutrality (LDN) indicators, at project mid\-term and closure, in line with FOLUR Impact Programme requirements.
* Review and discuss assessment, evaluation and monitoring results with FAO, the National Technical Coordinator, MoA\&FW and state\-level Operational Partners (SPMUs) and recommend corrective/adaptive management action.
* Support training of NPMU, SPMU and District Project Implementation Unit (DPIU) staff and partners on the project's Results Framework, M\&E system and reporting requirements.
* Develop methodologies and protocols for project M\&E, and support the Operational Partner in defining methodologies, timelines and quality assurance for the project's monitoring framework.
* Provide technical support for the design and Terms of Reference of impact evaluations, thematic studies and process\-monitoring studies, work with third\-party agencies/consultants engaged to oversee periodic evaluations, and review study reports and provide comments.
* Prepare the technical design document for the project's mid\-term review (MTR) and terminal evaluation (TE), in coordination with the National Technical Coordinator (NTC), Budget Holder (BH) and Lead Technical Officer (LTO).
* Elaborate, and support the periodic review and updating of, the project's Results Framework and Theory of Change, making recommendations to adapt these to project needs and to fill missing baseline information.
* Coordinate with the MEAL and Communications Expert(s) at SPMU level and with the project MIS to ensure consistent, harmonized data collection, reporting and knowledge management across the four target states.
* Support Operational Partners in preparing State and National Annual Work Plans and Budgets (AWP/B) that are clearly linked to Results Framework indicators.
* Participate in team meetings, briefings and Project Steering Committee meetings to present M\&E findings and conceptualize/propose approaches for assessing project impact and process indicators, both quantitative and qualitative.
* Contribute to addressing cross\-cutting issues such as gender, Indigenous Peoples' engagement and knowledge/communication planning, including ensuring gender\-disaggregated data collection within the M\&E system.
* Provide M\&E related advice and support to other thematic units in the project NPMU


**CANDIDATES WILL BE ASSESSED AGAINST THE FOLLOWING**
**Minimum Requirements**
* Master’s degree in agriculture, Economics, Statistics, Rural Development, Development Studies, Environmental Sciences, or a related field.
* At least 8 years of progressively responsible professional experience in monitoring and evaluation and/or results\-based management of natural resource management, agriculture, rural development, climate change, sustainable food systems or related development projects.
* Working knowledge (Level C) of English
* National of India or resident of the country with a valid work permit.


**FAO Core Competencies**
* Results Focus
* Teamwork
* Communication
* Building Effective Relationships
* Knowledge Sharing and Continuous Improvement


**Technical Skills And Competencies**
* Knowledge and demonstrated experience in project cycle management and results\-based MEAL, including Results Frameworks/logframes, Theories of Change, indicator development, target setting and results monitoring.
* Demonstrated knowledge of monitoring and evaluation methodologies and tools, including quantitative and qualitative data collection, data analysis, outcome monitoring, participatory approaches and data quality assurance.
* Familiarity with GEF monitoring and evaluation requirements, including GEF Core Indicators and Project Implementation Report (PIR) requirements.
* Experience in developing and operationalizing M\&E/MEAL plans, indicator protocols, data collection tools relating to Community Based Natural Resource Management (CBNRM) and agriculture/food systems, means of verification and data quality assurance mechanisms for development projects.
* Ability to analyse and interpret monitoring data and translate evidence into practical recommendations for adaptive management, project performance improvement and learning.
* Experience working with or in international non\-governmental organizations and donor organizations (UN agencies, World Bank, IFAD, Asian Development Bank, etc.) implementing participatory projects.
* Good data management, analytical, visualization and report\-writing skills, with the ability to present results clearly to technical teams, government counterparts and senior management.
* Familiarity with the agro\-ecological and socio\-economic context of Punjab, Haryana, Odisha and/or Chhattisgarh is an asset.


**Selection criteria**
* Full proficiency in English and Hindi is desirable, working knowledge of Punjabi, Odia or other languages spoken in the target states is an asset.
* Experience working with government agencies and multilateral/donor\-funded development projects will be an advantage.


**Additional Information**
* FAO does not charge a fee at any stage of the recruitment process (application, interview meeting, processing)
* Applications received after the closing date will not be accepted
* Please note that FAO only considers higher educational qualifications obtained from an institution accredited/recognized in the World Higher Education Database (WHED), a list updated by the International Association of Universities (IAU) / United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO). The list can be accessed at http://www.whed.net/
* For additional employment opportunities visit the FAO employment website: http://www.fao.org/employment/home/en/
* Appointment will be subject to certification that the candidate is medically fit for appointment, accreditation, any residency or visa requirements, and security clearances.

* Develop and execute liquidation plans for
 **slow\-moving, non\-moving, obsolete and excess inventory** 
 .
* Define SKU\-wise liquidation priorities based on ageing, value, demand and margin.
* Monitor inventory turnover and ensure continuous stock movement.
* Develop mechanisms to prevent inventory from becoming stagnant.



  




 2\. Data \& Inventory Analytics
 * Analyse
 **inventory ageing, stock holding, sell\-through, inventory turnover, sales velocity and SKU performance** 
 .
* Prepare regular MIS and dashboards for inventory movement and liquidation.
* Identify dead stock and excess inventory through data\-driven analysis.
* Analyse customer purchase patterns and historical sales to identify potential buyers for specific inventory.
* Track liquidation value, recovery value, discount impact and margin realization.



  




 3\. Customer \& Market Development
 * Build and maintain a strong network of
 **distributors, dealers, retailers, workshops and other trade customers** 
 .
* Proactively approach customers for specific slow\-moving or excess SKUs.
* Map available inventory against customer demand and market requirements.
* Develop alternate sales channels for products with low regular movement.
* Maintain strong market intelligence on pricing, demand and competitor activity.



  




 4\. Pricing \& Discount Management
 * Design
 **SKU\-wise/customer\-wise discount structures** 
 for inventory liquidation.
* Determine appropriate discount levels based on stock ageing, purchase cost, market price and expected recovery.
* Balance liquidation speed with
 **gross margin and contribution margin** 
 .
* Develop promotional/bulk\-buying offers for ageing inventory.
* Monitor the impact of discounts on inventory recovery and profitability.



  




 5\. Commercial \& Working Capital Management
 * Focus on reducing
 **working capital blocked in inventory** 
 .
* Monitor inventory value versus sales velocity.
* Identify opportunities to convert dormant inventory into cash.
* Coordinate with Finance, Sales, Purchase and Warehouse teams for liquidation decisions.
* Recommend purchase controls based on inventory performance and demand trends.



  




 6\. Process \& Control
 * Establish SKU\-level inventory movement targets.
* Create ageing buckets and liquidation action plans.
* Set up regular review mechanisms for
 **30/60/90/120\+ day inventory** 
 .
* Develop escalation processes for high\-value and long\-ageing inventory.
* Maintain accurate records of liquidation activities, pricing approvals and customer conversions.



  




 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
 * Inventory Turnover Ratio
* Reduction in 90\+/120\+ day ageing inventory
* Slow \& Non\-Moving Inventory Reduction
* Inventory Liquidation Value
* Inventory Recovery %
* Stock\-to\-Sales Ratio
* Gross Margin / Contribution Margin
* Discount vs. Recovery Analysis
* Working Capital Released
* SKU Sell\-Through Rate
* Reduction in Dead Stock



  




 Candidate Profile

 in inventory liquidation, inventory management, commercial operations, sales or stock optimization.
* **Mandatory experience in Auto Spare Parts \& Accessories industry.**
* Strong understanding of
 **automotive spare parts, accessories, brands, applications and aftermarket distribution** 
 .
* Strong customer and market network in the automotive aftermarket.
* Hands\-on experience with
 **inventory ageing and liquidation strategies** 
 .
* Strong knowledge of pricing, discounting, margins and commercial negotiations.
* Advanced Excel/MIS and strong data interpretation skills.
* Experience working with
 **ERP/inventory management systems** 
 .
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to work independently and take commercially sound decisions.



  




 Ideal Candidate
 
 The ideal candidate is someone who understands that
 **inventory is not an asset if it is not moving** 
 . The person should be commercially strong, highly data\-driven and well connected with the automotive aftermarket, with the ability to convert
 **ageing and excess inventory into sales and cash while protecting margins** 
 .
