title: Assistant Project Coordinator- (Research)/Senior Researcher - Delhi
description:
Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research) / Senior Researcher
 



 Indian Police Foundation \| Internal Police Reforms Project
 



  





 Organisation: Indian Police Foundation
 



 Project: Internal Police Reforms Project
 



 Location: Indian Police Foundation HQ, New Delhi (C\-8, 8758, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi \- 110070\)
 



 Number of Positions: 1
 



 Tenure: Contractual. Offered initially for 1 year but extendable till the completion of the project (2027\-2028\).
 



 Remuneration: Rs. 75,000 per month (Assistant Project Coordinator \- Research) / Rs. 60,000 per month (Senior Researcher), including Rs. 5,000 as transport allowance.
 



 Last date to apply: 5 October 2026, till 4:00 PM only.
 



  





 OVERVIEW
 



  





 Applications are invited for the position of Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher on a contractual basis.
 



  





 Candidates possessing a minimum of 3 years or more of relevant experience will be considered for the position of Assistant Project Coordinator (Research). However, candidates shortlisted with less than 3 years of relevant experience will be considered for the position of Senior Researcher.
 



  





 Although the position is in Delhi, the APC\- Research/Senior Researcher is expected to travel to various (3 states) both for research as well as project implementation and monitoring.
 



  





 ABOUT THE ROLE
 



  





 The role of the Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher involves coordinating both the research and operational components of the Internal Police Reforms Project. Working closely with the Project Director (PD), Project Coordinator (PC), and State Supervisors, the he/she will play a key role in project planning, research, implementation, coordination, monitoring, and documentation across three states (Punjab, Telangana \& Tamil Nadu).
 



  





 ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS
 



  





 \- Educational Qualification: M.A in Social Sciences/Police Sciences/Criminology/Public Safety or any other related field. However, candidates with Ph.D. in relevant domains will be preferred.
 



 \- Researcher/Consultant with experience of 3 years or more in social research in universities, other research institutes, NGOs, think tanks, or consulting firms. (Minimum experience may be relaxed in exceptional cases at the discretion of the Project Director).
 



 \- Experience in Independent Research Study Design and leading/mentoring research team.
 



 \- Proficiency \& experience in developing and conducting Baseline, Midline and Endline evaluation study.
 



 \- Proficiency in Research Tool Development for empirical data collection.
 



 \- Proficiency in mixed\-data \- quantitative and qualitative \- analysis \& and knowledge of quantitative data analysis software (advance excel, SPSS/STATA).
 



 \- Ability to understand and communicate the meaning of field\-based data and writing research report.
 



 \- Strong management, coordination and leadership skills for engagement with senior police officers, trainers, research staff and other research institutions.
 



 \- High level of proficiency in computer skills.
 



 \- Willingness and good health to undertake field visits (as and when required).
 



 \- Good command over English and Hindi.
 



 \- Attend the IPF office at Vasant Kunj, Delhi, on a regular basis.
 



  





 DESIRABLE
 



  





 \- Previous experience of working with Police organisations.
 



 \- Familiarity with criminal laws (major \& minor).
 



 \- Familiarity with relevant Supreme Court judgments \& NHRC directives.
 



 \- Familiarity with MHA and State Government circulars related to citizen centric policing.
 



 \- Familiarity with recommendations of various police commissions, including the National Police Commission (1979\-81\), related to citizen centric policing.
 



 \- Publications of Research papers/articles in various journals/magazines/Newspapers.
 



  





 ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 1\. Research and Data Analysis
 



  





 \- Head the research team, provide guidance to Research Associates both in Headquarters \& States, and monitor their work.
 



 \- Guide Research Associates in data analysis for various stakeholders for both quantitative and qualitative data collected through three tools (structured questionnaires, FGDs, and in\-depth interviews).
 



 \- Coordinate with and visit the external agencies engaged for data analysis \& report writing (Centre for Economic \& Social Studies, Hyderabad \& Centre for Good Governance, Hyderabad).
 



 \- Guide and Supervise Research Associates in desk research, including analysis of reports of the National Police Commission and other committees on police reforms.
 



 \- Formulation of Reports to State DGP on Public Grievances in 3 states based on data analysis.
 



  





 2\. Formulation of Change Manual
 



  





 \- Assist in the Formulation of Change Manual \& its action plan for all the 3 states based on the Project Focus areas, namely improving Compliant / FIR Registration and Police Response, improving Citizen Services and Community Engagement, prevention of Harassment by Police, and improving Police Conduct and Behaviour.
 



 \- Presentation of Change Manual to the respective state DGPs in 3 States.
 



  





 3\. Baseline and Endline Evaluation
 



  





 \- Work on evaluation parameters, selection of police stations for evaluation, training of field enumerators, and ensure that the data required by the agency for conducting baseline and endline evaluations is provided in a timely manner.
 



 \- Guide in the formulation of Data Collection Tools by evaluation agencies.
 



 \- Support and monitor the execution of Baseline and Endline evaluations by independent agency in selected police stations across Punjab, Telangana, and Tamil Nadu.
 



 \- Review and scrutinize the reports prepared by the evaluation agencies.
 



  





 4\. Engagement with Experts
 



  





 Assist the Project Director and Project Coordinator in engaging with Experts for vetting and finalization of the following activities:
 



  





 \- Finalization of Research Methodology
 



 \- Evaluation Parameters for (Baseline and Endline Evaluation)
 



 \- Change Manual prepared for all 3 states
 



 \- Baseline \& Endline Reports prepared by Evaluation agencies
 



 \- Final Project report (combined report for all 3 States)
 



  





 5\. Training
 



  





 \- Assist in the preparation of state\-specific training manual \& training materials.
 



 \- Support and participate in the conduct of training programmes for police office in all 3 states.
 



  





 6\. Project Implementation and Monitoring
 



  





 \- Support monitoring of project implementation across 90 police stations in three states, including field visits to selected police stations on quarterly basis.
 



  





 7\. Coordination
 



  





 Ensuring smooth communication, information exchange and prompt follow up with:
 



  





 \- All state project monitoring units (State Supervisor \& Research Associates in 3 states)
 



 \- External agencies engaged in data analysis (CESS, Hyderabad \& CGG, Hyderabad)
 



 \- Evaluation Agencies for Baseline \& Endline Evaluation in 3 states
 



 \- Donor Agency
 



  





 8\. Documentation and Reporting
 



  





 \- Documentation of Best Practice Visit reports submitted by the Project Coordinator, State Supervisors \& Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher (himself).
 



 \- Formulation of Reports to the Donor Agency as and when required.
 



 \- Preparation of the Final Project Report, based on Public consultation meetings, Change Manual, baseline and endline evaluation reports from the respective states and monthly reports from respective State Supervisors.
 



  





 9\. Miscellaneous
 



  





 \- Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research)/Senior Researcher will report to the Project Director and Project Coordinator.
 



 \- In\-addition to the above\-mentioned job chart, the Project Director \& Project Coordinator may assign any other project related tasks from time to time.
 



  





 SALARY AND OTHER SERVICE CONDITIONS
 



  





 \- Assistant Project Coordinator \- (Research): Rs. 75,000 per month (including Rs. 5,000 as transport allowance)
 



 \- Senior Researcher: Rs. 60,000 per month (including Rs. 5,000 as transport allowance)
 



 \- The selected candidate will have to give the undertaking in the form of the bond to serve for minimum period of one year.
 



 \- Economy\-class airfare for visits to various States and UTs
 



 \- Accommodation in police guest houses (or will be reimbursed as per IPF policy).
 



 \- Other service conditions will be governed by IPF HR and other policies
 



  





 SELECTION PROCESS
 



  





 Selection will be based on a written examination and an interview (if you clear the written exam) to be held on 15th \& 16th October 2026 at IPF HQ New Delhi.
 



  





 HOW TO APPLY
 



  





 Please visit https://www.policefoundationindia.org/careers for detailed guidelines.
 



  





 \- Download the application form and fill it out electronically, along with updated CV in PDF format \& send them to us at recruitment.tpfi@gmail.com
 



 \- For queries, write to recruitment.tpfi@gmail.com or contact 9625878853 (Admin Officer) \& 9910224876 (Project Coordinator).
 



 \- Last date for online submission of applications: 5th October 2026 till 4:00 PM only.

title: Content Analyst
description:
**About AlphaSense**
 The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision\-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.
   

  

 The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI\-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S\&P 500\. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!
   

  

**The Role**
 Content Analyst will work with our Content team to expand AlphaSense’s content offering and support the needs of our clients. You will work together with a team of: product managers, content analysts, software engineers, and content vendors. Tasks will include: identifying and onboarding new content, configuring automatic content ingestion processes, and monitoring content quality. Content sets include public company presentations, news, regulatory, trade journals, publications, and other content available via the web.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have: strong written and verbal communication skills; prior content onboarding and support experience; solid analytical skills; web research; and troubleshooting skills.
   

  

**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Research \& Analysis: Discover new sources of content available on the web to augment our content offering, and additionally evaluate web sources to be onboarded. Strategize and assist in creating frameworks of operation to optimally achieve project goals.
* Content Onboarding \& Maintenance: Review content processing alerts. Verify and upload company presentations and other content from company, regulatory, and other websites. Configure new web scraping jobs via an admin interface. Maintain existing scraping jobs, adjusting configuration as needed to ensure quality content ingestion. Define requirements for quality reports and execute quality reports.
* Troubleshooting Content Issues : Bring new ideas and concepts forward to develop innovative and effective ways of troubleshooting content issues.
* Content Support: As a subject matter expert, you will be responsible for 3rd level support, addressing content\-related inquiries. Escalate to internal teams and externally to content providers when necessary, raise tickets, and track issues. Coordinate with engineering teams, product managers, and content providers regularly.
* Coordinate with content providers : Proactively follow up with content providers and internal teams in order to resolve issues in a timely manner. Keep the stakeholders/requestors up to date on their reported issues.
* Content Flow Monitoring \& Reporting : Track processing state, generate content usage reports, and maintain logs of content requests (e.g., via Productboard or similar tools).
* Documentation : Create, update, and document content onboarding processes.
* Quality Assurance and Quality Control: review documents for property categorization and tagging across our processing pipeline of content


**Candidate Requirements**
* Outstanding oral and written communication skills
* 0\-4 years of data entry and/or data maintenance experience.
* A high aptitude and willingness to learn. Because of our diverse base of clients, much of the technical knowledge required to succeed will be learned on the job
* Knowledge of MS Office, Google Suite and basic technical knowledge
* Superior Excel Skills
* Ability to distill and explain complex issues in simple terms
* Energetic and creative individual, possessing natural curiosity with the ability to learn quickly and adapt
* Effective time management and task prioritization when under pressure
* Ability and interest to work independently.
* Must be able to work a late shift to support the U.S. revenue team.
* Bachelor’s Degree.
* Experience with financial information / data and analyst workflows


**Optional/Strong Plus Qualifications**
* Experience managing content aggregation processes
* Experience processing documents published by companies (presentations, filings, press releases, transcripts)
* Experience configuring web crawl jobs (structured or unstructured data sets)

 Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25\-year\-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. **Position Overview**
 The Supply Chain Digitalization Analyst supports the execution of the Supply Chain Digitalization strategy by maintaining high\-quality Supply Chain data and delivering advanced analytics, insights, and Power BI solutions. Working under the direction of the SC Digitalization Manager, the role helps ensure data is structured, consistent, governed, and usable across systems to support operational performance, planning, service, inventory, working capital, and cost optimization. The Analyst also supports the lifecycle management of dashboards and analytical tools aligned with global Supply Chain priorities.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Resolve data inconsistencies through root cause analysis and sustainable fixes, while supporting Data Governance standards, definitions, documentation, and issue escalation.
* Analytics Solution Development, Data Modeling \& Digital Tools: Translate Supply Chain requirements into data models, semantic models, Power BI dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions aligned with data strategy and architecture. Partner with stakeholders to support Power BI builds and scalable analytics solutions using tools such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, and Power Platform / PowerApps, where applicable.

Manage refresh validation, issue resolution, enhancements, documentation, user support, KPI alignment, and report consolidation, while driving automation and standardization to improve scalability and consistency.
* Advanced Analytics, Data\-Driven Insights \& Supply Chain Optimization: Develop advanced analytics and network optimization models using complex Supply Chain data to improve operational performance, planning, service, inventory, working capital, cost, and risk management. Partner with internal Supply Chain and cross\-functional teams gather data, maintain accurate baseline network models, evaluate customer shipping points, and assess strategic network opportunities, including greenfield locations and point\-of\-manufacturing options. * Operates as a continuous learner, proactively asking questions, challenges status quo and makes recommendations for improvement. Analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent presentation, verbal, and written communication skills to communicate effectively at all levels.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Working with or in the Supply Chain function
* Previous use of Supply Chain Guru / Llamasoft, or comparable Network Modeling software
* Experience supporting greenfield, brownfield, and existing network optimization analyses.

* See your job as ending at a report — here the goal is often a working algorithmic product, not just a recommendation
* Consider your job done once a dashboard ships — you need to keep watching it and flag when something breaks



  





**Skills Required:** 




  





**Must\-Have** 



* D2C / E\-commerce Background: hands\-on experience in a D2C, quick\-commerce, or high\-velocity consumer business — this is non\-negotiable, since it's what lets you understand the complexity of our systems from day one
* Supply Chain \& Logistics Analytics: reasoning about how orders should be allocated across fulfilment and logistics partners, and how a fulfilment network should evolve as the business scales
* COD \& RTO Risk Analysis: analysing order and delivery patterns to flag fraud and RTO risk
* Data Modelling \& SQL: comfortable querying and modelling on a warehouse (Redshift or similar) to build data cuts for multiple functions
* Algorithmic Product Thinking: able to scope and prototype rule\-based or lightweight algorithmic tools that automate a decision (allocation, routing, cancellation prediction) rather than just reporting on it
* Customer Support Ops Analytics: building scorecards for support quality/efficiency and identifying automation opportunities, including voice agent/IVR use cases
* Vendor Performance Analytics: analysing vendor\-level data (fill rate, quality, lead time, cost) to help procurement decide when to de\-risk away from a vendor or push for more utilization from one
* Structured Project \& Impact Tracking: taking a finding from problem statement and baseline through to a tracked project with a target KPI, and validating after the fact whether it actually moved the number
* Analytics Tools: Excel/Google Sheets for modelling and a BI tool (Metabase/Power BI) for reporting
* AI\-Assisted Building: using LLMs and vibe coding tools to prototype logistics and CS intelligence tools quickly



  





**Good to Have** 



* Python for scripting data pulls, automations, or lightweight algorithmic prototypes
* Prior exposure to COD/RTO fraud protection systems
* Familiarity with WMS/OMS platforms or courier aggregators
* Exposure to voice agent/IVR or CS automation platforms
* Basic optimization or linear\-programming concepts for allocation/inventory problems



  





**What will you do?** 




**Fulfilment \& Logistics Allocation Intelligence** 



* Build data\-driven logic for how orders should be allocated across fulfilment locations and courier partners
* Assess how the fulfilment network should evolve as order volumes and geographies grow, and where new locations would help
* This kind of business case — going from a raw operational question to a data\-backed algorithm that runs the decision — is representative of the business cases and product algorithms you'll own end to end in this role



**Inventory Optimization** 



* Build models to project stock requirements at the fulfilment\-location level across the network
* Minimize stockouts and overstock by improving how inventory is positioned across locations



**COD \& RTO Fraud Protection** 



* Analyse COD order patterns to identify at\-risk pin codes, customers, and order profiles
* Build and monitor fraud/risk scoring systems that flag orders before dispatch



**Vendor Intelligence for Procurement** 



* Analyse vendor\-level performance — fill rate, quality, lead time, cost — to give procurement a clear, data\-backed view of each vendor
* Help procurement decide when to de\-risk away from a vendor versus when to push for greater utilization from one



**Customer Support Intelligence** 



* Build scorecards for CS quality and efficiency across support channels
* Identify automation opportunities, including voice agents, and monitor cancellation drivers and reduction levers



**AI \& Algorithmic Products for Supply Chain** 



* Partner with product and engineering to scope and prototype algorithmic tools that automate fulfilment, routing, and cancellation\-related decisions
* Push prototypes from spreadsheet logic to production\-ready tools where the impact justifies it



**Own Supply Chain \& Ops Reporting** 



* Be the single go\-to person for all supply chain and operations reporting — fulfilment, logistics, warehouse, inventory, and CS metrics
* Build and maintain the dashboards and MIS that warehouse, logistics, CS, and production teams rely on day\-to\-day
* Make sure every function has one consistent, trusted source of truth for its numbers instead of everyone pulling their own



**Proactive Monitoring \& Early\-Warning** 



* Closely monitor supply chain and ops KPIs so you're the first to know when something breaks — a fulfilment delay, a courier SLA slip, a spike in cancellations or RTO
* Build early\-warning indicators that catch a problem before it snowballs into a stakeholder escalation
* Flag anomalies proactively and get the right team looking at it immediately, rather than waiting to be asked



**Track Projects Through to Impact** 



* For every recommendation you drive, define the baseline, target KPI, owner, and timeline upfront
* Follow through post\-implementation to confirm whether the change actually moved the metric, not just that it shipped
* Maintain visibility of open supply chain and ops projects — status, risk, and expected versus actual impact



**Cross\-Functional Data Cuts** 



* Act as the single source of intelligence for warehouse, logistics, CS, production, and procurement teams
* Give each function the right data cuts, dashboards, and recommendations to act on



**Reporting \& Stakeholder Communication** 



* Present supply chain health, fraud trends, vendor risk, and automation impact to founders and functional heads
* Translate complex operational data into clear, actionable narratives



  





**Work Experience:** 




 3–5 years of experience, with a D2C/e\-commerce background required
 



  





**Working days:** 




 Monday – Friday
 



  





**Location:** 




 Golf Course Ext. Road, Gurugram, Haryana (Work from Office)
 



  





**Perks:** 




 • Friendly atmosphere
 



 • High learning \& personal growth opportunity
 



 • Flexible timings
 



 • Diverse work environment

 We believe in an open, intellectually honest culture where everyone is given the autonomy to contribute and do their life's best work. As part of the dynamic team at Nutrabay, you will have a chance to learn new things, solve new problems, build your competence, and be a part of an innovative marketing\-and\-tech startup that's revolutionising the health industry.
 



 Working with Nutrabay can be fun and a place of unique growth opportunities. Here you will learn how to maximise the potential of your available resources. You will get the opportunity to do work that helps you master a variety of transferable skills, or skills that are relevant across roles and departments. You will feel appreciated and valued for the work you deliver. We are creating a unique company culture that embodies respect and honesty, which will create more loyal employees than a company that simply shells out cash. We trust our employees and their voice and ask for their opinions on important business issues.

 Nutrabay is the largest health \& nutrition store in India.  We have built a complex and high\-converting eCommerce system, and our monthly traffic has grown to a million. We are looking to build a visionary and agile team to help fuel our growth and contribute to further advancing the continuously evolving product.

title: Senior Analyst Media
description:
What’s up?
 **We’re VaynerMedia!** 
 VaynerMedia is a global integrated creative and media agency, built for today's consumers. As the Modern Agency of Record, it understands the nuances of today's attention landscape,
   

  

 empowering brands to win attention, drive relevance, and deliver business results. Founded in 2009, by Gary Vaynerchuk, the independently owned agency operates in 15 offices worldwide, including Amsterdam, Bangkok, Chicago, New Delhi, Kuala Lumpur, London, Los Angeles, Mexico City, Miami, New York, Tokyo, Toronto, Singapore, and Sydney. VaynerMedia is part of the VaynerX family of companies
   

  

**Culture is our key and Empathy is how we build it.** 
 VaynerMediaAPAC is strong with a world\-class combination of diverse backgrounds collaborating to put forward innovative, creative and strategic solutions to the one advantage that stands the test of time \-\-\- PEOPLE. Day in and day out, we propel some of the biggest brands in the world to the intersection of attention and culture. In APAC, we are proudly \+200, servicing a diverse client all around the region.

 We day\-trade consumer attention, guiding our diverse clientele to focus on the platforms that command the attention of their specific customers. The Performance Marketing \& Analytics team plays a critical role in helping our internal teams and clients understand where attention is and how that is translating to impact on the business by creating data structures \& hierarchies, automated dashboards \& visualizations, integrating paid \& organic social listening data, and helping to build bespoke measurement solutions for our clients.
   

  

 We’re currently on the lookout for a team player who is a critical thinker, upbeat, and hungry to learn. You're someone who's driven to constantly look for better ways to do things and excited at the prospect of working in a constantly evolving industry with far more "unknown" than "known", and love playing a leadership role on a team that shares your drive to always continue learning.
   

  

**THE TASK AT HAND**
* Analyze campaign and customer data to provide conclusions, implications, and actionable recommendations designed to improve the quality of future relationship marketing communications.

* Partner with creative, content, media, and account teams to evaluate and optimize integrated paid and organic social media campaigns.
* Support performance measurement and reporting across social media platforms including Meta, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X.
* Leverage social listening, trend analysis, audience insights, and content performance data to identify opportunities for campaign optimization and business growth.


**PEOPLE WHO THRIVE IN THIS ROLE ALSO POSSESS:**
* 3 years of relevant experience in Media Analytics, Digital Marketing Analytics, Social Media Analytics, or Performance Marketing (Google, Meta and Publisher Campaigns).
* Result\-oriented with the ability to work within strict time constraints while balancing multiple projects.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact at all levels of the organization.
* A collaborative teammate with the knack to pivot in a constantly evolving environment.
* Knowledge of a variety of measurement methodologies and their applications.
* Passionate about research, television, marketing, emerging media, and technology.
* Strong PowerPoint/Excel and Google Slide/Sheet skills.
* Experience with one or more media platforms including Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, Tumblr, YouTube, DCM, DV360, The Trade Desk.
* Experience with SQL, Tableau.
* Strong understanding of Organic and Paid Social Media Management across platforms such as Meta, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and X.
* Experience in Social Media Strategy, Planning, Content Amplification, and Digital Marketing Campaign Optimization.
* Hands\-on experience with Google Ads Planning and Execution, including Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max, and Remarketing campaigns.
* Experience in audience targeting, performance tracking, campaign measurement, and reporting, particularly within Meta and other digital advertising platforms.
* Strong ability to analyze content performance, generate actionable insights, and translate findings into optimization recommendations.
* Experience with Social Listening, Community Management, and Trend Identification to support campaign and content strategies.
* Understanding of the synergy between organic and paid media channels and their role in maximizing campaign effectiveness and business outcomes.
* Strong Client Servicing and Stakeholder Management skills with the ability to independently manage client conversations and present strategic recommendations.
* Ability to develop integrated social media and measurement strategies while collaborating closely with creative, content, media, and analytics teams.
* Query and analyze complex data sets to develop actionable insights that enable the optimization of media and content.
* Analyze and correlate media campaign performance with audience data, including identification of high\-impact KPIs for tactics with a focus on audience engagement, campaign effectiveness, fan growth and content deep dives.


**What You Should Know About VaynerMedia**
 Think “lab” and not “agency”. We get excited about solving business problems, not creating advertising for the sake of making advertising. Our entrepreneurship DNA runs deep. We’re willing to break rules, try new things, and test hypotheses if it means better understanding our craft. It’s fun!

 **We can’t wait to meet you.**

description:

**Job Description \- Analyst \- D2C Merchandising** 




  





**You should apply if you have:** 



* A sharp analytical mind combined with a genuine feel for on\-site consumer experience — you notice when a layout, widget, or page just doesn't convert, and you can prove why with data
* Strong grounding in A/B testing methodology — designing hypotheses, sizing tests, and reading results correctly rather than eyeballing conversion bumps
* Comfort blending qualitative and quantitative research — you can watch session recordings on tools like Hotjar/Clarity and run user interviews, and translate what you see into a testable hypothesis
* Fluency with product/funnel analytics — you can dig into event\-level data to find exactly where the funnel is leaking and size the opportunity to fix it
* An ownership mindset over the D2C storefront as a whole — you think of every widget, PDP section, sale page, and search result as real estate to be optimized, not just decorated
* An AI\-first workflow — you use LLMs and vibe coding tools to prototype page changes, synthesize research, and move faster than a traditional analyst would
* Stakeholder management ability — you can take a merchandizing recommendation to the product and design teams and defend it with evidence



**You should not apply if you:** 



* Are looking to run merchandising operations day\-to\-day (inventory, pricing, catalog ops) — this is an analysis and optimization role, not a merch\-ops role
* Need a long ramp time — we expect you to understand our D2C storefront and start proposing tests within weeks
* Treat a page redesign or a new widget as the finish line rather than the start of a measurement cycle
* Are uncomfortable making a judgment call on a page layout without a perfectly clean dataset behind it

* Product/Funnel Analytics: using event\-based analytics tools to identify exactly where the funnel is leaking and quantify the opportunity
* Qualitative Research: running and synthesizing session recordings and user interviews into actionable findings
* Merchandizing \& Storefront Analytics: reasoning about widget placement, PDP structure, sale page architecture, and on\-site search/discovery

* Build and maintain a prioritized backlog of testing hypotheses



**Drive Consumer Insights** 



* Watch and synthesize session recordings on Hotjar/Clarity to uncover on\-site friction points

* Convert qualitative signals into testable hypotheses and merchandizing recommendations

* Use product analytics tools to trace the funnel step by step and pinpoint where users drop off

* Partner with product on instrumentation gaps when the data needed isn't already tracked



**Plan On\-Site Promotions \& Campaigns** 



* Plan how sale pages, campaign pages, and promotional widgets should look and be sequenced across the site
* Coordinate timing and placement of on\-site promotions with the marketing calendar



**Optimize PDPs and On\-Site Search** 



* Identify PDP\-level improvements — content, trust signals, cross\-sell, review placement — and validate them with data

title: Demand Planner
description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.
   

  

 Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25\-year\-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
   

  

 While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia\-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Demand Planner executes the demand forecasting strategy for a low\-volume and low complexity portfolio, accountable for \<$500\+ million of annual sales revenue. This role requires analytical mastery and proven experience with statistical modeling. The Demand Planner also requires strong communication skills and the ability to explain complex algorithms to cross\-functional business partners. The position helps support the monthly Pre\-Commercial Review/Consensus process within the IBP framework by owning the baseline statistical forecast. This role also supports Product Life Cycle management through supply chain forecasting, error detection and resolution. By providing accurate baseline forecasts and reducing forecast bias, this position enables McCormick to deliver predictable financial results and ensure cost, service and working capital goals are met.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Maintains historical baseline data and trends, determines best\-fit statistical models for each SKU, and cleanses historical data to remove anomalies where applicable.
* Tracks and maintains demand KPIs (Forecast Accuracy and Forecast Bias) to determine appropriate root cause corrective action next steps.
* Communication of downstream impacts of material plan changes (short\-term).
* Forecast Value\-Add (FVA) analysis and implementation
* Trouble shoots large, complex system problems with IT and GBS; develops forecast scenarios with assumptions.
* Support role in IBP and S\&OE processes (Pre\-PCR, PCR and PSRs)


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, or related field of study.
* 4 years \+ of planning experience with a strong understanding of demand planning processes.
* Experience in (statistical) forecasting and knowledge of Demand Planning systems and complex algorithms.
* SAP, MS\-Office tools, ERP packages and other relevant IT systems knowledge with focus on planning and forecasting.
* CPG Experience preferred.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Excellent time management and prioritization skills.
* Excellent attention to detail.
* Curiosity (experience diagnosing RCCA).
* Excellent analytical skills.
* Ability to analyze complex and disparate data sources down to incorporate key insights.
* Proven problem\-solving and critical thinking skills.
* Proficiency with MS Excel, Power Point, Word, ERP (ex: SAP), ECC, APO, IBP and forecasting tools required.


 At McCormick, we have over a 100\-year legacy based on our “Power of People” principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value

title: Fraud Manager

**About you** 





**Formal Education** 




 • Bachelor's and/ or master's degree in technology, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
   

 • Oracle HCM Cloud certification(s) advantageous.
 



**Work Experience** 




 • 3\+ years' experience working with Oracle HCM / Fusion.
   

 • In\-depth experience with Oracle HCM modules including Core HR, Talent, Performance, Goals, Recruitment, Onboarding and Compensation \& Benefits.

**Technical Skills** 




 • Strong domain knowledge of HR, Payroll, Time \& Attendance and Talent management processes is a must

 • Confident troubleshooting skills, able to diagnose and resolve issues efficiently within a ticketing environment.
   

 • Understanding of system integrations (e.g., middleware, third\-party HR platforms) and data governance principles.
   

 • Able to translate business requirements into practical, scalable system solutions.

 • Comfortable working with stakeholders across Mining Operations, HR, Payroll, IT, Finance and business leadership in different regions and time zones.
   

 • Strong understanding of HR processes and associated workflows.
 




**What's on offer**

 • 3\+ years of experience in B2C Lead Generation, Performance Marketing or a closely related growth role.

 The Program Officer – MEL will play a key role in translating field data and digital insights into clear, actionable evidence that strengthens program delivery across Protsahan’s work.

 The Program Officer – MEL will ensure that Protsahan’s program data is collected systematically and on a regular basis, maintained with high levels of accuracy, and regularly analysed to generate actionable insights for program improvement and organisational learning. The role will work closely with program teams to monitor implementation, identify gaps, track outcomes, and surface emerging trends. The role will also involve working with diverse data sources including digital applications, social media platforms, and large datasets to identify patterns and strengthen evidence\-based decision\-making. Strong data analytics skills, including knowledge of BigQuery, SQL, dashboards, data extraction and management, and social and digital media trends, will be a significant advantage.

**Monitoring Programs**
* Implement monitoring and evaluation plans, formats, tools, and reporting systems across Protsahan programs and partners.
* Ensure program data is collected systematically and regularly.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and up\-to\-date program data.
* Conduct regular field visits and data verification checks to confirm reported data reflects on\-ground program implementation.
* Work with field teams to strengthen their understanding and use of monitoring data that is accurate, complete, and meaningful.


**Data Management \& Analysis**
* Collect and analyse quantitative and qualitative primary and secondary data, including data generated through monitoring, assessments, and evaluations.

* Identify patterns, trends, gaps, emerging issues, and insights from the data to inform program decisions.

* Maintain and improve AI\-enabled learning tools, such as chatbots or digital assistants, that reinforce training and support frontline staff with day\-to\-day protocol questions.

**Knowledge Management**

title: Manager Impact, India and Southeast Asia
company: The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet
description:
The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) The Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet (Global Energy Alliance) works for a world where everyone has access to affordable, reliable, clean electricity and the means to use it to improve their lives. Our Alliance builds transformative public, private, philanthropic partnerships to end energy poverty and accelerate green economic opportunity. Founded in 2021 by The Rockefeller Foundation, IKEA Foundation, and Bezos Earth Fund, we design innovative projects/programs, unlock finance, strengthen institutions and transform markets, delivering progress anchored in deep community engagement. By uniting actors across the value chain, from households to heads of state, we go beyond individual projects to drive lasting systems change. With work in more than 30 countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, our Alliance aims to reach 1 billion people with clean electricity, prevent 4 billion tons of carbon emissions and create or improve 150 million jobs.
   

  

**Contract type: Fulltime, Open ended**
**Reports Directly To**
 Direct Reports:
   

  

**Matrix/Dual Reports**
 Chief Impact Officer
   

  

 None
   

  

 VP, India; MD, Grids of the Future
   

  

**Overview Of The Role**
 Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet’s goals are bold and audacious. We recognize that the path to a just energy transition worldwide will be complex, non\-linear, and filled with successes and opportunities, alongside failures and challenges. The Manager, Impact, India and Southeast Asia will support our effort to measure our contribution to impact through evaluations, monitoring and learning. Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL) is embedded within our operating model, to ensure that we have an ear to the ground so we remain responsive and opportunistic, while generating insights that support continuous improvement.
   

  

 Stepping into a start\-up environment, the Manager, Impact, India and Southeast Asia will lead monitoring, evaluation and learning for the India and Southeast Asia portfolio, guided by the organization’s Impact framework. They will also lead impact measurement for the Grids of the Future pillar across all regions, and provide monitoring and analytics support across the global portfolio. They will be responsible for independently establishing the routine and long\-term work component of these workstreams, ensuring that they are efficiently managed and executed.
   

  

**Accountabilities** 
  

  

* 
+ Monitoring: Providing backend impact data quality assurance for all India and Southeast Asia transactions. Provide technical advice on target setting, indicators, theory of change mechanisms, causality links for the India and Southeast Asia portfolio. Onboard and train program teams on results monitoring sheets – ensuring compliance. They will also support the monitoring function across the global portfolio, including data compilation, quality checks and analytics for quarterly impact reporting, working alongside the Alliance’s external monitoring and learning partner.
+ Grids of the Future impact: Leading impact measurement for the Grids of the Future pillar across all regions. Developing and maintaining expected\-impact estimates for utility partnerships, grid digitalization, battery energy storage and distributed energy resource programs, working with program teams and external modelling partners. Tracking realized impact against expected impact as programs move through the pipeline, and designing evaluations of utility\-level outcomes such as reliability, losses and effects on consumers.
+ Evaluation: Sourcing and managing independent evaluation partners working closely with the Director of Evaluation. Establishing the pulse on what needs evaluation and when by closely working with the India and Southeast Asia and Grids of the Future teams in sourcing evaluation questions. Selecting fit for purpose evaluation approaches and tools and sense checking their design and functionality.
+ Learning: Support the team in designing and managing ongoing reflection, sense\-making, and learning from the work to inform potential shifts in strategy when necessary, using data and evidence to rationalize change.
+ Capacity building: Onboarding, training and operationalizing Impact functions in country teams, solution teams and hiring monitoring evaluation and learning consultants. Ensuring that all requirements per the Impact framework are met in the investment cycle for all India and Southeast Asia programs.
+ Systems integration: Ensuring the internal Global Energy Alliance systems tracking progress on program implementation, financial execution and impact measuring are integrating, working in close collaboration with the IT systems manager, the management teams for country programs and scalable solutions and the Investment team.
+ Advisory function: Advising global Impact colleagues and external technical providers by ground truthing India and Southeast Asia portfolio realities.


**BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES**
**Preferred Attributes**
* Working in Partnership: Learning with, learning from, and learning for our partners, particularly those who are closest to the work on the ground. Balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders and working in partnership wherever possible.
* Directs Work: Being strategic with efforts and generating information that informs decision making and improves impact. Providing direction and removing obstacles to get work done.

title: Fintech Fraud & Risk Analytics Engineer
description:
**Location:** 
 Gurgaon / Remote (Hybrid / Flexible Work Policy)
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Experience Required:** 
 3–5 Years
   

  

**Industry\-Standard Salary Range:** 
 18 LPA – 32 LPA
   

  

**About Us \& Our Mission**
 In the fast\-paced ecosystem of digital B2B fintech settlement rails and cross\-border payments, financial fraud attempts are increasingly sophisticated and executed in milliseconds. Protecting enterprise ledger systems and merchant accounts requires real\-time anomaly detection, sophisticated graph analysis, and instantaneous risk scoring.
   

  

 Our engineering culture values proactive threat mitigation, high\-performance data processing, and uncompromised system reliability. If you want to build intelligent risk engines that protect multi\-million\-dollar financial networks from malicious actors, you will find your professional home with us.
   

  

 The Role \& Impact
   

  

 We are seeking a sharp, data\-driven
 **Fintech Fraud \& Risk Analytics Engineer** 
 to design, build, and deploy real\-time fraud detection and risk scoring systems. In this role, you will analyze massive transaction streams, build behavioral profiling models, and implement automated rules and machine learning classifiers that flag suspicious activities before settlement occurs. You will work at the critical intersection of data science, backend engineering, and financial security.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities \& Daily Expectations
   

  

* Risk Engine Development: Design and scale real\-time transaction screening microservices and rule evaluation engines using Python, FastAPI, and asynchronous message queues.
* Feature Engineering: Build and maintain low\-latency feature stores that compute rolling user velocity, device fingerprinting, and transactional behavioral anomalies on the fly.
* Model Integration: Integrate machine learning classification and anomaly detection models (Isolation Forests, XGBoost, graph\-based link analysis) directly into payment processing pipelines.
* Investigation Dashboards: Build analytical reporting tools and investigative dashboards for compliance teams to review flagged transactions and audit fraud patterns.
* Latency Optimization: Ensure fraud evaluation checks execute well within tight SLA windows (under 50 milliseconds) to prevent payment friction.


**What We Are Looking For (Requirements)**
* Experience: 3 to 5 years of professional experience in data engineering, machine learning engineering, or backend development within fintech, banking, or risk management domains.
* Technical Mastery: Strong command of Python, advanced SQL, and experience with streaming data platforms (Kafka/Flink) and relational/NoSQL datastores.
* Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of payment gateway flows, anti\-money laundering (AML) indicators, KYC verification logic, and common fintech fraud vectors.
* Analytical Mindset: Proven ability to analyze large datasets, spot statistical anomalies, and tune precision/recall tradeoffs for risk models.
* Education: Degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or equivalent analytical field.


**What We Offer \& How To Apply**
* Competitive Compensation: Industry\-standard salary bracket (18–32 LPA) backed by performance bonuses and equity options.
* High\-Impact Role: Direct ownership over core financial security and fraud prevention systems.

title: Sr Data Product Manager , Global SAP Analytics
description:
At McCormick, we bring our passion for flavor to work each day. We encourage growth, respect everyone's contributions and do what's right for our business, our people, our communities and our planet. Join us on our quest to make every meal and moment better.
   

  

 Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25\-year\-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.
   

  

 While our global headquarters are in the Baltimore, Maryland, USA area, McCormick operates and serves customers from nearly 60 locations in 25 countries and 170 markets in Asia\-Pacific, China, Europe, Middle East and Africa, and the Americas, including North, South and Central America
   

  

**Position Overview**
 The Data Product Manager (SAP Analytics) leads the strategy, design, and delivery of trusted, high\-value data products for McCormick’s SAP Analytics. This role is accountable for the end\-to\-end lifecycle, quality, and adoption of SAP Analytics data products that enable measurable business outcomes — including strategic decision\-making, performance transparency, and operational excellence across McCormick.
   

  

 The Data Product Manager (SAP Analytics) is accountable for the definition, championing, and most importantly, delivery of trusted, high\-value data products. The role works as one with McCormick’s Transformation \& Technology (including Data \& Analytics, Data Governance, Information Security and Technology teams) and Global Business Solutions (including Automation and Data Science \& Engineering teams) functions to connect people, platforms, and processes — establishing a trusted, intelligent, and connected SAP Analytics data foundation that supports McCormick’s global growth and enterprise value creation.
   

  

**Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Data Product Strategy \& Vision: Defines the strategy and roadmap for SAP Analytics data products that enable functional priorities and deliver measurable business value in alignment with McCormick’s enterprise data strategies—both at the functional level, as established by the Data Owner, and at the enterprise level as established by the Chief Data \& Analytics Officer (CDAO). Partners with stakeholders and Transformation \& Technology Business Relationship Managers (BRMs) to prioritize initiatives based on business impact, ROI potential, and readiness for advanced analytics and AI applications. Directs the design and delivery of data products that generate tangible business outcomes while ensuring scalability, interoperability, and long‑term sustainability. Establishes and maintains strong cross‑functional alignment to effectively prioritize initiatives, communicate progress, and advance McCormick’s data‑driven transformation.
* Data Product Lifecycle Ownership: Directs the planning, prioritization, and delivery of SAP Analytic data products through an agile, iterative approach that ensures responsiveness to evolving business needs. Manages the data product backlog—translating functional requirements into clear, actionable user stories—and directs Data Engineers, Data Architects (who are part of the AI and analytics product teams), and Data Stewards to deliver high\-quality, secure, and accessible data solutions. Oversees release planning and approval in alignment with governance and quality standards.
* Data Quality, Trust \& Compliance: Drives adherence to enterprise and functional standards for data quality, lineage, metadata, and compliance across SAP Analytic data products. Partners with key stakeholders to embed governance and regulatory requirements into data product design and delivery. Monitors data quality and trust metrics, driving continuous improvement to ensure data products remain reliable, reusable, and fit for analytical and AI\-driven use cases.
* Data Enablement \& Workforce Readiness: Enables relevant stakeholders to easily find, understand, and use trusted data by ensuring data products are well\-documented, cataloged, and supported with clear usage guidance. Partners with key stakeholders to maintain accurate catalog entries, metadata, and reference materials that promote consistent and compliant data use. Leads initiatives to strengthen engagement with data products and activate a culture where data is valued, trusted, and responsibly used as “ground truth”.
* Data Product Performance \& Value Realization: Defines and tracks performance metrics to measure the adoption, quality, and business impact of SAP Analytic data products. Establishes feedback loops that leverage usage insights and stakeholder input to drive continuous improvement and optimization. Partners with the Data Owner to quantify and communicate data product value, demonstrating significant advancement McCormick’s digital and AI transformation.


**Required Qualifications**
 Level of Education and Discipline
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business Analytics, or other applicable field
* Candidates with strong SAP Analytics qualifications and a demonstrated track record of data literacy may also be considered in lieu of the above degree requirements


 Experience \- functional/industry/commercial knowledge, business acumen
   

  

* 15\+ years of experience in data product management, data strategy, or data governance within a complex or global organization
* 12\+ years of experience in SAP Analytics within the CPG, food, or manufacturing industries
* Proven ability to manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of data products, from vision and roadmap through delivery and adoption
* Strong understanding of data architecture, quality, metadata, and governance, with the ability to connect technical design to business value and apply modern data product concepts (e.g. data mesh)
* Demonstrated success working in Agile environments, collaborating with cross\-functional teams including Data Engineering, IT, and business stakeholders
* Solid business acumen and communication skills, with experience quantifying data product value and driving data adoption across functions


 Interpersonal Skills \- leadership, interactions, communication, influence
   

  

 Strategic thinking skills are essential to develop data products that create business value and support key business objectives and strategies. By connecting business context with technical execution, the role balances competing needs, prioritizes product backlogs, and ensures successful delivery of data products that achieve business objectives while driving accountability for data quality, governance, and adoption within an Agile, iterative environment.
   

  

 Influencing and collaboration skills are critical to align diverse stakeholders and advance McCormick’s enterprise data and governance strategy. The Data Product Owner builds trusted relationships across multiple functions including RDQR, Transformation \& Technology, and Global Business Solutions, leading through influence and collaboration to deliver data products that meet evolving business needs.
   

  

 Communication skills are required to articulate data product vision, value, and progress in a clear and compelling way. The role tailors messages to different audiences, ensuring complex ideas are conveyed with clarity and purpose. Active listening, transparency, and structured communication are used to align expectations, secure engagement, and reinforce accountability for trusted, high‑value data products.
   

  

 At McCormick, we have over a 100\-year legacy based on our “Power of People” principle. This principle fosters an unusually dedicated workforce requiring a culture of respect, recognition, inclusion and collaboration based on the highest ethical value

title: Risk Analytics - Product Analyst - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS \- Delivery Excellence Senior position**
 Within last decade, cost of delivery and Delivery excellence has become the most critical factors to run successful and popular businesses spread around the globe. To support such a dynamic and fast paced IT transformation industry, we are using various cutting\-edge Delivery Excellence models and tools with relentless focus on automation to offer best in class and tailor\-made solutions to our clients.
   

  

 As a part of our global team you will be part of GDS projects as Delivery Excellence management professional. You will be involved in working on challenging problems and creating next generation delivery excellence platforms.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Are you a detail driven professional with a passion for translating business needs into impactful product experiences? Do you thrive at the intersection of people, process, and technology? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our Product team and help shape solutions that deliver real value to our clients and users.
   

  

 In this role, you’ll serve as a critical bridge between the business stakeholders and the development and engineering teams. Your work will influence how ideas become features, how features become products, and how products deliver meaningful outcomes in a fast paced, evolving environment.
   

  

 As a key member of the Product team, you will play a hands on role in defining business requirements, crafting user stories, and ensuring that technical execution aligns seamlessly with business objectives. You will lead user acceptance testing (UAT), drive iterative testing cycles, validate enhancements, and ensure that issues or defects are accurately identified, tracked, and resolved. Your keen eye for detail and strong communication skills will help ensure that every release meets the highest standards of quality and functionality.
   

  

 This is a client facing and user centric role where you will engage with stakeholders, address queries, clarify requirements, and ensure that feedback is incorporated into continuous product improvements. You’ll gain a deep understanding of real world user behaviors, business processes, and product journeys—making this the perfect place to grow as a product focused business professional while driving meaningful impact across the product lifecycle.
   

  

 If you’re energized by the opportunity to influence product development end to end, collaborate with cross functional teams, and help bring scalable, user friendly solutions to life, this role provides the platform for you to make a lasting difference.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, ensuring alignment across stakeholders, product managers, and engineering teams.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by testing the defined test cases, validating functionality, and ensuring readiness for release.
* Support in iterative testing cycles, identifying defects, documenting issues, validating fixes, and performing regression testing as needed.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
* Serve as one of the primary liaison between business teams and engineering, providing clarifications, resolving requirement gaps, and ensuring shared understanding throughout the product lifecycle.
* Review and validate bug fixes, ensuring that resolved issues meet expected outcomes before closure.
* Engage with clients and end users, addressing queries, troubleshooting issues, and gathering feedback for continuous improvement.
* Support product rollout activities, including release planning, communication, and training support where required.
* Monitor product performance post release, identify enhancement opportunities, and contribute to backlog prioritization.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation including requirement specifications, UAT plans, test results, and user feedback logs.
* Support product strategy, roadmap planning, and end\-to\-end product lifecycle management for Internal Controls and Audit solutions.
* Partner with stakeholders across business, risk, audit, and technology teams to gather requirements and drive product adoption.
* Own MIS, reporting, KPI tracking, and executive dashboards to measure product performance and business outcomes.
* Analyse large datasets to derive insights, identify control gaps, and support decision\-making.
* Drive product implementation, rollout, user onboarding, and change management initiatives.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to define functional requirements and prioritise product backlogs.
* Identify automation and AI opportunities to enhance audit and internal control processes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Risk Assessment – Assessment of internal processes to identify findings, vulnerabilities, and control gaps/deviations identified across applications and infrastructure.
* Control Monitoring / Testing \- Understanding of controls around Business processes, ITGC, Cyber, Data protection and privacy to perform testing of design and operational effectiveness of controls.
* Ability to create process documentation.
* Ability to understand business problems in Risk/Finance and contribute to translating them into solution or product requirements.
* Exposure (through projects or roles) to Risk, Finance, Supply Chain Operations (SCO), or related business functions preferred.
* Demonstrates interest in AI/analytics\-driven Risk solutions and their business applications.
* Agentic AI architecture\- Design agentic AI system architectures and define associated technical guardrails.
* Functional understanding of foundation models (LLMs) and associated risks. Awareness of the AI deployment lifecycle
* Control Automation – Identify automation opportunities using analytics platform to monitor the operational effectiveness on the regular basis.
* Basic exposure to Presales, solutioning, proposal support, or client presentations is a plus.
* Interest in working in tech\-enabled or AI\-led Risk products/solutions environment.
* Ability to support senior team members in product development, go\-to\-market efforts, and client engagements.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team\-player and self\-started attitude.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, global delivery environment with distributed teams.
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.
* Open to hiring across locations, aligned with EY’s Global Delivery Services (GDS) model.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Overall 3\-6 years of experience in Risk Advisory (preferably Internal Controls) experience with Big 4 or comparable professional services environment
* CA or Master’s degree in Business Administration or Risk management
* Good to have certifications – CISA, CISM, CIA, AIGP, ISO 42001, CISSP, CRISC, CCSK, ISO 27001, and others (as relevant)
* Any 1 hard tech skill is a must – Either Python or Databricks Or full stack or AI
* Product Management experience with demonstrated ownership of delivering business solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Experience in reporting, MIS, analytics, and data\-driven decision making.
* Hands\-on experience in product implementation and deployment.
* Domain expertise in Internal Controls, Risk, Compliance, or Audit (mandatory).


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 250\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Coro brings together technology, data, and services to build and operate proprietary solutions that create differentiated value for Bain’s clients and case teams.

 The Software Engineer role is a full stack engineering position focused on building and maintaining product features across the Artemis backend (Python/FastAPI) and frontend (React/TypeScript). Engineers in this role contribute to platform capabilities used by consultants and clients in live engagements, working within established patterns and with guidance from senior team members. Contributions span both the API layer and the React components that surface those capabilities to users — including the marketing mix model configuration interface, channel allocation dashboards, scenario planning tools, and client\-ready output views.
 





 This is a delivery\-focused role for engineers who are ready to contribute meaningfully across the full stack and grow their ownership over time. The core expectation is shipping well\-tested features within defined specifications, collaborating closely with senior engineers, and developing the habits and judgment that come with working in a production product environment. Additional responsibilities include participating in support and operations by identifying system defects, contributing to troubleshooting efforts, and supporting code deployments.
 




  






**WHAT YOU’LL DO** 





 Feature Development
 
* Implement features across backend API logic and React frontend components for assigned Artemis product areas, working from clear specifications and with guidance from senior engineers. Contribute to taking features from development through testing and deployment across both layers.
* Build and maintain backend routes for assigned product areas, following established patterns for request/response contracts, versioning, and testing. Keep TypeScript type contracts on the frontend in sync with backend changes.



 Frontend and Data Visualization 
 
* Build and maintain React components using the shared Demand Generation Suite design system, contributing to marketing analytics interfaces including channel allocation dashboards, scenario comparison views, and model configuration workflows. Follow established component and styling conventions.
* Write database queries and data access logic for Artemis data models, following existing schema and migration patterns. Develop familiarity with the data volumes and access patterns typical of marketing analytics engagements.



 Quality and Collaboration
 
* Write and maintain tests for backend and frontend code. Ensure new features ship with adequate coverage and do not degrade existing functionality, with support from senior engineers on testing strategy.
* Participate in structured feedback sessions with Artemis Expert Consultants and go\-to\-market\-aligned specialists. Contribute observations and help translate feedback into concrete improvements in subsequent sprints.
* Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across the team and with adjacent stakeholders.



 Innovation \& Emerging Technologies
 
* Drive innovation through out\-of\-the\-box thinking to solve critical business challenges and demands.
* Participate in technical discovery, POCs, and innovation workstreams to validate new tools, technologies, and designs.
* Investigate and keep up\-to\-date on emerging data, AI, and agentic technologies and trends; lead knowledge sharing.
* Entrepreneurial spirit, willing to try new approaches.



  






**ABOUT YOU** 





 Technical
 
* Proficient in Python for backend development, with exposure to or interest in async frameworks (FastAPI or equivalent). Able to implement features within an established codebase and framework.
* Proficient in React and TypeScript in a production or near\-production context, with foundational understanding of state management patterns, data fetching, and TypeScript type safety.
* Familiarity with CSS and comfort working within component libraries and design systems, following established conventions rather than authoring them from scratch.
* Working knowledge of relational databases: writing SQL queries, reading and modifying schemas, and debugging query issues.
* Exposure to data visualization libraries for building chart\-based interfaces is a plus.
* Experience contributing to time and cost estimates of product enhancements, advise on trade\-offs of features.
* Familiarity with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) to support and accelerate development workflows.
* Results\-driven, with an analytical and collaborative mindset. Eager to learn and grow in a fast\-paced Agile environment.



 Education
 
* Associate/Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.



 Experience
 
* 2\-3\+ years of experience building full\-stack web applications.


* Track record of delivering in an Agile environment.
* Experience with troubleshooting and issue resolution skills.

* Exposure to marketing, media, or commercial data (such as spend, sales, or campaign performance) in any context, including academic or side projects, is a plus.
