title: Performance marketeer
description:
**About The Crafture** 




 The Crafture is a Gurugram\-based bespoke furniture studio creating handcrafted, made\-to\-order furniture for homes, hospitality spaces and design\-led businesses. With our own manufacturing setup, we work across solid wood, cane and upholstery to deliver distinctive, durable pieces and complete\-home furniture solutions.
 



**The Role** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on Performance Marketer who can plan, execute and scale paid campaigns across Meta and Google. You will own the complete performance funnel \- from audience strategy and creative testing to tracking, optimisation and lead quality. The role is ideal for someone who is analytical, commercially aware and comfortable working closely with founders, sales and creative teams.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 Plan, launch and optimise lead\-generation and conversion campaigns across Meta Ads and Google Ads.
 



 Own campaign structure, audience segmentation, keyword strategy, bidding, budgets and daily performance optimisation.
 



 Drive qualified enquiries for full\-home furniture, bespoke furniture, hospitality projects and B2B partnerships across priority cities.
 



 Track and improve core metrics including spend, CTR, CPC, conversion rate, CPL, CAC, ROAS and lead\-to\-sale conversion.
 



 Build a disciplined testing calendar for creative formats, hooks, copy, audiences, offers and landing pages.
 



 Translate campaign data into clear creative briefs and work with the design/content team to produce higher\-performing ads.
 



 Set up and maintain accurate tracking through GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel/CAPI, UTMs and relevant conversion events.
 



 Connect marketing performance with lead quality and sales outcomes using Zoho CRM, WhatsApp and website enquiry data.
 



 Prepare concise weekly reports with insights, learnings, budget recommendations and next actions \- not just metric dumps.
 



 Monitor competitors, platform changes and emerging opportunities without chasing trends that do not support business outcomes.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




 2\-4 years of hands\-on performance marketing experience, preferably with a D2C, e\-commerce, interiors, real\-estate, luxury or premium consumer brand.
 



 Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads, including Search, Display, Performance Max and remarketing.
 



 Demonstrated ability to manage budgets independently and improve ROAS, CAC or CPL through structured optimisation.
 



 Practical understanding of conversion tracking, attribution, GA4, GTM and performance dashboards.
 



 Comfort with numbers, experimentation and making decisions from imperfect data.
 



 Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate with founders, salespeople, designers and content creators.
 



 A portfolio or case studies showing actual campaign budgets, approach and results.
 



  





**Success in This Role Will Be Measured By** 




 Growth in qualified leads and revenue influenced by paid campaigns.
 



 Improvement in CPL, CAC, ROAS and lead\-to\-sale conversion.
 



 Lead quality across retail, complete\-home, hospitality and B2B enquiries.
 



 Speed and quality of testing, learning and budget reallocation.
 



 Accuracy and usefulness of tracking, reporting and actionable insights.
 



  





**Why Join Us** 




 Work directly with the founders and influence growth strategy, not only campaign execution.
 



 Build performance marketing for a design\-led brand with its own manufacturing capability and strong visual content.
 



 Take ownership across the full funnel and see a direct connection between campaigns, leads and sales.
 



  





**How to Apply** 




 Apply with your CV and 2\-3 campaign case studies. Please include the objective, media budget, platforms used, your specific contribution, key results, current and expected CTC, notice period and present location.
 



**Please apply only if you are comfortable working full\-time from our Gurugram office.**

title: Senior Business Solution Owner
description:
You may know McCormick as a leader in herbs, spices, seasonings, and condiments – and we’re only getting started. At McCormick, we’re always looking for new people to bring their unique flavor to our team.
   

  

 McCormick employees – all 14,000 of us across the world – are what makes this company a great place to work.
   

  

 We are looking to hire an Senior Business Solution Ownerimmediately in a Hybrid (50/50\) capacity at our Gurgaon office.
   

  

**What We Bring To The Table**
 The best people deserve the best rewards. In addition to the benefits you’d expect from a global leader (401k, health insurance, paid time off, etc.) we also offer:
   

  

* Competitive compensation
* Career growth opportunities
* Flexibility and Support for Diverse Life Stages and Choices


**Profile Overview**
 The key purpose of a Sr Business Solution Owner is to support the development and management of our most complex data\-related solutions to deliver value in line with the business’s strategy. This role will support the implementation of product vision and strategy, prioritization of enhancements, and communication of changes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Product Vision and Strategy: Facilitate and lead the technical teams to deliver a product that reflects the vision for the data product and provide guidance to ensure the teams are on track and informed on requirements. Provide clarity to a well\-defined and inspiring solution that aligns the team and stakeholders with the overall business goals. Support the refinements and plannings of product features in line with business goals.
* Business Partnering \& Prioritization: Support and work closely with our stakeholders to prioritize features based on business value, ability to navigate the complexity of our data landscape to offer advice on product features to prioritize backlog that balances short\-term needs with longterm goals and resource constraints
* User Story Definition: Provide support in the development \& maintenance of user stories translating business requirements into actionable tasks that inform a well\-defined backlog that serves as a basis for development
* Quality Assurance: Support the successful implementation of acceptance criteria to ensure product quality, resulting in a high\-quality product that meets specified requirements and user expectations. Actively provide regular feedback on product features to optimize performance and maximize business value.
* Informal Leadership \& Mentoring: Mentor and share knowledge with some of the more junior Business Solution Owners and developers on the broader team allowing for quick upskilling and best practice adoption


**Secondary Responsibilities**
* Ability to achieve project goals and objectives by applying the discipline of planning, organizing, and managing resources to bring about successful project completion


**Required Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of prior experience doing similar or comparable projects in a related field.
* Demonstrated expertise in converting complex business requirements into actionable technical and functional specifications for implementation by development teams.
* Familiarity with development lifecycle for creating reports using Business Intelligence tools, e.g. Power BI
* Familiarity with development lifecycle for creating automation solutions using automation tools, e.g. Power Automate, UiPath, Power Apps
* Familiarity with development lifecycle in creating data engineering solutions using relevant tools, e.g. Azure, Python, SQL.
* Experience working with structured and unstructured data
* Demonstrated ability to proactively solve problems and multi\-task.
* Understanding of enterprise data sources to drive visibility to data\-driven insights
* Execute continuous improvement initiatives to improve systems and ways of working.


**Other Skills And Competencies**
* Strong business perspective; able to merge business questions/needs with available data to provide data\-driven insights.
* Basic Supply Chain, Finance and Business acumen.

description:
Wood Mackenzie is the global leader in analytics, insights and proprietary data across the entire energy and natural resources landscape.
   

  

 For over 50 years our work has guided the decisions of the world’s most influential energy producers, utilities companies, financial institutions and governments.
   

  

 Now, with the world’s energy system more complex and interconnected than ever before, sector\-specific views are no longer enough. That’s why we’ve redefined what’s possible with Intelligence Connected.
   

  

 By fusing our unparalleled proprietary data with the sharpest analytical minds, all supercharged by Synoptic AI, we deliver a clear, interconnected view of the entire value chain. Our trusted team of 2,700 experts across 30 countries breaks siloes and connects industries, markets and regions across the globe.
   

  

 This empowers our customers to identify risk sooner, spot opportunities faster and recalibrate strategy with confidence – whether planning days, weeks, months or decades ahead.
   

  

 Wood Mackenzie
   

  

 Intelligence Connected
   

  

**WoodMac.com**
**Wood Mackenzie Brand Video**
**Wood Mackenzie Values**
* Inclusive – we succeed together
* Trusting – we choose to trust each other
* Customer committed – we put customers at the heart of our decisions
* Future Focused – we accelerate change
* Curious – we turn knowledge into action


 We monitor key events and conduct research to produce thought\-provoking reports, data models, and presentations. From asset valuation to corporate reports, from market supply\-demand research to price\-forecasting, and from the regional to the global, our analysis helps shape our customers’ commercial strategies.
   

  

 We also support bespoke consulting projects, diving deeper into our data to answer unique questions. We help our Sales team retain and win new business by spending time with customers and answering questions that matter to them. We work closely with colleagues in our Data and Product functions to maintain the quality of our published data and to deliver content via our
 **growing Lens platform** 
**.**
 Through carrying out primary research, responding to customer questions, and presenting to industry stakeholders, you will build relationships and a network of contacts at key operators, national bodies, and other relevant institutions. Over time you will gain specialist knowledge and develop the skills you require to progress your career at Wood Mackenzie.
   

  

**Main Responsibilities**
 We are looking for a Research Associate to join our Gas \& LNG research practice within the Commodities Global Analyst Team, based in Gurugram or Mumbai, India. The role will support the development of Wood Mackenzie’s views across global and regional Gas \& LNG markets, with a particular focus on APAC gas markets and global LNG asset developments.
   

  

 You will undertake detailed research and analysis across the Gas \& LNG value chain, including gas and LNG supply and demand, consumption patterns, LNG supply and regasification projects, LNG contracts and shipping, market developments, and relevant macroeconomic trends. You will track and assess industry developments, identify key market drivers and risks, and translate data and industry intelligence into clear, insightful views on current market conditions and future market possibilities.
   

  

 You will contribute to the development and maintenance of datasets, data models, methodologies and other intellectual property supporting our Gas \& LNG research and products. This will include supporting the Global Gas Model, developing scenarios for how gas and LNG markets may evolve, and creating compelling visualizations and analysis to communicate our views.
   

  

 You will contribute to regular research reports, global LNG outlooks, market insights, informs and webinars, working closely with regional analysts and subject matter experts across Gas \& LNG, upstream and other relevant teams. You will be expected to build compelling narratives from researched and available data, articulate supply and demand views, and communicate short\- and long\-term market outlooks clearly to both internal and external audiences.
   

  

 The role will also involve supporting client engagement by responding to client enquiries and ad hoc requests, participating in client discussions and presentations, and helping communicate Wood Mackenzie’s views and insights to customers and prospects. Through research trips, industry events and client interactions, you will develop an understanding of the key topics and challenges facing the Gas \& LNG industry and incorporate these perspectives into our research.
   

  

 You will be expected to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively across geographically dispersed teams. As you develop in the role, you will build deeper expertise across Gas \& LNG markets and assets while strengthening your capabilities in research, data analysis, modelling, market intelligence, written and verbal communication, and client engagement.
   

  

 Your application should showcase your enthusiasm for the Gas \& LNG sectors and demonstrate your ability in the following areas, which we require daily at Wood Mackenzie.
   

  

**General Core Capabilities**
* Research and data gathering – we identify and gather intelligence that feeds our industry expertise. We need inquisitive and passionate people with a keen eye for detail.
* Analysis \- we provide market\-leading research using this data/intelligence and form opinions for, and tell stories to, our customers. We need people with natural curiosity with potential to become experts in their field, and with the ability to articulate – both verbally and in writing – clear, insightful analysis.
* Internal engagement – we work with colleagues across the Wood Mackenzie business to deliver a compelling, integrated view of the natural resources sector to customers through our cutting\-edge products. For this, we need people who are as comfortable working collaboratively as they are independently and who have excellent interpersonal skills.
* External engagement – we proactively connect with our customers and contacts in the industries we serve, adding value and promoting the Wood Mackenzie brand. This requires people with the potential to become industry experts who have intellectual curiosity, passion, and excellent presentation skills.
* Continuous improvement – at Wood Mackenzie, we are committed to transform the way we power our planet. The energy transition is here and this impacts our customer base and how we serve them. We need colleagues with a change mindset, who are flexible, growth\-orientated and proactive.


**Specific Role Requirements**
* Build and develop high\-quality research on the short\-term LNG market, with a focus on demand and shipping.
* Forecast monthly gas and LNG demand for various countries, run complex models and ensure our view remains robust, up\-to\-date, and consistent.
* Participate in the creation of new demand models.
* Run our shipping models and drive enhancements to our methodologies.
* Identify and collect market research and data relating to these datasets, working with the data teams to ensure a high level of automation.
* Compile weekly commentary on LNG demand and LNG shipping. Contribute to our regular internal knowledge shares.
* Work with the broader gas \& LNG teams (for regional and global consistency) or other commodity teams (like power, coal, carbon).
* Create content for the Monthly Outlook, participate to our monthly webinars.
* Take part in regular client engagement, either via email, virtual and F2F interactions


**Diversity is at the core of our business** 
 and we welcome applications from a range of academic or professional backgrounds. Wood Mackenzie has adopted a hybrid approach and we expect people to be present in our offices 2 days per week.
   

  

**About You**
 You have a keen interest in commodity market dynamics, and you want to develop an in\-depth understanding of how these markets underpin the natural resources industry and impact our everyday lives.
   

  

 You have an analytical mindset and an eye for detail, which have been proven in your academic and/or work experience to date. You are comfortable collecting, structuring and interpreting large data sets, articulating your findings in a clear and insightful manner. You are curious and seek to clarify and enhance your knowledge by asking thoughtful questions. You also have a flair for writing and communication and confidence in presenting to an audience.
   

  

 You are a highly adaptive team player and embrace fast\-paced environments with frequent change. You are excited to be part of a team that gives you opportunities to work cross\-functionally on a variety of tasks. You can work independently and as part of a global and regional team, generating ideas you want to share. The way in which you work is productive and driven, striving to be best in class.
   

  

 You have an excellent command of English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of at least one other language would be an advantage. You also have an excellent working knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite, particularly Excel, PowerQuery, and PowerPoint, and some exposure to coding.
   

  

**Equal Opportunities**
 We are an equal opportunities employer. This means we are committed to recruiting the best people regardless of their race, colour, religion, age, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, disability or protected veteran status. You can find out more about your rights under the law at www.eeoc.gov

title: Project Leader- Data & Insights (Industries) - Consumer Lab
description:
**About Us**
 Bain \& Company is a global consultancy that helps the world’s most ambitious change makers define the future. Across 61 offices in 39 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Since our founding in 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients, and we proudly maintain the highest level of client advocacy in the industry.
   

  

 In 2004, the firm established its presence in the Indian market by opening the Bain Capability Center (BCC) in New Delhi. The BCC is now known as BCN (Bain Capability Network) with its nodes across various geographies. BCN plays a critical role in supporting Bain's case teams globally to help with analytics and research across all industries, for corporate cases, client development, private equity diligence or Bain intellectual property. The BCN comprises of Consulting Services, Knowledge Services and Shared Services.
   

  

**Who You’ll Work With**
 This position is based in BCN's Gurgaon office and is a vital part of the Data and Insights Industries’ Consumer Lab team within CP. The Consumer Lab team plays a critical role in advancing Bain's expertise in the consumer products sector via building, maintaining, and advancing comprehensive Bain IP/Research to capture key trends within the consumer space.
   

  

 With a focus on consumer centricity, Bain Consumer Lab works with CP Practice/Case\-teams to triangulate bespoke qualitative and quantitative research, in\-market testing, third\-party data sets, and the perspectives of our expert network to unearth validated, actionable insights to answer clients' pressing challenges. Our network includes AAG, Innovation \& Design, Pyxis, Net base, FBX and the Bain Advisor Network.
   

  

 By staying ahead of industry trends and leveraging advanced data analytics, the Consumer Lab team supports Bain’s commitment to delivering top\-tier strategic guidance to its clients. Over time, we have developed seamless solutions and utilized powerful, dynamic visualizations and charts on various platforms (e.g., Tableau) to showcase our results and have been venturing towards Gen\-AI\-based tools to drive further value. Our working model features a mix between long\-term research projects as well as short, dynamic engagements with case\-teams supporting them on key analyses.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As a Project Leader in the CP Consumer Lab team within Data \& Insights Industries, you will play a key role in driving the workstream forward. You will lead the Consumer Lab team in co\-developing Bain’s global IP solutions/insights to pave way for strong Consumer research. The role would involve liaising closely with CP Practice/Case\-team(s) and other 3rd party vendors/associate network teams to identify, manage and drive high\-quality insights for Bain within Consumer space. Operationally, this would entail working under the direct supervision of a Manager/Senior Manager and leading 1\-2 project engagements at any given time, along with guiding analysts/associates to support ad\-hoc data/storyline requests for the case\-teams. This would also involve extensive boundary management with team such as AAG, RDS, Innovation and Design and 3rd party survey vendors to procure and manage the most relevant set of data and associated insights. In time, you’d be expected to drive innovation within the team via helping your supervisor explore and introduce more advanced Tableau and Gen\-AI for Consumer insights from data. Additionally, you will guide and mentor a team of analysts and associates, providing direction and support to enhance team productivity and contribute to the overall success of the Consumer Lab initiatives.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Lead the development, maintenance and upgrading of proprietary Bain IP, coordinating efforts with the help of 3\-4 aligned team members (analysts and associates) and ensuring data accuracy and relevance.
* Guide Analysts/Associates on best practices and methodologies for IP creation, ensuring consistency and quality in data collection and reporting.
* Effectively communicate with BCN / end clients and deliver client ready documents containing implementable solutions.
* Provide mentorship and hands\-on support to analysts/associates in data analysis and other ad\-hoc work engagement.
* Set\-up strong standards for data accuracy and quality
* Pressure test insights and perform extensive sense checks
* Be a key thought partner to CP Practice in conceptualizing research, explore innovative solutions and further client engagement for Consumer Lab.
* Stay up to date with the latest consumer products industry trends and incorporate these insights into the insights creation processes.
* Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality outputs by managing workflows and team efforts.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure solutions align with overall business objectives and industry trends.
* Able to quickly come up to speed on different businesses and lead research and analysis engagements across geographies and industries.
* Collaborate with Bain case teams globally and work under direct guidance of senior leadership, to identify client\-specific trends, validate assumptions, and ensure recommendations are aligned with industry.
* Liase with cross\-functional teams to drive value
* Identify and use relevant analytical tools and internal repositories to extract data and analyze information.


**About You**
* Graduate (preferably with degree in engineering / science / commerce / business / economics) with at least 5\-8 years of relevant experience or an MBA/Post\-Graduate with high academic records having 3\-5 years of relevant experience.
* Proven expertise in leading, guiding and mentoring a team of 3\-5 members in the past. Experience of data analysis and project management
* Effective communication skills and ability and deliver clear and professional presentations to senior stakeholders (Bain managers, partners, and clients)
* Expertise in building intellectual proprietary based research reports backed by strong primary and secondary research skills.
* Strong number crunching/Excel modelling skills, with a knack for setting up and meeting high data quality standards
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills to lead the team towards pragmatic solutions.
* Strong expertise in various analytical and reporting / visualization tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, Tableau and Alteryx
* Experience in survey design, coding, deployment, and results creation across various internal/external platforms (Qualtrics, IncQuery etc.)
* Performing advanced survey analytics to back impactful insights for clients
* Any experience with LLM/AI tools would be a bonus.
* Ability to foresee potential bottlenecks, risks and short\-term/long\-term implications and exhibit willingness to change.
* Ability to navigate the above challenges with a professional mindset.
* Ability to handle multiple tasks and work in a team set up.
* Curiosity to continuously groom oneself towards knowing more about consumer products space and wider consumer trends.


**What Makes Us a Great Place To Work**
 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work, a champion of diversity and a model of social responsibility. We are currently ranked the \#1 consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list, and we have maintained a spot in the top four on Glassdoor's list for the last 12 years. We believe that diversity, inclusion and collaboration is key to building extraordinary teams. We hire people with exceptional talents, abilities and potential, then create an environment where you can become the best version of yourself and thrive both professionally and personally. We are publicly recognized by external parties such as Fortune, Vault, Mogul, Working Mother, Glassdoor and the Human Rights Campaign for being a great place to work for diversity and inclusion, women, LGBTQ and parents.

title: Ecommerce Manager
description:
**Job Title: E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 




  





 We are looking for a highly driven and commercially minded
 **E\-Commerce \& Marketplace Growth Manager** 
 to take ownership of our online sales channels and drive growth across marketplaces, our website, and other digital commerce platforms.
 



  





 This is not a purely operational role. We are looking for someone who can think like a business owner—someone who can identify opportunities, improve sales, optimise profitability, study competitors, develop new product ideas, and build new revenue channels.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will manage and grow our presence across platforms such as
 **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, our own website, and other relevant marketplaces and aggregator portals** 
 .
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Marketplace Management \& Growth** 



* Manage and grow sales across Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and other relevant e\-commerce and aggregator platforms.
* Create, optimise and manage product listings, including titles, descriptions, keywords, images and product information.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities to improve sales and visibility.
* Plan and execute pricing, discounts, offers, bundles and promotional campaigns.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure inventory availability and minimise stock\-outs.
* Monitor product ratings, reviews, returns and customer feedback.
* Identify underperforming SKUs and develop strategies to improve or discontinue them.
* Identify high\-performing products and opportunities to scale them.



  





**2\. Website Sales \& Digital Commerce Growth** 



* Drive sales and growth through the company website.
* Identify opportunities to improve website conversion rates and customer experience.
* Create product bundles, combo offers, trial packs, family packs, premium packs and other initiatives to increase average order value.
* Develop cross\-selling and upselling opportunities across the product portfolio.
* Work with internal and external teams to improve product pages, offers and customer journeys.
* Develop strategies to increase repeat purchases and customer retention.



  





**3\. Customer Feedback, Testimonials \& Retention** 



* Develop and manage a structured process for collecting customer feedback.
* Conduct customer calls to understand product experience and satisfaction.
* Identify satisfied customers and collect written and video testimonials.

description:
**COMPANY PROFILE**





 Bain \& Company is one of the top management consulting firms in the world that helps the world’s most ambitious changemakers define the future.
 





 Across 65 cities in 40 countries, we work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperforming the competition, and redefining industries. We complement our tailored, integrated expertise with a vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators to deliver better, faster, and more enduring outcomes.
 





  
 





 The firm established several functions in the Indian market early 2000s and its remit across functions has expanded over time. Since 2019, these functions have become part of Global Business Services (GBS). Global Business Services (GBS) is a network of five interconnected business functions hubs across India, Poland, Malaysia, Mexico and Portugal, serving Bain globally to run our business, support other functions, and help drive innovation internally. We are over 1000 business professionals – serving functions in operations, HR, finance, legal, tech, marketing, research, and data analytics – who support our offices globally. Our mantra of “shared innovation, seamless execution,” underpinned by a passion for results, teamwork, and creativity, helps Bain stay at the top of our game operationally.
 





  
 





**WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK** 






 We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world’s best places to work. We are currently the top\-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor’s Best Places to Work list and have earned the \#1 overall spot a record seven times.
 





 Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don’t happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.
 





  
 





**Job Summary** 






 Bain’s Airlines, Logistics and Transport (ALT) sector is part of the Advanced Manufacturing \& Services (AMS) Practice. The Operations Senior Analyst role sits at the intersection of client relationship management, knowledge management, and AI enablement. You will help sector leadership and account teams improve client engagement, strengthen commercial execution, and scale best practices and IP — and you will build and maintain a growing library of AI\-powered tools, skills, and automations that case teams can pull off the shelf. Working closely with partners, knowledge management, and product teams globally, your mandate is to take routine analytical and administrative work off case teams’ plates so they can focus on higher\-value activities.
 





  
 





**Key Responsibilities** 






  
 





**Client and Account Support** 




* Support the smooth operation of Bain’s CRM tool (“Cortex” on a Salesforce platform) for approximately 30 key accounts, ensuring data integrity and consistent usage.
* Monitor client engagement patterns and surface signals that indicate opportunities for timely partner outreach.


* Build and maintain recurring dashboards and reports (e.g., account status, activity, pipeline signals) to help client heads proactively manage relationships and identify growth opportunities.
* Design and maintain a centralized repository (on Bain approved platforms) for pitch materials, proposals, case examples, and templates; ensure content is searchable, appropriately tagged, and version\-controlled for reuse.
* Partner with Knowledge Management to develop microsites using established frameworks, improving speed and consistency of content access for teams.
* Partner with other sector/practice PPK teams to cross\-pollinate IP.
* Contribute to sector IP development by participating in the creation of new IP as opportunities arise.
* Support IP deployment and commercialization by assisting the Regional Sector Leaders with go\-to\-market planning (timing, channels, and enablement materials).
* Maintain and update sector affiliate and expert lists (in coordination with relevant internal teams) to improve access to expertise when needed.




**AI Enablement** 




* Build and maintain a practice\-level repository of reusable AI assets — including Claude skills (SKILL.md files), artifacts, prompts, and agent configurations — that case teams can pull off the shelf to accelerate recurring analytical and content tasks. Own the taxonomy, documentation, access, and version control of these assets, and drive adoption through onboarding materials and light coaching of case teams.
* Develop purpose\-built AI tools that turn sector data sources into fast, case\-ready outputs — for example, skills that analyze Cirium Diio schedule data or IATA MarketIS booking data to produce quick market sizing, competitive dynamics, route economics, or network\-change analyses on demand for case teams.
* Set up and maintain recurring AI\-driven insight generation pipelines that combine licensed data subscriptions (e.g., Cirium Diio, IATA MarketIS) with public and scraped sources to produce regular sector pulses, trend updates, and proprietary points of view the practice can push to partners and clients.
* Identify routine, repetitive tasks across the practice — administrative, reporting, research, or data\-prep — and design AI automations, freeing up time for client\-facing and judgment\-heavy work. Deploy automations responsibly with appropriate confidentiality, data handling, and access controls.
* Catalogue and maintain the sector’s library of hosted proof\-of\-concept apps built for proposals and pitches — capturing what each app does, the client and proposal context it was built for, where it is hosted, its current status, and the internal owner — so the practice can quickly surface, demo, or repurpose prior POCs in new pitch situations. Coordinate with partners and product teams to retire stale apps and promote proven ones into reusable assets.







  




**Qualifications** 






 Required
 



* 2\-5 years of professional experience, ideally in professional services, consulting, technology, or data\-driven roles.
* Quantitative undergraduate degree (or equivalent analytical training).
* Hands\-on familiarity with Claude and/or other leading GenAI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot). Comfortable designing effective prompts, applying LLMs to real work tasks such as document synthesis, content drafting, and data extraction, and critically evaluating outputs to improve quality. Genuine interest in going beyond day\-to\-day usage to author and share reusable AI assets — prompts, custom GPTs, Claude skills, and artifacts — that other people can pick up and run with.
* Light analytics and data skills, including advanced Excel (pivot tables, lookups, dynamic arrays, chart\-building) and basic SQL or Python for querying, cleaning, and transforming data. Comfortable structuring datasets, performing exploratory analysis, and producing clear, insight\-driven outputs for non\-technical audiences.
* Ability to drive work end\-to\-end with limited direction; strong organization and attention to detail.
* Effective stakeholder management skills, including the ability to steer small working meetings and contribute thoughtfully with senior stakeholders.




 Preferred
 



* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce reporting and dashboarding, including building custom reports, configuring dashboards for different user personas, and working with report types and filters. Strong CRM and data\-quality habits — including ownership of data hygiene routines, deduplication, consistent taxonomy and tagging, and proactive identification of gaps or inconsistencies that could affect downstream reporting.
* Experience with knowledge management tools such as SharePoint, Google Drive, or Confluence, including setting up structured content libraries, applying metadata and tagging schemas to aid discoverability, and managing access and permissions across user groups. Familiarity with basic content governance and versioning practices — including lifecycle management (draft, approved, archived), naming conventions, and periodic content review cycles to ensure materials remain current and reusable.
* Automation experience using tools such as Power Automate, Zapier, or n8n, Salesforce flows and process builders, or light scripting (e.g., Python, JavaScript, Apps Script) to connect systems and streamline repetitive tasks. A track record of shipping reusable AI assets that others have adopted is a strong plus, as is experience identifying high\-friction processes and replacing them with automated solutions that demonstrably freed up time.

title: Consultant - Digital Strategy, Customer Experience & Analytics
description:
**What makes Gartner Consulting a GREAT fit for you?**
 A career at Gartner Consulting will be unlike any other you have experienced. Not only are we passionate about technology and its applications, but we are also committed to attracting the most creative, talented, and self\-driven people to take our well\-regarded Consulting function to a whole new level. When you join Gartner, you will be a part of some of the most innovative business and technology efforts in the marketplace today. We are technology thought leaders for the 21st century. You can expect to connect technology innovations, data\-driven insights and automation to the strategic requirements of an organization and to the commercial needs of a business, all within the context of a rapidly evolving digital economy. Consulting associates enjoy a collaborative work environment, exceptional training, and career development opportunities. If you thrive on solving complex business challenges with technology, Gartner Consulting is the place for you.
   

  

**About Role:**
 Gartner Consulting is looking for a Consultant who will work with some of the world’s largest enterprises to shape digital roadmaps, assess and improve customer experience, design data\-driven performance insights, and implement technology\-enabled transformation priorities. **What you’ll need:**
* 3\-5 years of total experience in strategy consulting, digital transformation, technology advisory, customer experience, business analytics, performance management, enterprise architecture, product strategy, IT strategy or related roles, preferably with exposure to large enterprise clients.
* 2\+ years of experience delivering digital or technology transformation, analytics and dashboarding, customer experience improvement, operating model, program assurance or related consulting engagements.

* Demonstrated hands\-on ability to design dashboards, scorecards, analytical models and automated reporting solutions using Power BI, Power Platform, Excel, SQL or similar analytics and visualization tools.
* Experience translating business and stakeholder requirements into meaningful KPIs, measurement frameworks, data requirements and executive performance views, with the ability to interpret data and communicate practical implications.
* Demonstrated understanding of digital transformation, customer experience, automation, cloud, data platforms, digital products and enterprise technology platforms, with the ability to translate technology opportunities into practical business and transformation actions.
* Experience using AI\-enabled productivity tools to improve research, synthesis, analysis, ideation, deliverable creation and speed\-to\-insight, with strong attention to accuracy, source validation, client confidentiality and responsible use.
* Passionate about technology; tracks latest trends and their potential use to solve complex business problems, improve customer outcomes, automate processes and strengthen digital capabilities.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills in a global environment, with the ability to collaborate continuously with cross\-border teams and engage business, technology and data stakeholders.
* A curious and inquisitive mind, with openness to new experiences and learning, strong problem\-solving ability, client focus and the versatility to work effectively across strategy, analytics, customer experience and transformation topics.
* Ability to create executive\-ready dashboards and deliverables with clear storyline, data\-backed recommendations, structured logic and practical next steps; Bachelor’s degree required, with an MBA or advanced degree in business, technology, engineering, analytics, computer science or a related field preferred.


**Who you are:**
* Self\-starter and quick learner who demonstrates ownership, intellectual curiosity and a strong commitment to client impact.
* Strong consultative skills and problem\-solving ability, with the confidence to structure ambiguous problems, analyze data and convert insights into actionable recommendations.
* Passionate about technology and helping clients improve customer and business outcomes through digital transformation, analytics, automation and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Comfortable combining hands\-on dashboard and analytical delivery with broader digital and technology consulting, and using AI\-enabled methods responsibly to improve productivity, quality and speed of delivery.
* Able to work effectively with senior stakeholders, engagement managers and globally distributed consulting teams across business, technology, customer experience and data topics.
* High\-performing and versatile team player with strong intercultural communication, collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
* Willing to coach and support junior team members, helping them improve consulting craft, analytical rigor, dashboard development, AI\-enabled productivity and deliverable quality.


**What Gartner Consulting will offer you?**
* A world\-class consulting environment.
* The opportunity to work on cutting\-edge dashboarding, analytics, customer experience, digital transformation and IT strategy engagements with a tier one client portfolio.
* A competitive salary.
* Structured bonus based on individual and corporate performance.

description:

title: Performance Marketer
description:
Performance Marketer
 
  





**Company:** 
 IZGGI Mercado Private Limited
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time \| In\-House
 



**Location:** 
 New Delhi
 



**Experience:** 
 2–4 Years
 



**Department:** 
 Growth \& Marketing
 



  




 About IZGGI
 
 IZGGI is a growing fashion and lifestyle brand focused on building a strong digital\-first presence and delivering products that customers love.
 



 We are looking for a
 **Performance Marketer** 
 to join our in\-house team and take ownership of our paid marketing efforts across platforms. This role is ideal for someone who is highly data\-driven, commercially minded, and comfortable taking complete ownership of campaign performance.
 



  




 The Role
 
 As a Performance Marketer, you will be responsible for planning, executing, optimizing, and scaling paid acquisition campaigns with a strong focus on
 **profitable growth and revenue generation** 
 .
 



 You will work closely with the Creative, Growth, E\-commerce, and Management teams to turn data and insights into campaigns that acquire customers efficiently and scale revenue.
 



  




 Key Responsibilities1\. Paid Advertising
 * Plan, launch, manage, and optimize campaigns across
 **Meta Ads and Google Ads** 
 .
* Manage campaign budgets and allocate spending based on performance.
* Build and manage prospecting, retargeting, and customer acquisition campaigns.
* Continuously test audiences, creatives, offers, placements, and campaign structures.
* Identify opportunities to scale high\-performing campaigns while maintaining profitability.
* Monitor campaign performance and take corrective action when performance declines.



  




 2\. Performance \& Growth
 * Own key performance metrics including
 **ROAS, CAC, CPA, CTR, CPC, CPM, CVR, AOV, and revenue** 
 .
* Track and improve overall customer acquisition efficiency.
* Understand the difference between platform\-level ROAS and actual business profitability.
* Analyse new vs. returning customer performance.
* Work towards improving the overall
 **Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER)** 
 .
* Identify growth opportunities across products, audiences, campaigns, and channels.



  




 3\. Creative Testing
 * Work closely with the Creative Team to develop performance\-driven ad concepts.
* Identify winning creative angles, hooks, formats, products, and messaging.
* Establish a structured creative testing process.
* Analyse creative\-level performance and provide actionable feedback to the creative team.
* Continuously refresh creatives to prevent ad fatigue.



  




 4\. Analytics \& Reporting
 * Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly campaign performance.
* Prepare regular performance reports with clear insights and action points.
* Analyse campaign, product, audience, and customer\-level data.
* Use
 **GA4, Shopify Analytics, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and spreadsheets** 
 to analyse performance.
* Maintain accurate UTM and campaign tracking.
* Identify tracking or attribution issues and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve them.



  




 5\. Conversion Optimization
 * Analyse the complete customer journey from
 **ad → landing page → product page → checkout → purchase** 
 .
* Identify conversion drop\-offs and recommend improvements.
* Work with the E\-commerce/Technology team on landing\-page and website optimization.
* Test offers, product positioning, landing pages, and other conversion opportunities.



  




 6\. D2C \& Commercial Understanding
 
 The candidate should understand the commercial side of performance marketing, including:
 


* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
* Average Order Value (AOV)
* Contribution Margin
* Break\-even ROAS
* Customer Lifetime Value (LTV)
* Repeat Purchase Rate
* COD vs. prepaid performance
* RTO impact
* New vs. returning customers
* Overall profitability



 The objective is
 **not simply to generate sales, but to generate profitable and sustainable growth.** 




  




 Required Skills
 * 2–4 years of hands\-on experience in Performance Marketing.
* Strong experience with
 **Meta Ads Manager** 
 .
* Strong understanding of
 **Google Ads** 
 .
* Experience working with
 **D2C / e\-commerce brands** 
 is highly preferred.
* Strong analytical and numerical skills.
* Good understanding of GA4 and Shopify Analytics.
* Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, events, and attribution.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
* Ability to interpret data and turn insights into actions.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing funnels.
* Excellent communication and problem\-solving skills.


- 

 Preferred Qualifications
 * Experience managing a significant monthly advertising budget.
* Experience scaling a D2C/fashion/e\-commerce brand.
* Experience with Performance Max and Google Shopping.
* Understanding of Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and server\-side tracking.
* Experience with A/B testing and CRO.
* Experience working closely with creative teams.
* Experience with marketing dashboards and reporting tools.



  




 What We Are Looking For
 
 We are looking for someone who:
 


* Thinks in
 **numbers and outcomes** 
 , not just activities.
* Takes ownership of campaign performance.
* Can explain
 *why* 
 a campaign is working or failing.
* Is comfortable experimenting and testing new ideas.
* Understands that high ROAS does not always mean high profitability.
* Can work independently and make data\-backed decisions.
* Moves quickly and adapts to changing performance.
* Wants to build and scale something rather than simply manage an existing account.



  




 Key Performance Indicators
 
 Your performance will primarily be evaluated on:
 


* Revenue generated through paid channels
* CAC / CPA
* ROAS
* Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER)
* Conversion Rate
* AOV
* New Customer Acquisition
* Contribution to overall profitable growth
* Quality and speed of campaign optimization
* Creative testing velocity and learnings



  




 Why Join IZGGI?
 * Work directly with the core growth and management team.
* Own a meaningful part of the brand's growth journey.
* Build and execute strategies rather than simply follow an agency's plan.
* Work closely with creative, e\-commerce, and technology teams.
* Opportunity to take significant ownership as the brand scales.



  




 Application
 
 Candidates should share their
 **CV along with details of the brands/accounts they have managed, approximate monthly ad spend handled, and key performance results achieved.** 




 Candidates who can demonstrate
 **actual revenue growth, efficient customer acquisition, and successful scaling of campaigns** 
 will be strongly preferred.

title: Business Analytics Manager
description:

title: GA / Data Analyst
description:
**Role Overview** 
* **Role:** 

 GA / Data Analyst
* **Experience:** 

 2 to 5 years
* **Team:** 

 Analytics / CRO Services
* **Location:** 

 India / Remote
* **Role Type:** 

 Individual Contributor
* **Primary Focus:** 

 Google Analytics, digital analytics, data analysis and CRO insights



  




**About the Role** 
* We are looking for a data driven analyst who can work with digital analytics data, understand user behaviour and turn complex datasets into clear business and CRO insights.
* The role will be closely connected to our CRO and experimentation teams, helping identify
 
**what is happening, why it may be happening and where there is an opportunity to improve conversion** 

 .
* You should be comfortable working across analytics platforms, exploring data independently, identifying patterns and anomalies, and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
* The ideal candidate is not someone who simply creates dashboards or reports. You should be able to
 
**question the data, investigate the reasons behind trends and tell a clear story from the numbers** 

 .



  




**What You Will Own** 
**Data Analysis** 
* Analyse website and product data to understand user behaviour and conversion journeys.
* Identify trends, patterns, anomalies and potential areas of improvement.
* Analyse key metrics across acquisition, engagement, conversion and retention.
* Perform funnel analysis to identify where users drop off.
* Analyse user journeys and behavioural patterns across different segments.
* Compare performance across devices, browsers, traffic sources, geographies and other relevant dimensions.
* Investigate sudden changes or unexpected movements in important metrics.
* Translate analysis into clear business and CRO insights.



  




**Google Analytics** 
* Work extensively with
 
**Google Analytics 4 (GA4\)** 

 .
* Build and analyse reports and explorations in GA4\.
* Work with:
* Events
* Conversions / key events
* Audiences
* User properties
* Dimensions and metrics
* Funnels
* User journeys
* Segments
* Acquisition data
* Understand GA4 data collection and measurement concepts.
* Identify gaps or inconsistencies in analytics implementation.
* Validate whether events and conversions are being captured correctly.
* Work with Google Tag Manager where required to understand and troubleshoot tracking.
* Understand the relationship between website behaviour, analytics implementation and reported data.



  




**Other Analytics Platforms** 
* Experience working with one or more additional analytics or product analytics platforms such as:
* Adobe Analytics
* Mixpanel
* Amplitude
* Heap
* Hotjar
* Microsoft Clarity
* FullStory
* Understand differences in data collection and reporting across platforms.
* Combine quantitative analytics with behavioural data where appropriate.
* Validate findings across multiple sources rather than relying blindly on a single platform.



  




**CRO and Experimentation** 
* Work closely with CRO strategists and developers to identify opportunities from data.
* Analyse conversion funnels and identify potential friction points.
* Use analytics data to support CRO hypotheses.
* Analyse experiment results and understand the impact of different variations.
* Understand A/B testing fundamentals and statistical concepts relevant to experimentation.
* Analyse performance across experiment segments and dimensions.
* Identify whether an observed change is meaningful or could be caused by data quality, traffic mix or other external factors.
* Support post experiment analysis and help translate results into future testing opportunities.
* Understand how tracking and implementation issues can affect experiment analysis.



  




**Data Quality and Tracking** 
* Identify tracking gaps, inconsistencies and anomalies.
* Audit analytics implementations from a data perspective.
* Validate events, parameters and conversion tracking.
* Work with developers and CRO teams to troubleshoot tracking issues.
* Understand basic JavaScript, HTML and website structure sufficiently to investigate analytics implementation issues.
* Identify situations where reported data may not accurately represent actual user behaviour.
* Document tracking requirements and data issues clearly.



  




**Reporting and Insights** 
* Build meaningful reports and dashboards based on business requirements.
* Avoid reporting metrics without explaining what they mean.
* Present findings in a simple and actionable manner.
* Highlight important changes, trends and anomalies.
* Convert analysis into clear recommendations for CRO, product and marketing teams.
* Present insights to both technical and non technical stakeholders.
* Create recurring analysis frameworks for important business and website metrics.



  




**Technical Skills** 
* Strong hands on experience with
 
**Google Analytics 4** 

 .
* Strong understanding of digital analytics concepts.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
* Experience with:
* Google Tag Manager
* Looker Studio
* Excel / Google Sheets
* Working knowledge of SQL is preferred.
* Basic understanding of HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
* Understanding of web tracking and event based analytics.
* Experience with one or more product or behavioural analytics platforms.
* Understanding of A/B testing and experimentation is strongly preferred.



  




**Ideal Candidate** 
* You enjoy digging into data and figuring out what is actually happening.
* You don't stop at reporting that conversion went down. You investigate
 
**why** 

 .
* You are comfortable working with messy or incomplete data and identifying whether the data can be trusted.
* You naturally question unusual numbers and investigate anomalies.
* You can move from a dashboard into raw data when necessary.
* You can explain complex analysis in simple language.
* You understand that analytics is useful only when it leads to better decisions.
* You are curious about user behaviour, websites and digital products.
* You are comfortable working closely with CRO strategists, developers, designers and clients.
* You have strong attention to detail and a healthy skepticism about data.



  




**Minimum Qualifications** 
* 2\+ years of experience in digital analytics, web analytics, data analytics or a related role.
* Strong hands on experience with GA4\.
* Experience analysing website traffic, funnels and user behaviour.
* Experience creating reports and dashboards.
* Experience with event based analytics and tracking.
* Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills.
* Experience working with stakeholders to convert business questions into analysis.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

title: Operations- Performance Analytics- AVP
description:
**Company Overview**
 KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world\-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.
   

  

**KKR's Gurugram** 
 oﬃce provides best in class services and solutions to our internal stakeholders and clients, drives organization wide process eﬃciency and transformation, and reﬂect KKR's global culture and values of teamwork and innovation. The oﬃce will contain multifunctional business capabilities and will be integral in furthering the growth and transformation of KKR.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 KKR is hiring for an enterprise Data Operations group to collect, manage, and harness the power of data across our diverse business activities. The Data Operations Center of Excellence (CoE) is a cross\-functional team dedicated to formulating and driving KKR’s enterprise data strategy while also providing the operating leverage required to bring these strategies and frameworks to life.
   

  

 We are hiring an AVP to lead the Performance Analytics function within the Data Operations CoE. This individual will own how fund, deal, and investor\-level performance is modeled, calculated, validated, and reported across KKR’s private equity, credit, real assets, and infrastructure strategies. The role is accountable both for the underlying calculation logic, including methodology, mechanics, and documentation, and for the reporting and analysis delivered on top of it to investment teams, senior management, Finance, and Global Client Solutions.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on leadership position. The successful candidate will personally build models and write code while also leading a team of approximately three analysts and associates, setting technical standards, reviewing work, and developing junior talent. We are looking for a practitioner who is credible in the details of performance measurement and equally comfortable explaining a result to a senior stakeholder who wants to know why a number moved. The ideal candidate brings 7 to 10 years of experience in performance analytics, investment analytics, or a closely related quantitative function, with substantial private markets experience. Exposure to credit, particularly private credit, is a strong advantage given the growth of that business.
   

  

 We are operating in a 4\-day in office, 1\-day flexible work arrangement.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
* Performance Methodology \& Model Ownership: Own the design, documentation, and ongoing maintenance of KKR’s performance calculation logic across asset classes, including gross and net IRR, MOIC, TVPI, DPI, RVPI, invested and returned capital, Dollars at Work, and levered versus unlevered return treatment. Define and defend methodology choices, including fee and waterfall mechanics, cash flow timing conventions, FX treatment, and hedged versus unhedged presentation.
* Multi\-Level Performance Analytics: Produce and interpret performance at fund, deal, asset, investor, and share class or series level, ensuring results are internally consistent and reconcilable as they roll up and drill down.
* Reconciliation \& Data Integrity: Reconcile performance outputs to accounting and fund administrator sources of truth, investigate and resolve variances, and establish controls that catch breaks before they reach stakeholders. Consume administrator and system\-calculated figures where appropriate while maintaining independent validation.
* Attribution \& Benchmarking: Build attribution frameworks that explain drivers of return and deliver benchmarking and public market equivalent analysis to contextualize fund and strategy performance.
* Credit Performance Analytics: Support credit and private credit strategies with the metrics that discipline requires, including yield, spread, loss and recovery analysis, and average funded balance measurement.
* Reporting \& Automation: Deliver recurring and ad hoc performance reporting for investment teams, senior management, Finance, and Investor Relations, including investor\-facing material. Replace manual processes with automated, tested, and version\-controlled pipelines that are transparent and easy to verify.
* Team Leadership \& Mentorship: Lead a team of approximately three analysts and associates. Set analytical and coding standards, review outputs, prioritize workload, and actively develop the technical and domain skills of junior staff.
* Stakeholder Partnership: Serve as the trusted point of contact for performance questions across the firm, translating stakeholder needs into analytical solutions and communicating results and their limitations clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with data engineering, technology, Fund Accounting, and Investor Relations to ensure the data foundations, systems, and controls supporting performance analytics are robust and scalable.


**Qualifications**
* 9\-12 years of experience in performance analytics, investment analytics, fund reporting, or a comparable quantitative role within asset management
* Direct experience in private markets is required, including a working understanding of fund structures, capital calls and distributions, commitments and unfunded exposure, valuations, and fee and carry mechanics
* Demonstrated ownership of performance calculation logic and methodology, not solely the consumption of pre\-calculated figures
* Strong command of the core private markets performance metrics, including gross and net IRR, MOIC, TVPI, DPI, RVPI, invested and returned capital, and Dollars at Work, with the ability to explain how each is constructed and where each can mislead
* Advanced Python and SQL skills, with the ability to build, test, and maintain production\-quality analytical code and data models
* Experience reconciling analytical output to accounting or fund administrator data and resolving variances with a documented audit trail
* Experience building reporting and dashboards for senior stakeholders, and comfort presenting figures that will be scrutinized
* Demonstrated experience mentoring, reviewing, or formally managing junior analysts
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain methodology and results to non\-technical audiences
* Meticulous attention to detail, paired with a bias toward structured, formula\-driven, and independently verifiable work
* Strong cultural fit (teamwork, results\-oriented, proactive, and high integrity)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience supporting AI workloads in financial services or other regulated industries.
* Experience with credit, and private credit in particular, including yield, spread, loss, and recovery analytics
* Experience across multiple asset classes, such as private equity, credit, real assets, and infrastructure
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in a quantitative discipline such as finance, economics, engineering, mathematics, statistics, or computer science
* CFA, CAIA, or comparable credential
* Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake) and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Sigma, Tableau)
* Familiarity with dbt, Git, and modern analytics engineering practices, including modular transformations and version\-controlled, tested data models
* Experience applying AI, machine learning, or large language models to improve analytical and reporting workflows
* Experience supporting investor\-facing performance reporting or LP due diligence requests.


 KKR is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, or any other category protected by applicable law.
   

  

 KKR will provide reasonable accommodations as required by applicable federal, state, and/or local laws. Individuals seeking an accommodation for the application or interview process should email Benefits@kkr.com. Emails sent for unrelated issues, such as following up on an application, will not receive a response.
   

  

 If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access https://www.kkr.com/careers because of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by sending an email to Benefits@kkr.com. Only emails left for this purpose will be returned.

title: Senior Associate - Monitoring, Learning and Evaluation ( EAII Advisors )
description:
**This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.**
**About EAII**
 EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence\-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi\-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long\-term wellbeing of children and families.
   

  

 For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAII
   

  

**About Evidence Action**
 At Evidence Action, we deliver data\-driven interventions that transform lives at an unprecedented scale. We identify neglected global health issues and deploy proven solutions, forging healthier futures for generations.
   

  

 Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel\-winning economists). We measure progress and outcomes at every stage to ensure we're making a real impact for people living in poverty and suffering from preventable or treatable health issues. Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900\+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.
   

  

* Our Deworm the World program has delivered over 2 billion treatments, significantly reducing worm prevalence and generating more than $23 billion in lifetime productivity gains.
* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low\-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.


 At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high\-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
   

  

**The Role**
 You will be part of our Monitoring, Learning and Evaluation team supporting the successful design and rollout of monitoring initiatives for the India Safe Water programme. The programme is implementing In\-Line Chlorination (ILC) technology in partnership with the Government of India's Jal Jeevan Mission, targeting communities served by Single Village Scheme water systems; ILC delivers safe, chlorinated water at the source and has demonstrated strong potential for cost\-effectiveness and scale. The programme is currently operational in Andhra Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh, with the goal of reaching 17\.5 million people across multiple Indian states with safe drinking water.
   

  

 As the programme portfolio expands, you will contribute to exploring and implementing innovative, technology\-enabled ways of operating at scale. The MLE team plays a central role in generating evidence, ensuring data quality, and informing programme decisions; this role requires significant experience in evaluation, quantitative research, impact assessment, development programmes, and applied data analytics.
   

  

 The Senior Associate \- Monitoring, Learning and Evaluation will be based in New Delhi and reports to the Senior Manager \- Monitoring, Learning and Evaluation.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Monitoring Framework and Systems
   

  

* Support the MLE team in developing programme Theory of Change, Results Framework, Logframe, indicators and measurement protocols aligned with programme objectives
* Develop and institutionalise monitoring tools, reporting formats, data quality protocols and SOPs
* Establish systems for routine tracking of programme outputs, outcomes and key performance indicators
* Work closely with programme teams to ensure that monitoring systems generate actionable insights rather than only reporting numbers
* Support the design and implementation of the MLE framework for the India Safe Water programme


 Evaluation Design and Assessment
   

  

* Work with MLE team to Develop evaluation designs appropriate to programme objectives, including experimental/quasi\-experimental approaches where feasible
* Work with the MLE team to develop sampling strategies, sample size calculations, survey designs, questionnaires and data collection protocols
* Define appropriate evaluation indicators and outcome measures related to safe water access, water quality, behaviour change, service delivery and programme performance


 Data Management, Analysis and Interpretation
   

  

* Analysis of large and complex programme datasets using appropriate statistical and econometric methods
* Conduct descriptive, inferential and multivariate analysis, as appropriate
* Identify trends, patterns, correlations and anomalies in programme data and translate these into actionable programme insights
* Develop approaches for data triangulation across survey and monitoring datasets
* Establish standards for data cleaning, validation, documentation and reproducible analysis


 Data Visualisation and Dashboarding
   

  

* Develop and maintain management dashboards and data visualisation systems to track programme performance
* Translate complex datasets into intuitive visualisations that can be used by field teams for decision\-making
* Design dashboards covering key programme indicators, performance, implementation progress, outcome indicators and emerging risks


 Data Quality and Field Monitoring
   

  

* Work with the MLE team to Establish and implement a robust Data Quality Assurance (DQA) framework
* Develop protocols for data verification, back\-checks, audits and validation of field\-collected data
* Conduct periodic reviews of monitoring data to identify inconsistencies, reporting gaps and potential data quality issues
* Work with field and implementation teams to strengthen data collection processes and address data quality gaps
* Ensure that data collection tools and processes are aligned with evaluation and analytical requirements


 Programme Learning and Decision Support
   

  

* Develop regular analytical reports and management briefs highlighting programme performance, challenges, emerging trends and recommended actions
* Institutionalise learning loops between monitoring, evaluation and programme implementation


 Stakeholder Coordination
   

  

* Work closely with programme, operations, technical and field teams to integrate M\&E into programme implementation
* Manage relationships with external agencies, survey firms, evaluators and technology/data partners


**Requirements**
* 3\-5 years of relevant experience in MLE, evaluation, quantitative research, impact assessment, development programmes, or applied data analytics
* Master's degree in Economics, Statistics, Public Policy, or a related field
* Experience in WASH, safe water, public health, or rural development is desirable
* Strong understanding of evaluation methodologies and research design
* Demonstrated experience in designing impact and outcome evaluations
* Knowledge of sampling techniques, sample size determination, and survey methodology
* Advanced skills in data analysis and statistical modelling
* Strong hands\-on experience in data quality assurance, high\-frequency checks, data validation, data cleaning, and data management
* Excellent data visualisation and dashboarding skills
* Proficiency in Stata, SPSS, Power BI, and CAPI scripting. Experience with multiple analytical and data management tools is an advantage
* Ability to independently interpret quantitative findings and effectively communicate insights and implications to non\-technical stakeholders
* Strong report writing, documentation, and presentation skills
* Fluency in written and spoken English and Hindi

 Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time.

This role will focus on the economic, financial and market aspects of the petrochemical industry in India and assist the team in accelerating a just transition from oil and gas in alignment with climate commitments, with an immediate freeze on the build\-up of petrochemical infrastructure. 
 



  





 We are looking for an experienced economics and financial professional with sound knowledge of the petrochemical sector in India with preferred hands\-on experience in financial analysis. They would be self\-motivated, able to work independently, able to multi\-task, set priorities and meet deadlines with limited direction while working remotely. They must also possess a commitment to IEEFA’s mission to accelerate the transition to a diverse, sustainable and profitable energy economy.  
 



  





 IEEFA is a rapidly\-growing NGO/nonprofit that conducts research and analysis on financial and economic issues related to energy markets, trends and policies. Headquartered in the United States, IEEFA has a team of 70\+ analysts and communications personnel located in 16 countries across the globe. IEEFA produces a significant volume of original research, as well as ongoing analysis and reports on issues affecting energy industries. Our major research reports, daily analysis, press coverage and other resources can be found on our website: www.ieefa.org.
 



  





**Roles and Responsibilities** 



* Conduct research on the agrochemicals and textiles sectors within the petrochemical industry
* Conduct research on banks and financial mechanisms of the petrochemical industry
* Conduct horizon scanning for petrochemical industry developments by reviewing articles, annual reports, investor presentations, and industry publications related to the industry
* Prepare forecasts and analysis of trends in the Indian agrochemical and textile sectors within the petrochemical
* Collects economic data from established datasets and other sources, utilizing data collection and data science protocols
* Utilizes statistical analysis and mathematical methodologies to develop data
* Engage with relevant external stakeholders (e.g. regulators, banking institutions, investors, MDB’s) in India and abroad, and represent IEEFA at meetings
* Collaborate with team members and work independently to research and write original, compelling, and professional reports and commentaries on India’s petrochemical industry
* Drafting, formatting and proofing reports, submissions, press releases and presentations
* Other duties as assigned



  





**Knowledge and Skill Requirements** 



* 2\-4 years’ experience in economics / finance including at least two years of experience related to the petrochemical industry (agrochemicals) of India
* A bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, public policy
* Comprehensive experience analysing the industry growth’s impact on the economy, financial reporting, stocks, and investment portfolios
* Proficient understanding of finance, public policy and quantitative analysis.
* Understanding of policy and regulatory landscape in the petrochemical industry, with a focus on India
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, demonstrated through publications, reports, commentaries and liaising with regulators/ government stakeholders
* High degree of technological proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word, and demonstrated ability to learn new software and applications
* Commitment to IEEFA’s mission to accelerate the transition to a diverse, sustainable, and profitable economy
* Demonstrated commitment to fostering diversity, equity, and inclusion in a collaborative, team\-based environment.



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Knowledge and experience of ammonia and agrochemical sectors.



  





**Compensation and Benefits** 




 Full\-time 12\-month fixed\-term employment contract with the option of extension by mutual agreement and a market competitive remuneration. Pay rates are also based on education, skill, experience level and internal equity.
 



  





**Work Schedule** 




 Full\-time, 5 days/week with occasional evening or weekend work as required.
 



  





**Travel** 




 Some travel is required. All team members attend IEEFA’s annual conference and international team retreat.
 



  





**Physical Demand and Work Environment.** 




 Must be able to work for prolonged periods at a computer. Computer work can involve repetitive motion, eyestrain, back, and neck strain.
 



  





**EOE Statement** 




 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at IEEFA. All members of under\-represented groups are especially encouraged to apply. We are committed to providing all team members with a work environment free from discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy/parental status or disability status.
